title: Alex Cooper poses nude at nine months pregnant ahead of welcoming first baby
description: The most transformative 9 months of my life     Cooper wrote in the caption  reflecting on the experience
content:
“The most transformative 9 months of my life,” Cooper wrote in the caption, reflecting on the experience
Alex Cooper has shared a series of intimate maternity photographs, posing nude at nine months pregnant as she prepares to welcome her first child with husband Matt Kaplan.
The Call Her Daddy host, 32, posted the photographs on Instagram on October 15, capturing the final weeks of her pregnancy. In one black-and-white image, Cooper stands sideways against a plain backdrop, holding her pregnant belly while covering her chest with one hand. Other photographs highlight her baby bump and the silhouette of her body.
“The most transformative 9 months of my life,” Cooper wrote in the caption , reflecting on the experience of becoming a mother. The post attracted hundreds of thousands of likes, with friends and fans sharing messages of support in the comments.
Fellow podcast host Morgan Stewart reacted to the photographs by writing, “GORGEOUS ❤️”. Hallie Batchelder, whose podcast Extra Dirty is part of Cooper’s Unwell Network, also congratulated the soon-to-be mother, writing, “You look amazing can’t wait to meet Bebe.”
The maternity shoot comes days after Cooper shared another Instagram carousel documenting the final stretch of her pregnancy. Captioning the post “Final countdown”, she included selfies and photographs taken throughout the preceding weeks, offering followers a glimpse of her preparations for motherhood.
Cooper announced in May that she and Kaplan were expecting their first child together. The couple shared photographs of the podcast host showing her growing baby bump alongside her husband, captioning the announcement, “Our family 🤍”.
The pregnancy marks a new chapter for Cooper, who previously spoke about postponing plans to start a family so she could focus on her relationship, career and personal growth.
During a June episode of Call Her Daddy , titled My Pregnancy Story , Cooper explained that she and Kaplan had mutually decided to pause their plans to have a child in the summer of 2024 because she did not feel ready for motherhood at the time.
“I wanted to prioritise our relationship. I wanted to prioritise work and I wanted, honestly, most importantly, to prioritise myself,” she said, explaining that she needed more time before taking on the responsibilities of parenthood.
By 2026, Cooper said she felt she had accomplished what she wanted professionally and personally, and was ready for the next stage of her life.
“I couldn’t be happier that I waited and I couldn’t be happier for this next chapter of my life,” she said.
In August, Cooper also spoke to PEOPLE about her pregnancy while discussing her partnership with Babylist, which involved helping clear baby registries for expectant parents. She said one of the biggest surprises had been how little people discussed the practical and financial challenges of preparing for a baby.
“There’s so much focus on the exciting milestones, but there’s also a huge learning curve, a lot of uncertainty, and a very real financial side to preparing for a baby,” she explained, adding that every pregnancy experience is different.
Cooper and Kaplan married in April 2024 in Riviera Maya, Mexico. Kaplan, 42, is a film producer, while Cooper has built a major media business through Call Her Daddy and the Unwell Network, which she founded with her husband.
As she approaches her due date, Cooper’s latest photographs offer a personal reflection on a period she has described as transformative, marking the final weeks before the couple welcome their first child.

title: Kundi orders action against those responsible for Peshawar school roof collapse
description: Calls for strict enforcement of registration and safety requirements for private schools
content:
Calls for strict enforcement of registration and safety requirements for private schools
Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa Governor Faisal Karim Kundi on Friday ordered action against those responsible for the collapse of a school roof in Dir Colony, calling for strict enforcement of safety standards and registration requirements for private educational institutions across the province.
At least 30 children and a female teacher were killed on Thursday when the roof of a private school collapsed in Peshawar, while more than 50 others were injured.
A meeting chaired by the governor reviewed the incident and related administrative matters. Adviser to the Education Department Amir Abdullah, Peshawar Commissioner Capt (retd) Khalid Mahmood, Deputy Commissioner Afaq Wazir and relevant education officials attended the meeting.
During the briefing, the Peshawar commissioner informed the governor that the school owner had obtained 16 marlas of land on a 10-year lease and constructed the school building on it. The school was registered in 2026, but its administration had failed to comply with the prescribed standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Read : Peshawar school roof collapse: Case registered against owners, contractor
Expressing deep sorrow over the incident, Governor Kundi stressed the need to identify and inspect buildings constructed without approved maps. He said tehsil municipal administrations (TMAs) could play an effective role in inspecting buildings across the city and ensuring compliance with construction regulations.
He directed all relevant departments to fulfil their responsibilities effectively and ensure that safety standards were strictly followed in the establishment of private schools and construction of their buildings.
The governor called for strict implementation of regulations governing the registration and safety arrangements of private educational institutions. He also directed the authorities to take action against schools operating without registration certificates and establish appropriate penalties for violations.
Kundi stressed the need for effective legislation to regulate private schools and ensure compliance with safety standards and prescribed procedures. He directed the relevant authorities to prepare new legislation and submit a report within 15 days.
He further called for transparency and effective monitoring of the administrative affairs of private educational institutions, urging authorities to adopt best practices in their management.
The governor reiterated that those found responsible for the Dir Colony school roof collapse would face action, underscoring the need for stronger oversight to prevent similar incidents in the future.

Netflix acquires Brandon Feldman’s ‘Canopy’, a creature feature about a botanist facing a deadly Amazon predator
Netflix has acquired Canopy , an upcoming horror-thriller creature feature screenplay by writer Brandon Feldman, in a pre-emptive deal reportedly worth six figures.
The project follows a botanist whose search for a rare medical cure in the Amazon rainforest turns into a fight for survival.
According to Deadline , the screenplay was acquired before a wider bidding process could take place, with Verve handling the auction. Netflix representatives declined to comment on the deal.
Canopy centres on a botanist who ventures into the uncharted Amazon canopy in search of a rare medical cure. Her mission takes a terrifying turn when a local village offers her as a sacrifice to an undiscovered apex predator. Forced to survive in a dangerous and unfamiliar environment, she must confront the deadly creature while navigating the threats of the rainforest.
The project has been compared to survival thrillers such as Apex , Predator and The Shallows , suggesting a mix of creature horror, suspense and high-stakes survival. However, further details about the film’s cast, director and production schedule have not yet been announced.
Adam Goodman and Matt Skiena of Dichotomy are attached to produce the film. The producers acquired the screenplay after it began attracting attention when it appeared on The Black List website, a platform known for highlighting promising unproduced screenplays.
Feldman is also developing other projects in Hollywood. His romantic comedy Marriage Material , co-written with Ben Agron and starring Emma Roberts and Matt Rife, is set up with BuzzFeed Studios and Capstone Pictures. The writing duo have also been hired to develop another romantic comedy for Storyboard Entertainment.
Additionally, Feldman has optioned scripts to Rebel Way Entertainment, Minds Eye Entertainment and Belga Studios. He is represented by Verve, John Dunne at Independent Artists Media, and Mitchel Ostrove at Yorn, Levine, Barnes.
Netflix has yet to announce further details about Canopy , including its release date.

title: Suspected mastermind behind Kohat Police Lines suicide attack killed in Lakki Marwat operation
description: Police say Zahid Gul facilitated suicide bombing  financed militant groups with Rs6 million from bank robbery
content:
Police say Zahid Gul facilitated suicide bombing, financed militant groups with Rs6 million from bank robbery
A suspected mastermind behind the suicide attack on the old Kohat Police Lines, terrorist commander Zahid Gul, was killed during a joint intelligence-based operation conducted by the Counter Terrorism Department (CTD) police and security forces in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa's Lakki Marwat district on Friday, police officials said.
Last month , at least 21 people, including 15 police personnel and six civilians, were killed in the blast at a mosque in Kohat’s Police Lines during Friday prayers.
According to officials, the operation was carried out in the Wolai Sagai area, adjacent to the Bettani subdivision of Lakki Marwat, formerly known as Frontier Region Lakki, on the basis of intelligence reports. Gul, who was wanted by law enforcement agencies and was affiliated with the proscribed Gul Bahadur group, was killed during the operation.
Police officials alleged that Gul had played a key role in planning and facilitating the suicide attack on the old Kohat Police Lines. He had allegedly guided the suicide bomber, who was driving an explosives-laden vehicle, to the target.
Read : Initial probe reveals terrorists planned prolonged siege in Kohat Police Lines attack
Officials further claimed that Gul was involved in a bank robbery in the Bilitang area of Kohat, in which Rs6 million was looted. The money was subsequently distributed among militant groups operating in the Baka Khel and Jani Khel areas of Bannu, they said.
According to police, Gul maintained close links with the Gul Bahadur group and had facilitated the arrival of several suicide bombers in Kohat for carrying out attacks.
Officials said that around two months ago, Gul had also brought a suicide bomber to attack the new Kohat Police Lines. However, the plan was foiled by law enforcement agencies.
Police further alleged that a Pakistan Air Force installation and the police training school in Kohat were among the potential targets of future attacks planned by the slain commander.
Officials said other members of the militant network had already been taken into custody by law enforcement agencies.
The allegations against Gul and details of the operation were provided by police officials. No independent confirmation of the claims was cited in the account.

title: Joe Manganiello shares difficult health journey with photos from hospitalisation
description: Joe Manganiello shares hospital photos after losing 60 pounds following intestine surgery amid seven year illness
content:
Joe Manganiello shares hospital photos after losing 60 pounds following intestine surgery amid seven-year illness
Joe Manganiello has shared photos documenting his difficult health journey, revealing that he lost 60 pounds following surgery to remove his large intestine during a seven-year battle with an autoimmune disease.
The Magic Mike actor, 49, posted the images on Instagram on October 15, days after releasing his memoir, Bloodlines , in which he detailed his prolonged illness and its impact on his life.
“In the days following the amputation of my large intestine, my weight began to plummet,” Manganiello wrote, explaining that he lost 60 pounds in the two weeks after surgery. He also shared images showing his recovery, including a photograph taken during his hospitalisation and pictures documenting complications affecting his abdomen and skin.
Manganiello said he experienced several symptoms throughout his illness, including digestive tract ulcers, severe abdominal pain, fevers, blistering rashes, headaches and extreme fatigue. The pain became so intense that he sometimes struggled to walk.
The actor explained that his symptoms began around the time of his marriage to Sofía Vergara in 2015. Despite undergoing numerous tests and trying medications commonly used to treat Crohn’s disease and colitis, doctors initially struggled to find an effective treatment.
In an interview with People published on October 7, Manganiello described how his condition continued to worsen. He also discussed relying on pain medication to manage his symptoms and the emotional challenges this created during his 13 years of sobriety.
Manganiello said his health struggles also affected his mental well-being. He later sought help from a shaman in Santa Monica, which he described as a turning point in his personal journey.
The actor, who is now engaged to Caitlin O’Connor, has opened up about his illness in his memoir, offering a detailed account of the physical and emotional challenges he experienced over seven years.

Couple share throwback photographs, affectionate messages as Saif’s sister joins celebrations with a tribute
Bollywood actors Saif Ali Khan and Kareena Kapoor Khan celebrated their 14th wedding anniversary on Friday, sharing nostalgic photographs and affectionate messages on social media to mark another milestone in their relationship.
Kareena took to Instagram to share a series of throwback pictures documenting different chapters of their life together, from their early days as a couple to family moments with their sons, Taimur and Jeh. “Another year around the sun…Forever to go,” she captioned the post, expressing her enduring affection for her husband.
Saif responded in the comments with a characteristically playful message, writing, “I wonder what the moon thinks about all this... Happy anniversary love!!!”
The exchange drew attention from fans, who celebrated the couple’s relationship and their ability to balance high-profile careers with family life.
Saif’s sister, Saba Ali Khan, also marked the occasion with a lengthy tribute , accompanied by photographs of the couple and a message reflecting on the years she had witnessed their companionship.
“Happy Anniversary. To my brother and sister... in law (only a technicality.) Wishing you the journey of many more beautiful years ahead.. filled with moments to treasure. From the collection of photos taken by me... its nostalgic to see how long I've witnessed your companionship,” she wrote.
Welcoming Kareena into the family, Saba added, “Bebo.. welcome to the family again. You completed the Khan clan! Bhai welcome to the gram family! Happy happy Anniversary to u both. Lots of Love.”
Saif and Kareena’s relationship began attracting considerable attention during the making of Tashan in 2008. Directed by Vijay Krishna Acharya, the action film brought the two actors together on screen and became an important chapter in their personal lives.
After dating for approximately five years, the couple married in Mumbai on October 16, 2012, in a private ceremony at Saif’s Bandra residence. Their wedding celebrations also included traditional functions and a reception attended by family members and friends from the film industry.
Their marriage brought together two prominent Bollywood families. Saif, the son of veteran actor Sharmila Tagore and former Indian cricket captain Mansoor Ali Khan Pataudi, had two children, Sara Ali Khan and Ibrahim Ali Khan, from his previous marriage to actor Amrita Singh.
Kareena, meanwhile, was already an established leading actor in Hindi cinema, having starred in films such as Jab We Met , 3 Idiots and Bodyguard .
The couple welcomed their first son , Taimur, in December 2016, followed by their younger son, Jehangir in February 2021.
Over the years, the family has shared occasional glimpses of holidays, celebrations and everyday moments on social media, while largely keeping their private lives separate from their professional commitments.
Saif and Kareena have appeared together in several films, giving audiences a glimpse of their on-screen chemistry. Their notable collaborations include LOC: Kargil (2003), Omkara (2006), Tashan (2008), Kurbaan (2009) and Agent Vinod (2012), spanning action, romance, drama and crime thrillers.
Despite their shared cinematic history, they have not appeared together in a full-length film since Agent Vinod . Kareena also made a brief appearance in Saif’s Happy Ending (2014).
In a June 2026 interview with Variety India , Saif discussed the prospect of reuniting with his wife on screen, indicating that they would need the right project to work together again. The pair have not rushed into another collaboration simply because of their real-life relationship.
Away from their anniversary celebrations, both actors remain active in the film industry. Kareena was recently seen in Daayra . The crime drama explores questions surrounding justice and crime, marking another project in Kareena’s continuing career as a leading actor.
Saif, meanwhile, starred in Priyadarshan’s Haiwan , a crime thriller featuring Akshay Kumar alongside an ensemble cast. The film is a remake of Priyadarshan’s Malayalam-language thriller Oppam .
The couple is also set to appear together on season five of The Great Indian Kapil Show , with their episode scheduled to stream on Netflix on October 17, a day after their anniversary. The appearance will offer audiences another opportunity to see the pair share their humour and anecdotes beyond their film roles.

title: Fakhar highlights World Cup preparations | The Express Tribune
description: Opener says tri-series offers Pakistan chance to build combination ahead of 2027 global event
content:
Opener says tri-series offers Pakistan chance to build combination ahead of 2027 global event
Pakistan ’s seasoned batsman Fakhar Zaman said on Friday that the ODI tri-series, also involving England and Sri Lanka, would help the team fine-tune combination for the 2027 ODI World Cup and regain momentum in the 50-over format after an extended break from one-day cricket.
Pakistan will face Sri Lanka in the opening match of the tri-series at Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium on Sunday (tomorrow), with England completing the three-team line-up.
Fakhar said Pakistan had drawn up plans for the upcoming series but would keep some details confidential, adding that preparations were also focused on the bigger challenge ahead.
“There are a lot of plans regarding the tri-series, some of which you cannot make public,” Fakhar told reporters at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium on Friday.
“We are very hopeful and excited. The way we are preparing, we have all the plans for the World Cup in the back of our minds, so we will try to do well in this tri-nation series and also build a combination because we are playing one-day matches after a long time.”
Pakistan have several experienced players in their ODI squad, including Babar Azam, Salman Ali Agha and captain Shaheen Shah Afridi. Meanwhile, younger players such as Saim Ayub, Hasan Nawaz and wicket-keeper Saad Baig will be looking to establish themselves.
Fakhar, Pakistan's only double centurion in the men's ODIs, said the squad's recent first-class cricket commitments could help players adapt to the demands of the 50-over format.
“The best thing about the combination is that all the boys are coming after playing the first-class season. So everyone is in rhythm and is coming after playing a long format of cricket,” he said.
“When you play first-class cricket then 50 overs format does not seem that long to you, whereas when you play T20 regularly, it seems a little long,” Fakhar said.
The left-handed opener added that Pakistan's bowlers had also shown encouraging signs, with the squad eager to establish a settled combination ahead of the global tournament.
“We have a very good combination, as you can also see from the way wickets are being sold out. Everyone has the World Cup in their minds,” he said.
Pakistan's recent ODI results have offered grounds for optimism. They swept Sri Lanka 3-0 at home in November 2025, defeated South Africa 2-1 and beat Australia by the same margin in home series in May and June 2026. However, they suffered a 2-1 defeat away to Bangladesh in March.
Fakhar acknowledged the pressure on senior players to deliver, saying criticism was an inevitable part of the professional sport when results did not go their way.
“When you perform, you get appreciation from fans. When you don't do well, then it is natural that things don't feel good,” he said.
“Every person, senior and junior, tries to do their best and improve in their profession.”
Pakistan have not won a major global cricket title in recent years, and Fakhar said the squad understood the importance of turning promising performances into silverware.
“We are excited right now, and we definitely have this thought in the back of our minds that it has been a long time since we won a big event,” he said.
“We have reached finals and played semi-finals, but the happiness that you get as a nation after winning the trophy is something you don't get, no matter how many finals or semi-finals you play.”
The stage for the tri-series is set as England also arrived on Friday and will undergo training on Saturday (today). Pakistan and Sri Lanka have started their preparation from Thursday.
The series will be played under double league round robin format with the top two teams progressing to the October 31 final.

title: Influencer Jennifer Burnham reveals son Baxter   s cause of death at age 4
description: Influencer Jennifer Burnham reveals her 4 year old son Baxter died from an aggressive brain cancer on October 5
content:
Influencer Jennifer Burnham reveals her 4-year-old son Baxter died from an aggressive brain cancer on October 5
Influencer Jennifer Burnham has revealed that her four-year-old son, Baxter, died from diffuse midline glioma, an aggressive form of brain cancer. The content creator previously announced his death on Instagram, sharing that he passed away on October 5.
In an Instagram video posted on October 15, Burnham opened up about her son’s diagnosis and the family’s efforts to find treatment. She explained that Baxter had been a healthy and happy child before they noticed his left eye beginning to turn inward.
Doctors initially suspected strabismus, a condition in which the eyes do not align properly, and planned surgery to correct it. However, an MRI scan conducted before the procedure revealed a brain tumour, changing the course of the family’s lives.
Burnham said Baxter underwent surgery to remove part of the tumour. The family also pursued red light therapy and travelled to Europe twice during the summer in search of additional treatment options.
The influencer described the experience as a difficult six-month journey, explaining that they consulted specialists and explored different possibilities to help their son.
“It’s so difficult to watch your child going through something like this and you’re literally helpless,” Burnham said. She added that Baxter remained strong throughout his illness and fought until his final day.
Following his death, Burnham paid tribute to her son in an emotional social media post, remembering his kind personality and love for his family, toy cars, chocolate chip cookies and karate.
“You have the most perfect angelic face and the sweetest personality,” she wrote, recalling the joy he brought to their lives.
Jennifer and her husband, Bryce Burnham, welcomed Baxter on January 25, 2022. The couple also share a younger son, Barron, who is one year old.
Burnham has built an online following of approximately 96,000 Instagram users through lifestyle, motherhood and cooking content. Her recent posts have documented the family’s grief following Baxter’s death and celebrated the memories they shared with him.

title: Hasan Raheem submits  Bewajah  for consideration in two Grammy categories
description: Song blends Urdu  Shina lyrics with visuals showcasing Gilgit Baltistan   s music  traditional attire and freestyle polo
content:
Song blends Urdu, Shina lyrics with visuals showcasing Gilgit-Baltistan’s music, traditional attire and freestyle polo
Singer Hasan Raheem has submitted his song Bewajah for consideration at the 2027 Grammy Awards in two categories: Best Music Video and Best Global Music Performance.
The singer announced the submission on Instagram through a post shared by the Hasan Raheem Global page, captioned “BEWAJAH | FOR YOUR GRAMMY®️ CONSIDERATION”.
The post listed both categories, marking a notable moment for Raheem as his music continues to bring the sounds and traditions of his native Gilgit-Baltistan to wider audiences.
The submission does not guarantee a Grammy nomination, but it places Bewajah in contention for consideration at one of the music industry’s most prestigious awards. It is notable not only for the song itself but also for the cultural heritage it represents.
While Best Global Music Performance recognises music from across diverse traditions, Best Music Video focuses on the visual production accompanying a recording. Bewajah brings the two elements together through its musical influences and portrayal of northern Pakistan.
Released in March 2026, Bewajah features producer Umair and blends Urdu lyrics with a bridge in Shina, a language spoken in Gilgit-Baltistan. The track draws on the region’s musical identity, combining emotional storytelling with sounds rooted in Raheem’s cultural heritage.
The music video is equally central to the song’s appeal. Filmed in Gilgit, Pakistan, it unfolds against the region’s dramatic mountainous landscape, incorporating traditional clothing, Gilgiti dance and a freestyle polo match. Raheem, dressed in white and adorned with jewellery, stands out against the dark-clad players and spectators, while the surrounding mountains add to the video’s striking cinematography.
By placing freestyle polo, traditional attire and local dance at the centre of its visual narrative, the video gives the release a distinct cultural identity that extends beyond its musical arrangement.
He has also spoken about freestyle polo, a sport closely associated with the region’s Shandur Polo Festival, describing it as an experience everyone should witness at least once. The video’s setting reflects his continuing interest in bringing the traditions of Gilgit-Baltistan to wider audiences.
Raheem rose to wider prominence with tracks including Aisay Kaisay and Joona , later expanding his audience through collaborations and appearances on Coke Studio Pakistan. His work has frequently drawn on his roots, making Gilgit-Baltistan an important part of his artistic identity.

title: Zara Larsson refuses to stay silent on social issues despite  3m brand deal loss

content:
The Swedish singer says the internet, feminist voices and early blogging shaped her views on injustice
Zara Larsson has defended her decision to speak openly about political and social issues after revealing that her outspoken views have cost her lucrative business opportunities, including a brand deal worth $3 million.
In an interview with fellow Swedish singer Robyn for Rolling Stone ’s Musicians on Musicians series, published on October 13, Larsson discussed the professional consequences of expressing her opinions publicly. Asked whether speaking out had cost her opportunities, she replied, “There’s many,” without naming the companies involved or revealing the value of the other deals she mentioned.
The singer has previously identified one specific loss. In an interview published on April 3, 2026, Larsson said she lost a $3 million brand deal following a social media exchange about abortion. The singer described it as the largest brand opportunity she had received.
The controversy began after a fan posted on TikTok that she had attended one of Larsson’s concerts before realising she was pregnant and later having an abortion. Larsson responded with a joke about the experience, drawing attention and criticism online.
Larsson subsequently defended the humour behind her response and argued that jokes could help people discuss serious subjects. She did not identify the brand that allegedly withdrew the deal, so its identity and the circumstances behind the decision remain undisclosed.
During her conversation with Robyn, Larsson also explained how her interest in social issues developed during her teenage years. She began blogging at around 13 or 14, reading news reports and discussing subjects with people who disagreed with her.
She credited the internet, Tumblr, Wikipedia and feminist voices with helping her understand injustice and develop her opinions. Topics including abortion, immigration and human rights have remained part of her public commentary.

title: Pakistani Saraiki folk song goes viral in India through social media
description: Singers Shanzy Sial and Mohsin Lashari s rendition gains millions of views online
content:
Singers Shanzy Sial and Mohsin Lashari's rendition gains millions of views online
A traditional Saraiki folk song from Pakistan is finding a new audience across the border, with Chalre Chalre Waal gaining widespread attention on social media and winning over listeners in India.
Performed in an acoustic rendition by Pakistani singers Shanzy Sial and Mohsin Lashari, the folk song has attracted millions of views across Instagram and YouTube. The song has particularly resonated with audiences in Indian Punjab, where listeners have embraced its melody and familiar folk sounds.
The singers shared their performance on Instagram , where it drew an enthusiastic response from fans and amassed more than 10 million likes, according to the supplied account.
The track’s growing popularity has also sparked comparisons with Na Kajre Ki Dhar , the popular 1994 song from Rajiv Rai’s Bollywood film Mohra . The parallels have fuelled online discussions, introducing the Pakistani rendition to an even wider audience.
Chalre Chalre Waal , also known in some versions as Tediyan Reesan Kon Kare , is a traditional Saraiki folk song associated with Pakistan’s Punjab region. Its renewed popularity highlights the enduring appeal of folk music and the role digital platforms play in introducing regional sounds to listeners unfamiliar with their origins.
Saraiki is widely spoken in southern Punjab and neighbouring areas of Pakistan. For many Indian listeners, the music offers an introduction to the region’s linguistic and cultural heritage.
The song has been performed by several folk singers over the years, with Muhammad Hussain Bandialvi widely associated with it. The late Shafaullah Khan Rokhri also played a significant role in popularising Saraiki music among wider audiences.
Like many traditional folk compositions, the song has evolved through different interpretations rather than remaining tied to a single definitive recording. Its continued circulation across generations has allowed singers to revisit the melody in styles that appeal to contemporary listeners.
The song’s appeal has extended beyond Pakistani artists, catching the attention of Indian Punjabi singer Sunanda Sharma, who has also shared her interpretation of the folk number.
Her version has introduced the melody to another segment of listeners, adding to the growing interest in a song that is increasingly crossing linguistic and national boundaries.
The enthusiasm surrounding the different renditions reflects the shared musical traditions of the wider Punjab region, where folk melodies have long travelled between communities and generations.
The song’s online momentum received another boost when Uttar Pradesh Police sub-inspector Nishant Mishra went viral for performing Chalre Chalre Waal while playing the guitar.
Mishra’s performance attracted attention from Indian social media users and helped introduce the Pakistani Saraiki song to another audience.
In his caption, he wrote, “A reminder that music has no boundaries, no language barriers, and no borders. It connects hearts!”
The response illustrates how unexpected performances and personal interpretations can give traditional music a new lease of life online. A song that might otherwise remain familiar primarily to regional audiences can quickly reach listeners across countries and languages.
From the acoustic performance by Shanzy Sial and Mohsin Lashari to Sharma’s rendition and Mishra’s guitar performance, Chalre Chalre Waal has found new life through multiple interpretations.
Its reception also underscores the continuing appeal of South Asia’s shared folk traditions. While audiences may discover the song through comparisons with familiar Bollywood music or viral performances, its roots remain firmly connected to Saraiki culture.

title: Ashley St Clair says Elon Musk showed a different side of himself after she had their son
description: St Clair recalls Musk telling her that they should have a child together and that she should have as many as 10 kids
content:
St Clair recalls Musk telling her that they should have a child together and that she should have as many as 10 kids
Ashley St. Clair has opened up about her relationship with Elon Musk, claiming the billionaire showed a different side of himself after she gave birth to their son, Romulus.
The former conservative influencer shares her account in Musk , a new documentary directed by Alex Gibney that examines the Tesla and SpaceX chief executive’s personal life, business empire and relationships. St. Clair describes how their relationship began and alleges that Musk’s behaviour changed after the arrival of their child.
“It was almost as if he didn’t show a certain side of himself until after I had our baby,” St. Clair says in the documentary.
St. Clair says she first connected with Musk through X in 2023, after he contacted her on the platform. Their relationship reportedly developed quickly, with conversations about having children together.
According to St. Clair, Musk frequently encouraged her to have a larger family. She recalls him telling her that they should have a child together and that she should have as many as 10 children.
She says he presented himself as a devoted father and gave her the impression that he maintained amicable relationships with the mothers of his other children. St. Clair eventually agreed to have a child with him, believing they shared similar expectations about family life.
However, she alleges that their relationship changed after Romulus was born in September 2024. The documentary details a subsequent dispute over financial support and an agreement that St. Clair says she refused to sign.
According to St. Clair, Musk’s representatives presented her with an agreement labelled as a child support contract that included a proposed payment of $15 million upfront and $100,000 per month for 20 years. She claims the arrangement also functioned as a non-disclosure agreement, which she ultimately declined to sign.
After St. Clair publicly revealed that she had welcomed a child with Musk in February 2025, his financial support allegedly decreased. The documentary claims her monthly payments were reduced from $100,000 to $40,000, and later to $20,000 after she spoke publicly about their relationship.
Musk’s representatives and his aide, Jared Birchall, did not respond to PEOPLE’s requests for comment on the allegations, according to the publication.
St. Clair has also spoken about messages she says she received from other women who claimed Musk had contacted them about having children with him. She specifically references a woman in Japan who was reportedly interested in sperm donation.
The dispute has since developed into a legal battle over Romulus. St. Clair has sought full custody of their son, while Musk has indicated that he intends to contest the case in court.
Musk did not participate in Gibney’s documentary and has criticised the project as a biased “hit piece”. His lawyer has also threatened legal action over what he described as factual inaccuracies.
The documentary offers St. Clair a platform to recount her experience, but her claims about Musk’s conduct and the financial arrangements remain allegations. The ongoing custody dispute adds another dimension to the public scrutiny surrounding their relationship.

title: Al Pacino to receive life achievement award from actors  guild
description: Veteran actor will receive SAG AFTRA   s 2027 Life Achievement Award for his long career and humanitarian contributions
content:
Veteran actor will receive SAG-AFTRA’s 2027 Life Achievement Award for his long career and humanitarian contributions
Celebrated actor Al Pacino will receive a lifetime achievement award for his career achievements and humanitarian work next year, the actors' union SAG-AFTRA announced on ​Thursday.
The American actor, best known for playing Michael Corleone in The Godfather films is ‌the 62nd recipient of the SAG-AFTRA Life Achievement Award.
The union will present the award to him in Los Angeles at the 33rd Actor Awards on February 28, 2027 as part of a ceremony to be ​live-streamed on Netflix.
Pacino's recognition follows a career spanning more than six decades across film, ​television and stage.
He is known for numerous memorable characters, including real-life police ⁠officer Frank Serpico in 1973's Serpico , Miami mobster Tony Montana in 1983's Scarface and more recently Hollywood ​agent Marvin Schwarz in Quentin Tarantino's 2019 film Once Upon a Time … in Hollywood .
The award is presented ​annually to an actor who embodies the "finest ideals of the acting profession," according to the union.
"I wondered and wandered most of my life but have always felt at home with a script and my fellow actors," ​Pacino said in a statement from the actors' union.
"It's the work and the actors along the ​way that have been among the greatest joys of my life. It's an honour to be recognised by ‌SAG-AFTRA ⁠in celebrating the journey," he added.
Pacino won the Best Actor Oscar for his performance as Lieutenant Colonel Frank Slade in the 1992 film Scent of a Woman , and has also won multiple Emmy, Tony and Golden Globe awards.
"Like so many actors, I have spent my life in awe and ​appreciation of the force ​of nature that ⁠is Al Pacino. When you watch him perform, you are witnessing a student and a master," SAG-AFTRA President Sean Astin added in the statement.
Pacino ​also participated in the America: A Tribute to Heroes telethon following the September ​11, 2001 ⁠attacks, and in 2009 received the Arthritis Foundation's Jane Wyman Humanitarian Award for his charitable work.
The 86-year-old actor was born Alfredo James Pacino in New York. He struggled throughout the 1960s to find ⁠steady work ​before his eventual film breakthrough in 1972's The Godfather .
SAG-AFTRA represents ​approximately 160,000 actors, announcers, broadcast journalists, dancers, DJs, news writers, news editors, program hosts, puppeteers, recording artists, singers, stunt performers, ​voiceover artists, influencers and other entertainment and media professionals.

title: Tesla s new Roadster turns in air with SpaceX thrusters  won t land until 2028
description: Roadster can accelerate from zero to 60 mph in less than one second and can hit a top speed of over 230 mph
content:
Roadster can accelerate from zero to 60 mph in less than one second and can hit a top speed of over 230 mph
Tesla unveiled a redesigned Roadster powered with rocket-style thrusters on ​Thursday and said it would start production in 2028, more than a decade after it first showed a next-generation version of its electric sports car.
The white two-seater vehicle, ‌developed in collaboration with CEO Elon Musk's rocket company SpaceX, drove upside down on a ramp using a suction system, turned in the air and landed using built-in thrusters. Later in the event, it used the thrusters to jump over a truck and other vehicles, twisting in the air during the manoeuvre.
Some watchers saw the collaboration as Musk drumming up interest in a merger of the two big companies he controls, an idea he has explored by discussing their ​overlap.
Flying cars may be closer than we think. Elon Musk showcases a Tesla Roadster demonstration featuring a "kickflip" through the air over other vehicles in Texas, leaving the crowd in awe as he teases a not-so-distant future where cars could do more than just drive. "This will be… pic.twitter.com/kZPRU59Myw
Tesla shares were up 5% in premarket trading on Friday.
The reveal gives Tesla a showpiece car after years of missed Roadster deadlines, but it comes as the company shifts its focus ​to self-driving technology and robotics, and days before third-quarter results that analysts say matter more to investors.
Read : Tesla plans to build new electric vehicles in mid-2025
"It was an engineering flex with no commercial value ⁠beyond embarrassing traditional car makers," Gene Munster, managing partner at Tesla investor Deepwater Asset Management, said on social media platform X.
"The Roadster event is the latest example of why Elon can't wait to bring (Tesla) ​and (SpaceX) together," Munster said.
Two takeaways from tonight’s Roadster event. 1. It was an engineering flex with no commercial value beyond embarrassing traditional car makers. 2. Elon can’t wait to bring $TSLA and $SPCX together.
Musk has played down the car's importance to Tesla's finances, describing it in 2023 as a "small potato situation" that would not "move the needle in a major way financially."
But the car still carries ​symbolic weight.
"Tesla does not currently have a halo car, or high-performance luxury vehicle designed to showcase an automaker's best engineering and technology. The Roadster will be Tesla's new halo car," Morningstar analyst Seth Goldstein said in a note last month.
Viewers and witnesses gushed over the spectacle of the launch.
"That was the most insane product demo I've ever seen," Tesla fan and investor Sawyer Merritt posted on X. "I just saw this in person, and I'm still asking how this wasn't ​AI."
Now leaving the Tesla Roadster event. The hype going into this event was sky-high, yet Tesla somehow managed to exceed expectations. Kudos to all the engineers and designers. That was the most insane product demo I’ve ever seen. The Roadster looks great in person. Can’t wait to… pic.twitter.com/cANPgyjCDO
Musk and other executives did not specify any target prices at Thursday's event, although Tesla nearly a decade ago quoted a base price of $200,000 for the vehicle.
Tesla's reservation page for the Roadster after ​Thursday's event showed a "Performance" version of the vehicle requiring a $50,000 deposit and a "Thrust" version with "acceleration thrusters" requiring a $250,000 deposit. A "Rocket" variant, which Tesla says is "invite only," is described as a single-seat model with a "full flight system."
The event at a SpaceX test site in McGregor, Texas, had all the elements of a classic Musk product reveal: dramatic music, smoke, mechanical hissing sounds and a launch countdown.
0-60 mph in 0.81 seconds pic.twitter.com/7Pp4oqJVzq
"This is the culmination of incredible work by Tesla and SpaceX engineers working closely together to make something that you haven't seen in any movie," Musk, wearing a silver Western-style belt buckle emblazoned with the Tesla logo, told a cheering crowd of enthusiasts and investors.
The Roadster can accelerate from zero to 60 mph (97 kph) in less than one second and can hit a top speed of over 230 mph (370 kph), Tesla vehicle engineering chief Lars Moravy ​said.
"Definitely much faster than that," an excited Musk ​said. "I think you've got to crack halfway to ⁠the speed of sound."
The Roadster can also travel over 300 miles (480 km) on a single charge. That is less than half of what Musk promised in 2017, when Tesla first revealed a prototype of the second-generation Roadster and said that deliveries would begin in 2020.
The original Roadster, released in 2008 and on ​sale until 2012, was Tesla's first-ever electric vehicle and used a Lotus Elise chassis. It helped change the world's view of what an EV ​could be. The company has ⁠since been known for its Model Y and Model X SUVs and Model S and Model 3 sedans.
The reveal of the second-generation Roadster comes amid a sharp shift in Tesla's focus to artificial intelligence-led self-driving tech and robotics, away from manufacturing cars for human drivers.
Read More : How Tesla defined a new era for the global auto industry
This year, Tesla stopped selling Model S and X vehicles to make space for production of its Optimus humanoid robots. It also launched Cybercab — a two-seater robotaxi that comes without ⁠manual controls such ​as a steering wheel, pedals and mirrors.
Tesla is set to report third-quarter results on October 21.
Sales of Tesla's ageing lineup ​of EVs have declined over the past two years, although high gas prices helped boost deliveries in the third quarter.
"The margin and cash flow numbers will carry far more weight with investors than anything they saw at the reveal," said Josh Gilbert, ​lead analyst for Asia-Pacific at trading platform eToro.

title: Zoya Nasir says divorce is not an easy decision  stresses need for healing
description: Actor says greater acceptance of divorce does not diminish heartbreak of separation or the time women need to recover
content:
Actor says greater acceptance of divorce does not diminish heartbreak of separation or the time women need to recover
Actor Zoya Nasir has weighed in on the debate surrounding veteran actor Saba Faisal’s remarks about divorce, stressing that ending a marriage is far from an easy decision for a woman and that the emotional toll of separation should not be overlooked.
Speaking in an interview, Nasir highlighted the heartbreak, difficult choices and healing that can follow the end of a marriage. She challenged the notion that greater acceptance of divorce means people have stopped grieving its consequences.
“I don’t think any girl makes a decision so fast. She’s like, ‘I hope this works.’ It’s not an easy decision. She puts a rock on her heart, and it’s like she’s lost an important part of herself when she gets divorced. To get out of that is very hard as well,” she said.
The actor also emphasised that women should be given the time and space to recover emotionally after a separation. “If she takes a three-month vacation, that’s the least she needs to heal,” Nasir said, adding, “It’s fine if it didn’t work out.”
Her comments come amid renewed discussion about Faisal’s views on how families respond to divorce today compared with previous generations.
In an interview with The Express Tribune , Faisal reflected on how divorce was once followed by an extended period of mourning within families, saying news of a separation now often appeared to be shared more casually. “Before, when someone used to get divorced, there used to be a ‘sog’ happening for months,” she said, referring to the mourning traditionally associated with the end of a marriage.
Faisal’s remarks sparked debate about whether divorce has become normalised in society and whether greater acceptance has diminished the significance of marriage. While some agreed that the end of a marriage should be treated as a serious matter, others argued that accepting divorce does not mean celebrating it or dismissing the pain involved.
Nasir had previously expressed strong reservations about the narrative surrounding divorce, describing it as a “dangerous and twisted narrative” in response to Faisal’s remarks. Her latest comments reinforce the distinction between treating divorce casually and recognising that a marriage may end despite a person’s best efforts to make it work.
The discussion also brings renewed attention to Nasir’s own experiences. In a 2022 interview with The Express Tribune , the actor spoke about her early marriage and subsequent divorce, urging parents not to marry teenage girls to significantly older men. She discussed the challenges she had faced and the importance of having a supportive family during a difficult period.
Nasir’s personal life also attracted public attention through her former engagement to German travel vlogger Christian Betzmann . The pair announced their engagement in 2020 before calling it off in 2021, following a public disagreement over Betzmann’s remarks concerning Pakistan, its culture and religion. Nasir announced the end of their engagement, citing differences over her values and his stance.
More recently, Nasir reflected on personal growth and self-discovery in a birthday post, describing the occasion as a private new year that allowed her to look back, learn and set new goals. “I’ve always treated my birthday as my own private New Year. A time to reflect, learn, unlearn, grow and step into another year with the same ambitions and new goals,” she wrote.
She added that the year had been rewarding both personally and professionally before describing her changing outlook on ageing. “I think I’m experiencing the exact opposite of a midlife crisis. A midlife clarity maybe? Turns out growing older might just mean growing into yourself,” she added.
Her reflections on growth and healing echo the message behind her comments on divorce: difficult life transitions require time, understanding and the freedom to move forward without judgement.
Beyond her personal life, Nasir has established herself as an actor and entrepreneur. She made her television debut in Hania and went on to appear in popular dramas including Deewangi , Dobara , Mere Humsafar , Jannat Se Aagay and Noor Jahan . Before entering the entertainment industry, she pursued cosmetology and built a career in the beauty business.

title: Families of children killed in Peshawar school roof collapse demand justice
description: Dozens of people gathered on Friday outside the school to mourn the children killed in the collapse
content:
Dozens of people gathered on Friday outside the school to mourn the children killed in the collapse
The families of children killed in a roof collapse at a school in Peshawar called for "justice" on Friday, the day after more than 30 pupils and a teacher were crushed to death.
A woman teacher and 32 students, mostly younger than 14, died in the building collapse on Thursday morning.
"The parents of all these children must receive justice," tailor Muhammad Wahab, who lost his 11-year-old nephew Hammad in the accident, told AFP on Friday.
Read: At least 30 children, teacher killed as school roof collapses in Peshawar
"I appeal to our rulers," he said, adding that Hammad had been "doing well in school" before the tragedy.
Dozens of people gathered on Friday outside the school to mourn the children who were killed in the collapse, which officials blamed on dilapidated infrastructure.
One grief-stricken father showed AFP a picture on his mobile phone of his young daughter, dressed in red and gold, who lost her life.
Another parent, Asadullah, said he lost a son, nephew, and three other close relatives in the tragedy.
"The children were good students and often achieved top positions in their classes," he told AFP . "They happily went to school every day."
Residents and rescuers described chaotic scenes in the aftermath of Thursday's collapse, as people scrambled to pull children out from under the rubble.
Read more: Lahore roof collapse claims 14 young lives
A man named Sohail told AFP that "everyone began screaming in panic" when his niece, who had escaped the building, arrived home to tell them it had collapsed.
"When I arrived at the scene, I saw around 10 to 15 children trapped beneath the rubble, with debris piled up to their necks. We quickly pulled them out," he said.
Images released by emergency services showed rescue workers in high-visibility vests scrambling to move debris, rubble and dirt.
A senior official in Peshawar told AFP that initial reports suggested the roof collapse was due to "weak infrastructure".
"The school owner has been detained," the official said on condition of anonymity because he was not authorised to talk to the media.
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif expressed "deep sorrow and grief over the loss of precious lives" in an X post.
My heart is with the families grieving the loss of their children and a teacher in the tragic roof collapse at a school in Peshawar. No parent should have to endure such pain. I extend my deepest condolences and pray for strength for every family affected. I have directed that…
President Asif Ali Zardari described the roof collapse as a "heartbreaking tragedy".
Building collapses are common in Pakistan, largely due to poor safety standards and substandard construction materials in the South Asian nation of more than 240 million people.
In June, more than a dozen children were killed when a roof collapsed at a tutoring centre in Lahore.
In 2025, 27 people were killed and 10 injured when a five-storey building collapsed in Karachi's Lyari.

description: The jewellery designer married Nigerian billionaire heir Geoffrey Ogunlesi earlier this month
content:
The jewellery designer married Nigerian billionaire heir Geoffrey Ogunlesi earlier this month
Jennifer Meyer has opened up about having her ex-husband, Tobey Maguire, officiate her wedding to her new husband, Geoffrey Ogunlesi, describing the decision as unconventional but fitting for their family.
The jewellery designer married Ogunlesi on 10 October 2026, with Maguire serving as the officiant. The detail emerged after paparazzi photographs from the ceremony circulated online.
Speaking in a new feature with Vogue , Meyer reflected on the wedding and explained why having her former husband involved made the occasion particularly meaningful.
“I genuinely felt like I was floating on cloud nine,” Meyer said. “I had zero jitters, just pure happiness. Having our three children and our parents walk down the aisle made it even more special. And having Tobey, my ex-husband, officiate was so special. A little unconventional, but so perfectly us.”
Meyer and Maguire married in 2007 and separated in 2016. Their divorce was finalised just days before her second wedding.
They share two children, Ruby, 19, and Otis, 17. Meyer also welcomed a child with Ogunlesi earlier this year.
Meyer has previously spoken warmly about her relationship with Maguire since their separation.
In an interview with People , she called him “the most A+ human being I know”.
“When Tobey and I broke up, it was very clear immediately that Ruby and Otis came first, and we really cared about each other as people, and we wanted to be in each other’s lives no matter what,” she said.
Meyer also explained that the former couple continue to celebrate holidays, birthdays and other occasions together, highlighting their commitment to co-parenting.
She added that Maguire and Ogunlesi have a positive relationship, saying: “And Geoff loves him and he loves Geoff. And so everything just works.”

title: Kaley Cuoco shares adorable moment as pet dog Dolly meets newborn daughter Philomena
description: Kaley Cuoco shares a sweet video of newborn daughter Philomena meeting family dog Dolly after her October 12 arrival
content:
Kaley Cuoco shares a sweet video of newborn daughter Philomena meeting family dog Dolly after her October 12 arrival
Kaley Cuoco has shared a sweet glimpse of her newborn daughter Philomena getting acquainted with the family dog, Dolly, after welcoming her second child with fiancé Tom Pelphrey.
The Big Bang Theory actress, 40, and Pelphrey, 44, welcomed their daughter, Philomena Carmine Bobby Pelphrey, on October 12. The couple have since brought their newborn home to meet their family, including their three-year-old daughter, Matilda.
On Thursday, October 15, Cuoco shared several family moments on her Instagram Stories, including a video of Dolly, a Cane Corso mix, licking the newborn. The actress added a message encouraging people to let dogs interact naturally with their families.
“Let dogs be dogs. Let them sniff and lick and do what they do. They are part of the family too,” Cuoco wrote over the video, which featured the song “Kiss Me” by Sixpence None the Richer.
Cuoco also shared a clip of Pelphrey sleeping on the couch while cuddling their newborn daughter. The video was accompanied by the song “Daddy’s Girl” by Needle & Salt. Another photograph showed Pelphrey holding both Matilda and Philomena.
The actress announced Philomena’s arrival in an Instagram post earlier this week, describing the experience as a blessing and expressing gratitude for the journey that brought their family together.
“Family officially complete,” Cuoco wrote, adding that it was time to bring Matilda’s baby sister home. She also praised Pelphrey, calling him her “girl daddy”.
Cuoco and Pelphrey were introduced by their mutual manager in 2022, at the season four premiere of Ozark . The couple welcomed Matilda in March 2023 and became engaged in August 2024.
In September, Pelphrey spoke about preparing for their second child, saying the couple and their daughter were excited about the new addition. He also discussed how they were rearranging their home and adjusting to the prospect of raising two children.
The latest family updates offer a glimpse into the couple’s first days at home with their newborn daughter.

title: Brad Pitt faces fresh family speculation as children reportedly change phone numbers
description: Several of the former couple   s children have also taken steps to remove Pitt from their surnames
content:
Several of the former couple’s children have also taken steps to remove Pitt from their surnames
Brad Pitt is reportedly facing further distance from his children, with a new report claiming that they have changed their phone numbers and that the actor is considering another way to reach them. The claims were published by the Daily Mail , but the details have not been independently confirmed.
Pitt shares six children with his former wife, Angelina Jolie: Maddox, Pax, Zahara, Shiloh and twins Vivienne and Knox. The couple separated in 2016, and their divorce was finalised in December 2024.
The family’s strained relationship has attracted renewed attention as several of the children have taken steps to remove Pitt from their surnames. Shiloh legally changed her name to Shiloh Jolie in 2024. Zahara’s name change to Zahara Marley Jolie was approved in 2026, while Maddox and Vivienne have also pursued changes to their names. These decisions are personal and do not, on their own, establish the reasons behind the family’s estrangement.
Pitt has not publicly confirmed the phone number claims in the report, and there has been no independently verified statement establishing that all six children have changed their numbers. Any suggestion that he has developed a plan to contact them without Jolie’s involvement should therefore be treated as reported speculation unless evidence emerges.
Their separation has also involved a long running legal dispute over Château Miraval, the French winery they once co owned. The legal proceedings and the children’s individual decisions have continued to generate headlines, but the family’s private communications remain out of public view.
The report’s central claims remain unconfirmed. Public records and previous coverage document surname changes by some of the children, but they do not verify the alleged phone number changes or the reported plan attributed to Pitt. Comment from the actor’s representatives or additional reliable reporting would be needed to establish those details.

content:
Lowe has directed multiple episodes of the show, which honoured Fiona with a tribute in its season 2 premiere
9-1-1: Nashville has paid tribute to Chad Lowe’s daughter Fiona following her death at the age of 13 last month.
The tribute appeared at the end of the season two premiere, which aired on Thursday, October 15. A title card displayed the words “In Loving Memory”, alongside Fiona’s name and photograph.
Lowe, 58, has directed multiple episodes of 9-1-1: Nashville and 9-1-1: Lone Star , the latter of which starred his brother, Rob Lowe. He also portrayed his brother’s on-screen sibling during a brief storyline.
News of Fiona’s death emerged in September. Chad and his wife, Kim Painter, subsequently shared a statement expressing their grief and requesting privacy for their family.
“We are deeply heartbroken by the loss of our beloved Fiona,” the couple wrote, describing their daughter as “a loving young girl who was smart, creative and loved to dance.”

title: The Mummy  Book of the Dead    confirmed as official title for Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz   s fourth Mummy film
description: Oded Fehr returns as Ardeth Bay  while Matt Bettinelli Olpin and Tyler Gillett direct the new adventure
content:
Oded Fehr returns as Ardeth Bay, while Matt Bettinelli-Olpin and Tyler Gillett direct the new adventure
The Mummy: Book of the Dead is the official title of the next instalment in the popular action adventure franchise starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz. Universal Pictures confirmed the title on October 15, 2026, while reaffirming the film’s planned theatrical release date of October 15, 2027.
In one year, The Mummy: Book of the Dead opens. In cinemas October 15. pic.twitter.com/aCqRJ9XdaX
Fraser and Weisz are returning as adventurer Rick O’Connell and Egyptologist Evelyn O’Connell. They will be joined by returning franchise cast members John Hannah and Oded Fehr, alongside Michael Johnston, Numan Acar and Kevin J O’Connor.
Fehr’s return as Ardeth Bay has added to speculation about the possible return of Imhotep, the central villain played by Arnold Vosloo in the first two films. However, no official confirmation has established whether the character will appear in the new movie.
The title references the Book of the Dead, an ancient text featured in the original 1999 film. Within the franchise, the book contains spells associated with resurrecting the dead and summoning supernatural warriors. Its connection to the earlier story has prompted fans to consider whether the new instalment could revisit elements that helped establish the series.
Directing duties are being handled by Matt Bettinelli-Olpin and Tyler Gillett, the filmmaking duo known as Radio Silence. David Coggeshall is writing the screenplay, while franchise veteran Sean Daniel is producing.
Early set photographs have also offered glimpses of Fraser and Weisz in costume, giving fans an indication that their characters will reunite for another adventure. Fehr previously shared a first look at his return as Ardeth Bay.
The upcoming film follows The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor , released in 2008, which did not feature Fehr’s character. Fehr later explained that Ardeth Bay had little reason to appear without Imhotep serving as the main antagonist.
Although the new title and returning cast have encouraged theories about the story, the plot remains under wraps. The Mummy: Book of the Dead is scheduled to arrive in cinemas on October 15, 2027.

title: Trump administration reopened citizenship probe into Rep Ilhan Omar  report
description: Current investigation focuses on documents submitted after Ilhan  family arrived in US as Somali refugees decades ago
content:
Current investigation focuses on documents submitted after Ilhan, family arrived in US as Somali refugees decades ago
The Trump administration has reopened an investigation into US Republican Ilhan Omar’s citizenship, seven years after federal officials examined similar allegations and found insufficient evidence of wrongdoing, The Washington Post reported on Thursday.
Federal agents searched the Minnesota Democrat’s Washington, DC, home on Monday as part of a renewed inquiry into whether Omar or her late father provided false information on immigration paperwork, according to the report.
The Trump administration’s investigation into Rep. Ilhan Omar is aimed at building a case to strip her of her U.S. citizenship and ultimately deport her, according to U.S. officials and other people familiar with the probe. https://t.co/JhyihvLHsd
The current investigation focuses on documents submitted after Omar and her family arrived in the US as Somali refugees decades ago, including paperwork used to obtain legal status and eventual citizenship.
Omar and her family were granted asylum when they came to the US in 1995, when she was 12 years old, and she became a citizen when she was 17.
Also Read : US launches immigration raid of Democratic congresswoman Ilhan Omar's home
During Trump’s first term, Homeland Security officials reviewed Omar’s immigration history after a political appointee sought evidence of possible fraud, the Post reported, citing former immigration officials.
Investigators examined her family’s refugee history, questions about her birthdate and her father's past military service in Somalia, along with longstanding allegations about her marriage.
A 2019 review by Trump administration immigration officials found insufficient evidence of wrongdoing by Democratic Rep. Ilhan Omar, including questions about her citizenship, birth date and her father's background. The Trump administration has now reopened an investigation into… pic.twitter.com/siKCi2QenX
The review concluded there was “insufficient evidence of wrongdoing,” one former official told the newspaper.
The renewed inquiry could lead to criminal charges or an attempt to challenge Omar’s citizenship if investigators obtain evidence of fraud, according to officials cited by the Post .
Omar, a frequent critic of Trump, rejected the investigation as an effort to “target political enemies and weaponise federal law enforcement.”
“Trump has spread lie after lie about the Congresswoman in a desperate attempt to justify his extraordinary abuse of power,” her spokesperson said on Thursday.
“This is politically motivated and an escalation of Trump’s personal vendetta against her lasting over a decade,” the spokesperson added.
One former official familiar with the earlier review questioned the basis for reviving the case. “I think her citizenship is solid and there wasn’t any fraud there,” the official told the Post .
Asked about Omar this week, Trump denied directing the investigation. “I think she’s a terrible person,” he told reporters. “But that’s really up to the DOJ (Justice Department). I have nothing to do with it.”
"I think she's a terrible person... I don't think she loves the country at all." President Trump makes his feelings about Rep. Ilhan Omar unmistakably clear when asked about the home raid involving the congresswoman. Despite the criticism, the president repeatedly insists he… pic.twitter.com/VDzfKa7y43
Under standard policy, the Justice Department avoids taking any action that might be seen as influencing an election within 60 days of that election.
Omar is currently seeking reelection to Congress in the November 3 election, which is less than three weeks away.

title: Pakistan should go with balanced squad in tri series
description: Sadiq says Shaheen must prioritise batting depth with defined role and disciplined bowling
content:
Sadiq says Shaheen must prioritise batting depth with defined role and disciplined bowling
Former Test opener Sadiq Mohammad has said that Pakistan should go with a balanced squad in the ODI tri-series which will begin on Sunday with the game between Pakistan and Sri Lanka at the Pindi Stadium Rawalpindi.
“Pakistan squad should carry five specialist batsmen, five bowlers and a stumper. My advice to Shaheen Afridi is to ensure that every player has a clearly defined role, with the right batsmen occupying their proper positions in the batting order,”Sadiq told The Express Tribune in an interview.
“It is disappointing that Shahibzada Farhan and Maaz Sadqat are not in the ODI squad. They are the two in-form batsmen and needed to be there,” Sadiq said.
“Pakistan should build its batting lineup around Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam and Hasan Nawaz, supported by a wicket-keeper batsman and the necessary all-rounders. The bowling options could include Sufiyan Muqim, Arafat Minhas, Faheem Ashraf, Razaullah, Shadab Khan, Shaheen Afridi and Abrar, depending on the final team combination. The middle order must be instructed to target a minimum total of 300 runs,” Sadiq said.
He said that at least one established batsman should remain at the crease until the final over to help Pakistan finish strongly,
“Whether batting first or chasing the objective should be to bat through all 50 overs and maximise the final total. Ideally, one of the top five batsmen should face the last ball of the 50th over and finish the innings with a well-timed shot in front of square,” Sadiq said.
“Bowlers must consistently hit a good length and maintain a disciplined line around the fourth stump, just outside off stump. Every delivery should have a clear purpose, with bowlers planning how to challenge the batter rather than simply delivering the ball.”
“Razaullah's outswing ability should be utilised with the new ball. I recommend giving him two overs with two slips in place and instructing him to pitch the ball up, inviting right-handed batsmen to play the cover drive and creating opportunities for catches in the slip cordon. Against left-handed batsmen, he should use his inswinger to target the pads and create opportunities for leg-before-wicket dismissals, with the field adjusted accordingly, including a deep square-leg fielder where appropriate,” Sadiq said.
He said that Pakistan should consider batting first if they win the toss.
“I think they should bat first after winning the toss, particularly when conditions are favourable and a strong total could improve their qualification prospects. The team must aim to bat for the full 50 overs and avoid unnecessary collapses. If teams finish level on points after four matches, net run rate or other applicable competition rules could determine qualification for the final. In such circumstances, every run matters,” he said.
“Finally, if the choice is between Salman Ali Agha and Saim Ayub, I would favour Salman on the basis of my assessment of their batting. I consider the bowling contributions of both players relatively modest, so the decision should primarily depend on the batting role required by the team,” Sadiq said.
Sadiq advised Babar to act as a premier batsman.
"Babar should play his natural game, just as he used to. For the first 25 runs, he should focus on playing in front of square rather than guiding the ball behind square. Once he is set, he should make sure to play the last ball of each over and not worry too much about his strike rate. This approach could help him score a century in 115 to 125 balls by the end of the innings. However, he must make sure to play the last ball of the innings," Sadiq said.
"When batting with a tailender, Babar must face at least four balls per over while guiding the tailender to stay with him and encouraging him to play with a straight bat."

title: Maldives arrive for King Cup
description: Eight nations will compete as Pakistan hosts the women   s event for the first time
content:
Eight nations will compete as Pakistan hosts the women’s event for the first time
The Maldives team have arrived in Islamabad ahead of the Billie Jean King Cup Asia/Oceania Group III, which will be held from October 21 to 24 at the Pakistan Tennis Federation (PTF) Tennis Complex.
Pakistan will host the international women’s team tennis competition for the first time, with eight nations set to compete in the tournament.
Bahrain, Bhutan, Iran, Jordan, Kuwait, Maldives, Pakistan and Qatar are participating in the event.
PTF president Aisam-ul-Haq Qureshi and secretary general Colonel Zia-ud-Din Tufail, along with federation officials, welcomed the Maldivian delegation upon arrival.
The PTF leadership said hosting the tournament reflected Pakistan’s commitment to developing tennis, particularly women’s tennis, while strengthening international sporting ties.
The competition will also give Pakistani players an opportunity to face international opponents on home soil.
The federation said it was making arrangements to welcome the participating teams and officials and ensure the smooth running of the tournament.
The event marks a milestone for Pakistan tennis as the country prepares to stage the regional competition for the first time.

title: Al Pacino to receive SAG AFTRA Life Achievement Award at 2027 Actor Awards
description: The Oscar winner has also earned two Tony Awards  two Primetime Emmy Awards and two Actor Awards
content:
The Oscar winner has also earned two Tony Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards and two Actor Awards
Al Pacino will receive SAG-AFTRA’s Life Achievement Award at the 2027 Actor Awards, recognising his celebrated acting career and humanitarian contributions. The union announced the honour ahead of the ceremony, scheduled for February 28, 2027, at the Shrine Auditorium in Los Angeles.
The award is presented annually to an actor who represents the finest ideals of the acting profession. SAG-AFTRA praised Pacino for his work across film, television and theatre, highlighting performances that have influenced generations of performers and left a lasting mark on entertainment.
SAG-AFTRA President Sean Astin also expressed his admiration for the veteran actor, describing him as an artist whose courage, intensity and talent have set an exceptional standard. Astin said the union was proud to celebrate Pacino with its highest honour.
Pacino, known for acclaimed films including The Godfather , Serpico , Dog Day Afternoon and Scarface , has earned numerous awards throughout his career. He won the Academy Award for Best Actor for Scent of a Woman and has received two Tony Awards, two Primetime Emmy Awards and two Actor Awards.
His other honours include the AFI Life Achievement Award, the Cecil B DeMille Award at the Golden Globes, a Kennedy Center Honor and the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement at the Venice Film Festival.
Responding to the announcement, Pacino reflected on his lifelong connection to acting and the people he has worked alongside. He said scripts and fellow actors had consistently made him feel at home, adding that the work itself and the relationships formed along the way had been among the greatest joys of his life.
Beyond his performances, Pacino has supported humanitarian causes, including the Shakespeare Center of Los Angeles. His charitable involvement has also included disaster relief efforts and global advocacy.
The 2027 ceremony will celebrate Pacino’s enduring contribution to the acting profession, bringing recognition to a career spanning decades and multiple entertainment mediums.

title: Medvedev to face Jodar in Shanghai semis
description: Russian beats Tommy Paul in the quarterfinals
content:
Russian beats Tommy Paul in the quarterfinals
Daniil Medvedev overcame a wobble to beat a fighting Tommy Paul on Friday and reach the semi-finals of the Shanghai Masters, setting up a showdown with rising star Rafael Jodar.
At age 20, the Spaniard is the youngest player to reach the Shanghai semi-finals since the tournament's inaugural edition in 2009.
Medvedev, the 2019 Shanghai champion, overcame inconsistent serving to beat Paul 6-3, 1-6, 6-3.
The 30-year-old saved seven break points to hold back the American in a marathon sixth game, giving little away as he broke to take the first set when Paul fired long.
But the 18th-ranked Paul returned inspired in the second set, displaying fantastic defence as Medvedev drove him around the court.
He was rewarded when Medvedev double-faulted twice in a must-win game to tumble into a decider.
The Russian, ranked sixth, cruised to a 2-0 lead in the third set and carried that momentum to the end, breaking again to win on his second match point.
Earlier, 13th-ranked Jodar beat Norway's Casper Ruud 4-6, 6-4, 6-3 -- recovering from a set down for the fourth time in a row this week.
Both players were tested but held serve to start with until Ruud capitalised on a break point, taking the first set with a searing forehand into the corner.
But Jodar's brilliance shone through, dazzling the crowd with a gorgeous over-the-shoulder smash in the fourth game of the second set.
Despite losing that game, the Spaniard held his nerve and won a crucial break point to go up 5-4 before closing out the set at the first time of asking.
Ruud, ranked 24th, saved three match points in the third set but double-faulted to hand Jodar victory.
"Casper is a very tough player," Jodar said afterwards. "I had to give my best level today to win this match."
Top seed Alexander Zverev faces Alejandro Davidovich Fokina in the other semi-final on Saturday.
