title: India s  cockroach  movement leaders detained in jail for five days  party and police say
description: Detentions risk triggering protests by youth supporters  opposition groups  student bodies holding demonstrations
content:
Detentions risk triggering protests by youth supporters; opposition groups, student bodies holding demonstrations
An Indian court ordered that two leaders of the youth-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) be detained in jail for five days, the party and police said on Wednesday, a day after they scaled barricades to enter a historic site popular for protests and chanted ​slogans demanding the election chief's resignation.
The detentions risk triggering fresh protests by youth supporters at a time ​when opposition groups and student bodies are holding almost daily demonstrations to demand commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's ⁠resignation over voter list revisions that critics say favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
The Election Commission has ​denied favouring any party and said wrongly deleted voters can re-enrol, while the BJP has accused rivals of trying to ​undermine democracy by wrongly questioning legitimate electoral processes.
CJP leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das were among about a dozen people who jumped barricades on Tuesday to enter the grounds of the Jantar Mantar open-air observatory in Delhi's central business district.
Read: What is fuelling India's protests over changes to voter lists?
Police said this week that the ​site -- previously designated for demonstrations -- was no longer an official protest venue.
Das and Ranka were sent to jail for ​violating a legal undertaking they had given authorities when they were released from detention last week, their lawyer Abhisht Hela told ‌reporters.
Delhi Police ⁠also said they were punished due to their "repeated violations" and "serious apprehensions" that they would "again violate law and instigate others to violate law" if released on bail.
CJP leader Ajinkya Shinde, who was released on a personal bond, said the party would not be "frightened" by its leaders' imprisonment.
"We will put an end to this dictatorial ​government," he said.
The 'cockroach' movement has ​mobilised protests in recent ⁠months against issues ranging from government school infrastructure to jobs and is among Modi and his BJP's biggest political challenges in his 12 years in power.
Read More: Indian police detain 'cockroach' movement founder Abhijeet Dipke
A weeks-long sit-in by its supporters ​at Jantar Mantar earlier this year forced Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation over exam ​paper leaks.
The recent ⁠demonstrations erupted after the Indian Express newspaper reported that Kumar's two deputies raised several concerns internally about the changes, registration procedures and digital systems.
The revisions, which started last year, removed over 130 million names — more than the population of Japan — ⁠from voter ​lists, including 28 million who died, 63 million who relocated, and ​30 million who could not be traced.
Opposition parties allege the deletions disproportionately affect Muslims and other minorities, who are unlikely to support the Hindu ​nationalist ruling party — allegations the poll panel and BJP reject.

title: Aurangzeb says Pakistan   s fiscal deficit falls to 22 year low
description: Finance minister highlights three consecutive primary surpluses  targets growth of 4  or higher this fiscal year
content:
Finance minister highlights three consecutive primary surpluses, targets growth of 4% or higher this fiscal year
Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb on Wednesday told an International Monetary Fund (IMF) meeting that Pakistan’s fiscal deficit had fallen to a 22-year low, with three consecutive years of primary surpluses and economic growth of 3.7 per cent, according to a statement issued by the Ministry of Finance.
Aurangzeb held a series of meetings with international financial institutions, credit rating agencies, investors and US officials on the sidelines of the World Bank Group-IMF Annual Meetings 2026 in Bangkok, with discussions focused on Pakistan’s economic outlook, financing, trade, energy cooperation and reforms.
Addressing the Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan and Pakistan (MENAP) meeting on the sidelines of the World Bank Group-IMF Annual Meetings 2026 in Bangkok, Thailand, Aurangzeb also highlighted Pakistan’s foreign exchange reserves, sovereign rating upgrades and progress under the IMF programme.
“He noted historic-high foreign exchange reserves covering three months of imports, and stronger buffers against climate and regional shocks. He cited sovereign rating upgrades, the September Eurobond issuance and the October 7 IMF staff-level agreement as evidence of progress,” the statement read.
The minister reaffirmed commitment "to reforms and targeted, budget-neutral and time-bound subsidies to protect low-income groups and preserve social cohesion." He also called for diversified energy sources and trade routes, deeper regional integration, and investment in logistics and food systems.
“The Finance Minister emphasised renewed commitment to multilateralism and Pakistan's readiness to contribute actively to regional cooperation,” the ministry added.
Finance Minister Highlights Pakistan’s Economic Progress and Reaffirms Commitment to Reforms, Regional Cooperation and Multilateralism at MENAP Meeting Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue, Senator Muhammad Aurangzeb, addressed the Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan and… pic.twitter.com/d9ILN0kRqj
Discusses energy imports and Reko Diq with US officials
In a separate meeting with Ambassador Yon of the US State Department, Aurangzeb discussed bilateral economic cooperation, including progress towards a trade framework agreement and energy diversification through increased imports from the United States.
“He reviewed progress towards a trade framework agreement and energy diversification through increased imports from the United States. The Finance Minister also outlined measures to maintain fuel supplies and support vulnerable consumers,” the ministry said.
Finance Minister Discusses Trade, Energy Cooperation, Strategic Minerals and Investment with U.S. State Department Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue, Senator Muhammad Aurangzeb, met with Ambassador Yon of the U.S. State Department on the sidelines of the World Bank… pic.twitter.com/ZBCizqKDb0
“Discussions covered AML/CFT arrangements, FATF follow-up and investment financing through the US Development Finance Corporation (DFC) and EXIM Bank. The Finance Minister highlighted Reko Diq, cooperation on critical minerals, project security and opportunities to mobilize private investment,” the statement read.
According to the statement, the meeting also discussed Boeing aircraft acquisition and financing, aviation clearances, digital asset regulation and potential remittances and Eurobond tokenisation applications.
Ambitious to secure double-B sovereign rating
At a separate meeting with S&P Global Ratings, the finance minister discussed Pakistan’s economic progress and sovereign credit outlook, highlighting the "September bond issuance, investor participation and progress under the IMF programme."
"He briefed the agency on improved tax collections, reserve accumulation and reduced swap and forward liabilities,” the statement added.
Finance Minister Highlights Pakistan’s Market Access, Economic Reforms and Sovereign Rating Ambitions in Meeting with S&P Global Ratings Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue, Senator Muhammad Aurangzeb, met with S&P Global Ratings on the sidelines of the World Bank Group–IMF… pic.twitter.com/CxpT6Or5Ro
Aurangzeb reaffirmed commitment to "structural reforms, fiscal discipline and sustainable export-led growth." He also outlined Pakistan’s ambition to enter the double-B rating category through sustained economic improvements.
“Discussions covered agricultural income taxation, energy and food security, targeted relief and climate resilience. The Finance Minister noted S&P’s emphasis on policy continuity, reform implementation, a lower interest burden and stronger external buffers as key rating considerations,” the ministry added.
At Standard Chartered Bank’s Sovereign Investor Roundtable, Aurangzeb briefed investors on Pakistan’s economic progress and financing strategy.
He highlighted three consecutive years of primary surpluses, a fiscal deficit at a 22-year low and sovereign rating upgrades.
"He outlined financing diversification through Sukuk, Panda bonds and a proposed rupee-denominated, dollar-settled international bond, emphasizing lower borrowing costs, longer debt maturities and reduced rollover risks,” the handout read.
Finance Minister Highlights Economic Progress and Financing Strategy at Standard Chartered Sovereign Investor Roundtable Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue, Senator Muhammad Aurangzeb, briefed investors on Pakistan’s economic progress at Standard Chartered Bank’s Sovereign… pic.twitter.com/suJZiLLj1b
The minister stressed, "sustained structural reforms, fiscal discipline, stronger tax enforcement and investment- and export-led growth beyond the IMF programme."
Discussions covered stronger reserves, inflation and the external outlook, energy security, targeted relief and climate financing.
“The Finance Minister reaffirmed the government’s commitment to sustaining reforms and further strengthening Pakistan’s sovereign credit standing,” the ministry added.
Minister sees growth exceeding 4% this fiscal year
In a separate meeting at the Citi Macro Forum held earlier, Aurangzeb briefed international investors on Pakistan’s economic outlook and reform priorities, expressing optimism about growth in the current fiscal year.
According to the ministry's post on X, “The Finance Minister highlighted continued macroeconomic stabilization, three consecutive years of primary surpluses, a fiscal deficit at a 22-year low and strengthened foreign exchange buffers, while expressing optimism about growth reaching or exceeding 4% during the current fiscal year."
Finance Minister Highlights Macroeconomic Stabilization, Capital Market Strategy and Reform Priorities at Citi Macro Forum Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue, Senator Muhammad Aurangzeb, participated in the Citi Macro Forum Session and briefed international investors on… pic.twitter.com/Y0pNkn1y8l
He outlined Pakistan’s capital market strategy, including further Panda bond issuances, Sukuk and a rupee-denominated, dollar-settled international bond, emphasising "diversification of funding sources, lower borrowing costs and longer debt maturities."
"He also discussed progress under the IMF programme, tax-base expansion, stronger enforcement and provincial coordination to sustain fiscal discipline,” the statement read.
The minister, addressing the impact of the Middle East conflict, outlined measures to maintain energy supplies and provide targeted relief to vulnerable groups within existing budgetary allocations. Discussions also covered climate resilience, disaster preparedness, and effective utilization of development financing.
“He reaffirmed Pakistan’s commitment to sustained reforms and a transition from aid towards trade and investment in its partnerships with other countries,” the statement added.

title: Leighton Meester and Jared Padalecki find romance in Netflix   s  Guarding Stars  trailer
description: The film is scheduled to premiere on November 18 as part of Netflix s Christmas movie line up
content:
The film is scheduled to premiere on November 18 as part of Netflix's Christmas movie line-up
Leighton Meester and Jared Padalecki are bringing holiday romance to Netflix with Guarding Stars, a festive romantic comedy based on Katherine Center’s bestselling novel The Bodyguard. PEOPLE has unveiled an exclusive first look at the upcoming film, which sees the pair caught between a professional assignment and unexpected romantic feelings.
Meester plays Hannah Brooks, a no-nonsense bodyguard tasked with protecting Jack Stapleton, a charming action star played by Padalecki, from a stalker during his holiday visit to his family in Montana. To keep the threat under wraps, Hannah poses as Jack’s girlfriend, setting the stage for a fake relationship that becomes increasingly complicated as the two grow closer.
The film combines romance and comedy with action, featuring horseback rides, explosive stunts and emotional family moments. The story also explores how the unexpected assignment challenges Hannah’s professional boundaries as she spends more time with the star she has been hired to protect.
The supporting cast includes Andie MacDowell, My Life with the Walter Boys actor Noah LaLonde, country singer Walker Hayes, Toby Sandeman, Rachael Ancheril, Shaun Johnston, Phil Brooks and pop singer Ava Max.
Directed by Elizabeth Allen Rosenbaum, Guarding Stars is adapted from Center’s 2022 novel. The screenplay is written by Erin Cardillo, Richard Keith, Gina Matthews and Grant Scharbo.
The film is scheduled to premiere on Netflix on November 18, 2026, as part of the streaming platform’s upcoming Christmas movie line-up.

title: Kelly Clarkson faces backlash after Art of Play co owner alleges staff received death threats
description: The company   s co owner says employees have faced frightening messages following the public dispute
content:
The company’s co owner says employees have faced frightening messages following the public dispute
Kelly Clarkson has been drawn into a controversy involving Art of Play after a co owner of the company alleged that employees received death threats following public attention surrounding the dispute.
According to TMZ , the co owner claimed that Clarkson’s actions had placed staff members in danger. The allegation adds a serious dimension to the disagreement, with concerns shifting beyond the parties directly involved to the people working for the company.
The co owner’s comments were reported on October 13, although the precise nature and number of the alleged threats were not independently established in the material provided. The claims should therefore be treated as allegations rather than confirmed findings.
Death threats against employees are a serious matter, particularly when a public dispute attracts attention online. Workers who have no direct role in a disagreement can become targets when anger is directed towards a business or its staff. However, the existence of threats does not, by itself, establish that any particular individual caused them.
Clarkson, the Grammy winning singer and television presenter, is widely known for her music career and for hosting The Kelly Clarkson Show . The latest controversy has brought renewed attention to her reported connection with Art of Play, though the available information does not fully establish the circumstances behind the dispute.
The co owner’s criticism centres on the alleged consequences for employees, rather than solely on the disagreement itself. Any assessment of responsibility would require further evidence about what was said publicly, how the messages were generated and whether a direct link can be established.
The claims also highlight the risks businesses can face when disputes involving well known personalities circulate online. Employees may find themselves caught up in public arguments despite having no decision making role in the matter.
Further information from Clarkson, her representatives or Art of Play would help clarify the allegations. Until additional details are confirmed, claims about responsibility for the reported threats should remain carefully attributed.

title: She was meant to fly   Hareem Farooq on launching Hania Aamir with  Janaan
description: Says she recognised her potential early on  sees producing as a way to support Pakistani cinema and emerging talent
content:
Says she recognised her potential early on, sees producing as a way to support Pakistani cinema and emerging talent
Actor and producer Hareem Farooq has reaffirmed her role in introducing Hania Aamir to the big screen through the 2016 romantic comedy Janaan , saying the actor was destined for success and that she had simply recognised her potential early on.
Speaking in an interview about her upcoming film Mango Jutt , co-starring Faysal Quraishi, Farooq spoke about her love for film production and her decision to give Aamir an early opportunity in the industry.
“Yes, I did launch her,” Farooq said, reflecting on Aamir’s entry into Pakistani cinema. “Let’s just say she was meant to be. She was meant to fly. I just caught her early. It’s just like that,” she added, describing her role in recognising Aamir’s potential.
Released in 2016, Janaan marked Farooq’s debut as a film producer. The romantic comedy introduced audiences to several performers who would go on to establish themselves in Pakistani entertainment, including Aamir, Bilal Ashraf and Ali Rehman Khan.
For Farooq, the project was not simply an entry into film production; it was also an opportunity to create space for emerging talent.
She joked that her work behind the scenes was often overlooked, despite her experience in theatre production.
“I was telling someone the other day that whenever I do a production, someone always comes up to me and asks if it is my first time producing. But when I went into theatre production, everyone knew of my work,” she said.
Farooq said she was drawn to production because it gave her the opportunity to contribute to Pakistani cinema beyond her own performances.
“But I love to do production. I like to do stories that can contribute to Pakistani cinema and make a difference. If I can contribute to our country, then why not, even if it is a slight challenge,” she said.
Her approach reflects a broader ambition to support local filmmaking by backing stories that resonate with audiences while creating opportunities for new performers. With Janaan , Farooq largely remained behind the scenes, allowing emerging actors to take the spotlight.
In a 2024 interview with The Express Tribune , Farooq also spoke about the satisfaction she derived from playing a role in Aamir’s career, describing production as a way of giving back to an industry that had given her opportunities of her own.
Aamir, who first gained attention through social media videos, went on to build a career across television and film. Her subsequent projects helped establish her as one of Pakistan’s prominent young performers, giving Janaan a lasting place in discussions about the industry’s introduction of new talent.
Farooq’s comments about introducing Aamir therefore speak to more than the discovery of a future star. They underline her view that producing involves recognising talent, taking chances on new performers and investing in stories that can contribute to the growth of Pakistani cinema.
For Aamir, Janaan marked the beginning of a screen career that would grow considerably in the years that followed. For Farooq, it was the first step in a parallel journey as a producer, in which creating opportunities for others has remained an important part of her vision.

title: PTI moves PHC against emergency  governor   s rule in K P
description: Salman Akram Raja says party will pursue legal action to establish Sohail Afridi   s whereabouts
content:
Salman Akram Raja says party will pursue legal action to establish Sohail Afridi’s whereabouts
Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan on Wednesday filed a petition in the Peshawar High Court (PHC), challenging the imposition of emergency and governor’s rule in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) and seeking the restoration of the province’s elected government.
In a post on X, PTI Central Information Secretary Sheikh Waqas Akram said the petition had been filed against the Federation of Pakistan and others, seeking the restoration of the people’s representative government in the province.
Petition filed by Barristar Gohar Ali Khan vs Federation of Pakistan and others before Peshawar High Court(against imposition of Governors rule and emergency) PTI is asking for the representative government of people to be restored. pic.twitter.com/zsyvW6uiKd
Meanwhile, PTI Secretary General Barrister Salman Akram Raja said the party was approaching the courts to ascertain the whereabouts of K-P Chief Minister Sohail Afridi and determine where he was being held. He said the party would pursue all constitutional and legal options alongside political engagement.
“Speaker Sahib has been arrested at this time. The homes of all our MPAs are under attack. The National Assembly session holds little significance at this point,” Raja said, referring to Wednesday’s National Assembly session .
He questioned the purpose of the session, saying it could result in the passage of a resolution calling for negotiations.
“We are going to court now. Where Sohail Afridi is and where he has been kept is of the utmost importance to us. We are looking into all of this, and we will certainly take all constitutional and legal measures. We will engage at the political level as well as at the legal level,” Raja said.
He added that the party was assessing the situation and taking the developments seriously.

The developments follow the federal government’s decision on October 11 to impose emergency and governor’s rule in K-P, suspending the PTI-led provincial administration.
The government cited deteriorating law and order and alleged shortcomings in the provincial government’s coordination with federal authorities on counterterrorism operations.

title: Saif Ali Khan   s sister opens up about managing family   s INR10 billion legacy
description: Custodian of Auqaf e Shahi trust says her late father   s lessons continue to guide her role in preserving the heritage
content:
Custodian of Auqaf-e-Shahi trust says her late father’s lessons continue to guide her role in preserving the heritage
Saba Pataudi, sister of Bollywood actor Saif Ali Khan, has opened up about her role in preserving and managing the Pataudi family’s legacy, revealing that the responsibility was entrusted to her by her late father, former Indian cricket captain Mansoor Ali Khan Pataudi.
According to Gulf News , Saba oversees matters relating to the family’s Bhopal estate and the Auqaf-e-Shahi trust. The wider family legacy has been estimated at more than INR10 billion, although this valuation does not represent Saba’s personal wealth.
Recalling the trust her father placed in her, Saba said, “Abba left that to me,” according to the publication.
Her responsibilities extend beyond managing the family estate. As the custodian of the Auqaf-e-Shahi trust, she oversees properties and charitable obligations associated with the family’s historical ties to Bhopal.
The trust’s assets and responsibilities include mosques and other properties, as well as facilities linked to pilgrims travelling to Makkah and Madinah. Her role involves managing these commitments while preserving the historical and charitable significance of the family’s heritage.
Saba has said that her father’s teachings continue to guide her approach to these responsibilities. She said he taught her the importance of remaining composed, treating people fairly and choosing her words carefully.
She has also described her late father as a continuing source of spiritual guidance, with his influence helping her understand the significance of the role entrusted to her.
Beyond managing the family’s assets, Saba has also discussed potential initiatives aimed at benefiting women and girls, including a school for girls and a hospital for women, according to Gulf News . However, the proposed projects remain subject to the resolution of pending legal matters involving family property, the report said.
The initiatives would add a charitable dimension to her responsibilities, which encompass not only preserving family assets but also overseeing properties and institutions connected to the Pataudi legacy.
Mansoor Ali Khan Pataudi, popularly known as Tiger Pataudi, was one of India’s prominent cricketers and captained the national team. His marriage to veteran actor Sharmila Tagore brought together two well-known families associated with Indian sport and cinema. Saba is the couple’s daughter and the sister of Saif Ali Khan and actor Soha Ali Khan.

title: Muneeb Butt urges couples to keep marital issues off social media
description: Actor says airing disputes online invites public scrutiny  encourages couples to resolve conflicts privately
content:
Actor says airing disputes online invites public scrutiny, encourages couples to resolve conflicts privately
Actor Muneeb Butt has advised couples to keep their marital issues private, warning that taking personal disputes to social media invites public scrutiny and criticism rather than helping resolve disagreements.
Speaking in an interview with Vasay Chaudhry, the actor said relationship problems should be addressed privately and respectfully instead of being made public.
“You should always keep your marital issues private and in between four walls. When you put it for the world to see, you leave people to have open opinions on your private life, and people will criticise you for entertainment,” Muneeb said.
He maintained that social media was not the solution to domestic disagreements, encouraging couples to involve their families and parents in resolving conflicts.
“I’d always say house stuff should stay inside the house. Social media doesn’t solve these things. You should sit your family together, parents together, and resolve the issue respectfully,” he added.
His remarks drew positive reactions from social media users, several of whom praised his emphasis on privacy, maturity and respectful communication in relationships.
One user described the actor as “very mature”, while another commented, “sensible statement”.
Others echoed his view that airing relationship problems publicly could make already difficult situations more complicated.
During the conversation, Muneeb also spoke about his personal life, expressing gratitude for how things had worked out for him.
“All grace to Allah for the way my life has worked out. I fell in love, got married, and we started a family. MashaAllah, I have three daughters,” he said.
The actor also emphasised the importance of maintaining a positive outlook on life and being grateful for one’s blessings.
“If you take everything positively in life, then you will always be thankful of Allah, but if you always find complaints, things won’t work out for you,” he said.
Muneeb is married to actress Aiman Khan. The couple tied the knot in 2018 and have three daughters together.

title: Momina  Fatima shine in National Women   s T20 Tournament

content:
Momina takes 4-1 as Sana's unbeaten 73 lifts Strikers to 160-8
Pakistan international and left-arm spinner Momina Riasat’s spell of four wickets for just one run helped Stars beat Invincibles by 48 runs in the seventh fixture of the National Women’s T20 Tournament at the Jawad Club in Faisalabad.
In the eighth fixture of the tournament, Fatima Sana’s unbeaten 73 and Syeda Masooma Zehra’s four-wicket haul guided Strikers to a 57-run win over Conquerors.
At the Jawad Club, batting first, Stars posted 110 for nine in their allotted 20 overs, courtesy of a 38-run knock from Samina Aftab.
Invincibles’ left-arm spinner Anosha Nasir was the most successful bowler, taking four wickets for 14 runs.
In turn, Invincibles were bundled out for 62 in 14 overs. Momina finished with impressive bowling figures of 4-1 in three overs, including two maidens. She was supported by right-arm fast bowler Diana Baig, who bagged two wickets for 15 runs.
At the Bohranwali Ground, Conquerors chasing a target of 161 were dismissed for 103 in 19.5 overs, with Strikers’ fast bowler Syeda Masooma Zehra taking four wickets for 18 runs.
Earlier, after opting to bat first, Strikers posted 160 for eight in their allotted 20 overs, courtesy of an unbeaten 73 off 48 balls from Fatima Sana. The right-handed batter’s innings featured nine fours and three sixes.
For Conquerors, Humna Bilal took three wickets, while Noreen Yaqoob grabbed two wickets.

title: Keffe D sentenced to 40 years to life for Tupac Shakur murder
description: Keffe D has been sentenced to 40 years to life for Tupac Shakur   s 1996 murder and plans to appeal his conviction
content:
Keffe D has been sentenced to 40 years to life for Tupac Shakur’s 1996 murder and plans to appeal his conviction
Duane “Keffe D” Davis has been sentenced to 40 years to life in prison for his role in the 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur, following a hearing in Las Vegas on Tuesday, October 13 2026.
Davis was convicted on August 31 2026 of murder with the use of a deadly weapon, with the intent to promote, further or assist a criminal gang. Shakur was 25 when he was fatally shot in a drive-by attack near the Las Vegas Strip.
Despite the conviction, Davis has maintained his innocence and indicated that he intends to appeal the verdict.
During the sentencing hearing, Shakur’s sister, Sekyiwa Shakur, spoke about the lasting impact of her brother’s death on their family.
She said the men in the family had never been the same since his killing and compared his legacy with influential figures including Malcolm X, Martin Luther King Jr and John F. Kennedy.
Sekyiwa questioned how history might have been different if those leaders had been killed at the age of 25, as her brother was.
Tupac’s stepbrother, Mopreme Shakur, also addressed the court, expressing sadness that the rapper never had children of his own or the chance to watch his nieces and nephews grow up.
Both family members urged the judge to impose the maximum sentence.
Prosecutors argued that Davis had continued to cause suffering for the family by profiting from Shakur’s murder through a book and media interviews.
However, defence attorney Michael Sanft challenged the prosecution’s position, arguing that authorities could have charged Davis years earlier but had not done so.
In an interview with The Hollywood Reporter following his conviction, Davis claimed he was nowhere near the scene of the shooting. He alleged that he was at a bar in West Los Angeles, near UCLA, after a Mike Tyson boxing match.
Davis now faces a sentence of 40 years to life while preparing to challenge his conviction on appeal.

Maaz hammered 50 and 96 in the first two games against Sri Lanka which benefitted him in his rise.

Farhan amassed 238 runs in three matches against Sri Lanka to move to 883 rating points, placing him behind India’s Ishan Kishan and Abhishek Sharma, who occupy the top two positions with 904 and 891 points, respectively.
Farhan’s tally against Sri Lanka surpassed the previous record for the most runs in a three-match T20I series, set by India’s Abhishek, who scored 229 against Afghanistan earlier this year.

title: Christopher Nolan   s    The Odyssey    announces 4K  Blu ray and DVD release details
description: The home release includes an IMAX prologue  trailers and a music video featuring James Blake and Travis Scott
content:
The home release includes an IMAX prologue, trailers and a music video featuring James Blake and Travis Scott
Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey is heading to home entertainment platforms, with Universal Pictures Home Entertainment announcing details of its digital, 4K Ultra HD, Blu-ray and DVD releases.
According to Forbes , the film will be available on digital platforms and physical media from November 17. The release will include 90 minutes of bonus material, offering audiences a closer look at the production of Nolan’s adaptation of Homer’s ancient Greek epic.
The additional content includes 12 behind the scenes featurettes overseen by Nolan. Titled Plotting a Course , Icons , The Widest Window , On Location , The Horse , The Fall of Troy , Ithaca , Battle Ready , Apparent Magic , The Sea People , The Score and Bringing it Home , the segments feature interviews with the director and key cast and crew members.
The 4K Ultra HD and Blu-ray editions will also contain The Journey of Film on The Odyssey , an IMAX exclusive prologue, the music video for “When I’m Home”, featuring James Blake, Travis Scott and Ludwig Göransson, and the film’s trailers.
Digital copies purchased by viewers will also include the bonus features, according to the report.
The film will be available to buy or rent through platforms including Apple TV, Fandango at Home, Prime Video and YouTube Movies & TV. The reported prices are $19.99 for digital purchase and an expected $14.99 for a 48 hour rental.
Physical editions are priced at $29.99 for 4K Ultra HD, which includes a Blu-ray copy and digital code, $24.99 for Blu-ray with a digital code, and $19.99 for DVD.
Starring Matt Damon as Odysseus, the film follows the Greek king’s dangerous journey home after the Trojan War. Anne Hathaway plays Penelope, while Tom Holland portrays their son, Telemachus. The ensemble also includes Zendaya, Charlize Theron, Lupita Nyong’o and Robert Pattinson.
The home release gives viewers the opportunity to revisit Nolan’s epic and explore how its ambitious production was brought to the screen.

title: Martinez blasts board s lack of investment
description: He questions United s summer recruitment after the club s winless run extends to five games
content:
He questions United's summer recruitment after the club's winless run extends to five games
Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez blasted the club's board for a perceived lack of investment this summer, after the team were beaten by Atletico Madrid in the Champions League on Tuesday.
United are winless in five games across all competitions after the 2-0 defeat in the Spanish capital and have made their worst start to a Premier League season in 40 years.
"Really poor," Martinez told Amazon Prime when asked about the team's performance against Atletico.
"I have to control myself a lot but sometimes is a reflection... (or) mirror of how our club is at the moment."
Martinez said he "100 percent" expected more investment in the squad during the summer after United finished third in the Premier League last season to return to Europe's top competition.
"I expect more from our technical director (Jason Wilcox), I have to be honest, as players we have to do more but it is also important when you make a strong squad to be ready for these kind of nights," he continued.
Martinez said last season the club had "created the base to create an amazing team", which was not followed through on.
Pressure is mounting on coach Michael Carrick after five games without a win but Martinez suggested sacking the Englishman was not the way forward.
"You can't keep changing, changing, changing the manager. What about other areas? I can't say more," said Martinez.
"Tonight it is easy to say the coach (is to blame), easy to say the players, but also we have to see other areas."
Red Devils minority owner Jim Ratcliffe was in the stadium to watch the league phase defeat by last season's semi-finalists.
Man United spent around 140 million pounds ($185m) this summer on midfielders Carlos Baleba, Youri Tielemans and Andrey Santos, but fans were upset the club did not reinforce in other positions, including left-back and striker.
Speaking to reporters after the game, Carrick said he had not heard Martinez's comments and so could not judge them.
"I think it's a little bit on the emotions of the game as well, of coming here and being disappointed not to get something from the game," said the coach.
Former Manchester United and England striker Wayne Rooney said Martinez's criticism was excessive.
"I think he's maybe gone a bit too far, and that should have stayed internal," Rooney told Amazon Prime.
"You can clearly see that he cares and he wants the club to invest more money in more players, and to do that he's probably one of the players who'll be out the door if I'm being honest."

title: Khawaja Asif trolled over Marilyn Monroe AI puzzle on X
description: Defence minister   s one word reply sparks jokes about his social media activity
content:
Defence minister’s one-word reply sparks jokes about his social media activity
Defence Minister Khawaja Asif became the subject of online mockery after responding with a single word to a viral image puzzle featuring Hollywood icon Marilyn Monroe wearing a modern smartwatch in a scene set in 1956.
Asif quote-posted the image on X, formerly Twitter, on Tuesday, October 13, writing simply: “Watch😊”. His brief response prompted users to poke fun at the minister for engaging with what appeared to be AI-generated engagement bait.
The image shows Monroe standing against a backdrop of vintage cars, challenging viewers to identify the detail that does not belong in 1956. The giveaway is a contemporary smartwatch on her wrist, an unmistakably modern accessory in an otherwise period setting.
The interaction quickly drew sarcastic reactions, with users questioning why the defence minister had engaged with a puzzle seemingly designed to generate clicks, comments and reposts.
Ladies and gentlemen… I present to you the defence minister of Islamic republic of Pakistan
One user, Hasan, mocked the minister's response, writing, "Ladies and gentlemen, I present to you the defence minister of Islamic republic of Pakistan".
Someone needs to take his phone away lol 😂
Another joked about the minister's social media activity, "Someone needs to take his phone away."
@grok As a Defense minister of atomic country (Pakistan) Is it okay to do this kind of post?
Another suggested that Asif had forgotten to switch accounts.
Others questioned whether the post was appropriate for a senior government official. One user tagged the AI chatbot Grok, asking whether such an interaction was suitable for the defence minister of a nuclear-armed country.
The episode highlights a familiar feature of online culture: AI-generated images that place recognisable faces in historical settings while introducing deliberately anachronistic details to encourage engagement.
For public figures, even a brief interaction with such content can attract disproportionate scrutiny. A comment that might pass unnoticed on an ordinary user's account can become a talking point when it comes from a senior government official.
In Asif's case, the response was limited to a single word and an emoji, but it was enough to trigger a wave of jokes about his social media activity and the expectations associated with his office.

title: Sage hails Palace opportunity ahead of Lyon reunion
description: He says Premier League move was too good to refuse
content:
He says Premier League move was too good to refuse
Pierre Sage has admitted in an interview with AFP that the opportunity to manage in the Premier League was one he could simply not refuse as he prepares to return to his native France with Crystal Palace this week.
Palace are in Europa League action on Thursday at Lyon, a special fixture for Sage who got his coaching break there in late 2023 and enjoyed a whirlwind 14 months in charge.
Sage, 47, has now joined a small band of Frenchmen to have managed in the Premier League, following most notably in the footsteps of legendary former Arsenal boss Arsene Wenger and the late Gerard Houllier, who was in charge at Liverpool.
"I am the 10th French coach to have worked in the Premier League and the slightly crazy thing is that I am the first to have done so without having had 100 matches as a manager," Sage said.
"Arsene Wenger and Gerard Houllier did incredible things here," he added. "When the opportunity comes along you obviously say to yourself that it might not come up again.
Sage had no top-level management experience when he was appointed Lyon coach in November 2023 by their American then-owner, John Textor -- who also formerly held a significant stake in Palace.
The seven-time former French champions were bottom of Ligue 1 and heading for relegation.
Sage transformed their fortunes so remarkably that they ended up qualifying for Europe and reaching the French Cup final.
Yet he was sacked halfway through the following campaign. There were talks with English second-flight club Queens Park Rangers that came to nothing before he bounced back in spectacular fashion last season at Lens.
Under Sage, the side from far northern France won the French Cup for the first time in their history and came second in Ligue 1 behind all-conquering Paris Saint-Germain.
Unsurprisingly his achievements attracted interest, and a new chance arose to move to England as Palace sought a successor to Oliver Glasner.
"It was a difficult decision because we had such an incredible year (at Lyon) -- historic even -- that I could sense what kind of impact it might have," he told AFP.
"But at some point you also have to think of yourself and that is what led me to my decision."
Sage, who was a goalkeeper at amateur level, worked his way up the coaching ranks to become the head of Lyon's youth academy before getting his big break.
He is learning all about the differences between French football and the Premier League, beyond the enormous financial gulf -- Palace's resources now far outstrip those of Lyon, who have fallen on harder times amid a wider economic crisis in Ligue 1.
Palace lost their first two matches under Sage, but their form has picked up since and they are fresh from beating Nottingham Forest 3-1 last weekend.
The Eagles, who won last season's Conference League, started their Europa League bid with a 4-0 victory over Poland's Lech Poznan.
"Compared to France, matches are always played at the same level of intensity by both teams," Sage said of his early impressions of the English game.
"It is very rare that a team sits back, tries to shut down the spaces and lets you play."
The very fact this fixture is being played is somewhat ironic -- Palace won the Conference League last season having been barred by UEFA from competing in the Europa League due to Textor's involvement with them and Lyon.
Lyon were allowed to play in the continent's second-tier competition, and do so again this season after falling short in the Champions League preliminary rounds.
"The first thing I dreamed of when I left Lyon was that I hadn't left at all," Sage joked as he contemplated Thursday's game.
"Being sacked is part of the job. It was more leaving Lyon that was difficult for me."
Now focused on his new life in south London, Sage is optimistic Palace can remain competitive domestically and also go far in Europe.
"With the quality we have, if we rotate the squad in the right way we can compete in both competitions," he said.

title: Cornell bans fraternity parties for rest of academic year after alleged gang rape
description: Measure is the strongest reaction yet from Cornell s leadership to lawsuit filed by former undergraduate  Jane Doe
content:
Measure is the strongest reaction yet from Cornell's leadership to lawsuit filed by former undergraduate, Jane Doe
Cornell University will ban parties and social events at fraternity houses until the ‌end of the academic year, its president said on Tuesday, responding to the outcry over an alleged gang rape on campus in 2024.
The measure is the strongest reaction yet from Cornell's leadership to a lawsuit filed by a former undergraduate, Jane Doe, saying seven men sexually assaulted her during a ​party.
Over the last several weeks, the Ivy League school in Ithaca, New York, and its president, Michael Kotlikoff, have ​come under heavy criticism from students, faculty and donors over its response to the allegations.
The suspension of ⁠parties and social events will apply to Interfraternity Council houses. The council website says Cornell currently has 34 fraternity houses.
"These measures will ​provide time for a thorough review of fraternity life at Cornell to determine whether and how it can safely continue," Kotlikoff ​said in the statement.
The Cornell Interfraternity Council did not immediately reply to a request for comment.
Read: Cornell president vows 'serious look' at fraternities, sororities in wake of rape allegations
Prosecutors reopened the investigation into the alleged gang rape after the lawsuit was filed. New York state Governor Kathy Hochul appointed New York Attorney General Letitia James as an independent special prosecutor in the case, ​citing the earlier failure to protect the alleged victim.
President Donald Trump repeated on Tuesday his call to take James, his longtime ​critic and an elected Democrat, off the case.
"The Governor should take James off this case, immediately," Trump posted on Truth Social.
Trump first questioned James' ‌appointment ⁠in early October, but his comments did not prompt any action by officials. The offices of Hochul and the attorney general did not immediately reply to requests for comment.
Since the lawsuit against seven fraternity members, the university and others was filed in September, the Cornell administration has faced student protests, a pending no-confidence resolution from faculty, criticism by alumni and a public assembly where students blamed ​university officials for tolerating what they ​described as a culture of ⁠sexual violence.
None of the men named in the lawsuit has been criminally charged.
"I have spent the past weeks listening to students, faculty, staff, parents, alumni, and trustees, who have shared their feelings ​of deep connection and sympathy with Jane Doe, anger and frustration that this could happen ​at Cornell," Kotlikoff ⁠said.
Read more: NY governor vows to close intoxication rape loophole at Cornell University
"Women on our campus continue to question whether they are safe," he said, adding that additional staff would be hired to support survivors of sexual assault.
Cornell will also work with New York State Police to investigate incidents, he said, and accelerate previous recommendations put forward by a ⁠task force ​on sexual violence.
35% of undergraduate women reported experiencing non-consensual sexual contact ​involving force or incapacitation since entering Cornell, according to a university survey conducted in 2025 and published on its website.
"We must meet this moment by acknowledging where ​we have fallen short and taking meaningful action," Kotlikoff said.

title: Paul McCartney reveals what filmmakers keep getting wrong about the Beatles in new interview
description: McCartney also raised concerns about the upcoming four part Beatles biopic series directed by Sam Mendes
content:
McCartney also raised concerns about the upcoming four-part Beatles biopic series directed by Sam Mendes
Paul McCartney has criticised filmmakers for inaccurately portraying the Beatles’ heights, revealing that the issue remains a personal frustration decades after the band’s heyday.
Speaking on the latest episode of Good Hang with Amy Poehler , the 84-year-old musician explained that the four band members were almost the same height, apart from Ringo Starr, who was slightly shorter.
“We were all the same height,” McCartney said, adding, “And if you look at photos, we’re all the same height.”
The conversation turned to Sam Taylor-Johnson’s 2009 film Nowhere Boy , which depicted a teenage John Lennon as noticeably bigger than McCartney.
The singer recalled objecting to the portrayal, saying his character appeared “wimpy” and was knocked to the floor by Lennon.
“And it’s like, ‘Sam, this is not true!’,” McCartney recalled telling the director. He said Taylor-Johnson responded that “this is a movie, it’s not a documentary”, an explanation he was unhappy with.
McCartney also raised concerns about the upcoming four-part Beatles biopic series directed by Sam Mendes. Paul Mescal is set to portray McCartney, while Harris Dickinson plays Lennon.
Discussing a still from the production recreating the Beatles’ famous Abbey Road photograph, McCartney said his character appeared noticeably shorter than Lennon.
“So I texted him, ‘Sam! Smaller! Don’t do this! You said you wouldn’t do it!,” McCartney said, describing his message to Mendes.
Mendes later reportedly sent another image showing the two characters at equal heights.

title: Critical Role announces canon miniseries with Hololive VTubers
description: Critical Role and Hololive will launch  Shattered Legends   canon Exandria miniseries using Daggerheart RPG
content:
Critical Role and Hololive will launch 'Shattered Legends', canon Exandria miniseries using Daggerheart RPG
Critical Role is partnering with Japanese virtual YouTuber agency Hololive Production for Shattered Legends, a new actual play miniseries set in the world of Exandria.
The series is scheduled to premiere in mid-November 2026 on YouTube and Critical Role’s streaming platform, Beacon.
According to the announcement, Shattered Legends will be canon to Exandria, the setting of Critical Role’s first three campaigns: Vox Machina, The Mighty Nein and Bells Hells. This means the miniseries could feature connections to established characters from those adventures.
Unlike the main campaigns, Shattered Legends will use Daggerheart, the tabletop role-playing game published by Critical Role’s publishing arm, Darrington Press.
Critical Role co-founder Matthew Mercer will serve as Game Master, while fellow co-founder Marisha Ray will join the players. She will be accompanied by four Hololive talents: Nerissa Ravencroft, Mori Calliope, Shiori Novella and Gig Murin.
The production will bring together in-person actual play and digital avatars, although details of how the two formats will be integrated have not yet been confirmed.
Viewers will be able to watch episodes on Beacon, with additional content including a “Session Zero” covering character creation and backstories, as well as post-episode “Cooldown” discussions.
Episodes will also be published on the official YouTube channels of Critical Role, Nerissa Ravencroft and Hololive English.
The collaboration will extend beyond the series itself. Critical Role and Hololive have plans for a promotional tour at conventions across North America, Europe and Asia, alongside exclusive merchandise and other collaborations. Further details are expected to be announced later.
Shattered Legends follows Age of Umbra: Sallowlands as another project featuring Daggerheart. The series is expected to debut in mid-November 2026 on Beacon and YouTube.

title: Bilawal offers to approach PM for ending K P emergency if PTI agrees to political dialogue
description: Accuses PTI of carrying out  political suicide attack  on its own government in K P
content:
Accuses PTI of carrying out 'political suicide attack' on its own government in K-P
Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari on Wednesday renewed his call for dialogue with Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), saying he would personally request Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif to end the emergency in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) if political conditions were created that made the measure unnecessary.
“Even today, I invite you to come and hold talks with the government and political parties and create conditions in which there will be no need for this emergency in K-P. If you create these political conditions. I will personally stand in this House and request the prime minister that the time has come to end this emergency,” said Bilawal while addressing the National Assembly (NA).
Bilawal maintained that the federal government had made every possible political effort to engage the opposition before taking the constitutional step, saying that the opposition had every right to speak against the decision and oppose it, but argued that PTI could not deny its own role in creating the political, legal and constitutional circumstances that led to the situation.
The PPP chairman accused PTI of carrying out a “political suicide attack” on its own government in K-P, adding that opposition leaders could blame the federal government or President Asif Ali Zardari for the loss of their provincial government, but maintained that PTI, particularly its provincial leadership, had played a significant role in creating the circumstances.
حکومت پاکستان نے ہر ممکن سیاسی کوشش کی، اپوزیشن کو انگیج کیا تاکہ ایمرجنسی کا قدم نہ اٹھایا جائے، اپوزیشن کا حق ہے کہ وہ اس قدم کی مخالفت کریں لیکن یہ بات انہیں ماننی پڑے گی۔ اپوزیشن کی ذمہ دارانہ قیادت یہ جانتی ہے کہ خیبرپختونخوا کی حکومت پر پی ٹی آئی نے خود ایک سیاسی خودکش حملہ… pic.twitter.com/Y4KBZS5KNU
He said responsible figures within the opposition were aware of these circumstances, even if they were unwilling to acknowledge them publicly. He argued that if the federal government had concluded that K-P was facing war-like conditions and that its internal situation prevented an effective response to terrorism, the provincial government should have provided political, legal or constitutional grounds for rejecting the proposed measure.
Read: Govt tables resolution in NA seeking endorsement of K-P emergency
The PPP chairman questioned why PTI's provincial leadership had failed to provide any justification that would have allowed President Zardari or the PPP to oppose the decision.
Bilawal said that when the proposal first came before the president and the PPP, their position was that the government should engage PTI and the opposition before resorting to what he described as a “constitutional atom bomb”. He said the objective was to address the federal government's objections and allegations that the provincial government was not cooperating in the fight against terrorism, thereby removing any legal, constitutional or political justification for taking the step.
He said two representatives of his party, including its parliamentary leader in the Senate, had participated in the committee negotiating with the opposition. Referring to previous experiences of political negotiations, Bilawal said he had initially been uncertain whether the talks would succeed.
However, he said he was informed late one night that negotiations were moving towards success and that PTI and the opposition were likely to agree on measures to address terrorism in K-P.
According to Bilawal, the proposed understanding included the provincial government declaring the areas most severely affected by terrorism as terrorist-affected areas. He said the opposition had also agreed in principle that the federal government, provincial government and K-P chief minister would prepare an agreement outlining how they would jointly combat terrorism.
Bilawal said he had regarded the development as a major political achievement, believing that the government, its allies and the opposition could work together on an issue of national importance. The PPP chairman also stressed the importance of protecting political space for all parties.
دہشتگردی کے خلاف جنگ میں وفاقی اور صوبائی حکومتوں کا مشترکہ لائحہ عمل وقت کی اہم ضرورت ہے۔ سیاسی اختلافات سے بالاتر ہو کر قومی سلامتی اور عوام کے تحفظ کے لیے مل کر آگے بڑھنا ہی حقیقی سیاسی کامیابی ہے۔ چیئرمین پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی بلاول بھٹو زرداری کا مؤقف ہے کہ سیاسی اسپیس کی… pic.twitter.com/u18DpxJrI5
He said restricting the political space of one party inevitably affected other political parties, political groups and ordinary Pakistani citizens. Bilawal acknowledged that the PPP and other political parties shared responsibility for the shrinking political space, but maintained that PTI could not deny its own role.
Referring to the security situation, he said K-P was the province most affected by terrorism, while tensions with Afghanistan had created additional challenges. Bilawal criticised the non-functional K-P chief minister for taking an oath from supporters not to cooperate with the federal government's efforts against terrorism.
He questioned whether such conduct amounted to political suicide and said the PPP, whose leaders and workers had sacrificed their lives in the fight against terrorism, had no justification for opposing measures intended to address the security threat.
Read more: Opp calls K-P emergency 'pre-planned'
Bilawal also referred to President Zardari's role in restoring the 1973 Constitution and introducing the 18th Amendment, arguing that the opposition had failed to provide him with a constitutional, legal or political reason to reject the proposed measure. Bilawal maintained that the statements and actions of PTI's provincial leadership had left the president, the government and the PPP with no grounds to oppose the step.
However, he stressed that the emergency was a temporary measure and could not continue indefinitely, adding that the decision had been necessary under the prevailing circumstances, but acknowledged that an emergency alone could not provide a permanent solution to terrorism.
Bilawal argued that even if the previous system had failed to cooperate in counter-terrorism efforts, lasting success would require a broader and more effective approach. He said eliminating terrorism from Khyber to Khuzdar required cooperation across the country and urged the opposition to fulfil its responsibilities in the fight against terrorists.
The PPP chairman described the current terrorism challenge as more complicated than in the past.
Referring to Pakistan's recent military confrontation with India, Bilawal said that Pakistan had inflicted a historic defeat on India, including shooting down six aircraft. He said that India had not accepted the outcome and continued to seek ways to destabilise Pakistan.

title: Joni Mitchell becomes a US citizen 62 years after beginning the process
description: The 82 year old Grammy winning singer announced the news with a photo of herself waving a small American flag
content:
The 82-year-old Grammy-winning singer announced the news with a photo of herself waving a small American flag
Joni Mitchell has officially become a US citizen, marking a significant milestone more than six decades after she first began the process.
The 82-year-old Grammy-winning singer-songwriter announced the news on Tuesday, October 13, sharing a photograph of herself smiling and waving a small American flag on Instagram.
“A journey that began 62 years ago,” Mitchell wrote alongside the image. She also posted a short video capturing the moment her name was called, making her American citizenship official.
Born in Canada, Mitchell first travelled to the United States in 1965 with her former husband, Chuck Mitchell. The couple lived in Detroit for several years before she briefly moved to New York City.
By the late 1960s, Mitchell had settled in Southern California, where she continues to live. Despite her long-standing connection to the United States, she has maintained ties to her Canadian roots.
In a 2006 interview with the Ottawa Observer , Mitchell described Los Angeles as her “workplace” and British Columbia as her “heartbeat”, reflecting the importance of both places in her life.
The singer returned to Canada in March 2026 for the Juno Awards, where she accepted a Lifetime Achievement Award. It marked her first visit to the country in “many, many years”, according to Just Jared.
Mitchell, renowned for songs including “Big Yellow Taxi”, also attracted attention earlier this year during the 2026 Grammy Awards, when a moment from her acceptance speech went viral.
Her citizenship announcement now adds another notable chapter to the celebrated musician’s life and career.

title: PSX recovers on late buying  gains 641 points
description: Late session buying lifts benchmark as index heavy stocks support recovery
content:
Late-session buying lifts benchmark as index-heavy stocks support recovery
The Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) staged a sound recovery on Wednesday as renewed buying towards the close lifted the benchmark index firmly into positive territory, reversing the previous session’s trend after volatile trading amid domestic political uncertainty and rising international oil prices.
The KSE-100 index gained 641.07 points, or 0.39%, to settle at 165,417.51. It touched an intraday high of 165,629.35 and a low of 164,060.34.
Earlier, the market had opened on a cautious note, with the index rising to 165,032.13, gaining 255.69 points, or 0.16%, by 9:33am. However, fluctuations soon pushed the benchmark into negative territory, with the index slipping to 164,770.12 at 12:38pm, down 6.32 points from the previous close.
Sentiment remained subdued amid political uncertainty following the reported imposition of governor’s rule and an emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (K-P).
Selling pressure was visible across automobile assemblers, cement, commercial banks, oil and gas exploration companies, power generation, refineries and oil marketing companies.
However, renewed buying in index-heavy stocks, particularly across banking, oil and gas, and power sectors, supported the benchmark’s recovery and helped it close firmly in positive territory.
Internationally, oil prices climbed on Wednesday after two vessels were struck in the Strait of Hormuz and Iranian officials announced new tactics to target ships, as Tehran seeks to keep oil prices high and influence the US midterm elections.
Brent crude futures rose 34 cents, or 0.3%, to $106.03 a barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate crude futures gained 28 cents, or 0.3%, to $94.42 a barrel. Both contracts had climbed by more than $1 in early trade.
KTrade Secuities wrote in its market wrap that the KSE-100 index gained 641 points (+0.4%) to close at 165,418, as oil prices remained stable near $106/barrel and the absence of fresh negative news improved investor sentiment. Despite early gains and subsequent profit-taking, renewed buying towards the close helped the market recover and finish firmly in the green, reversing yesterday's trend.
Sectoral support came from commercial banks, investment banks, cement, fertiliser and refinery stocks, with Engro Holdings, Lucky Cement, Fauji Fertiliser, Bank AL Habib and NBP among the key contributors. Meanwhile, Cnergyico, K-Electric, Bank of Punjab and TRG Pakistan led individual stock volumes, with total turnover remaining subdued at around 150 million shares. Despite the positive close, low volumes reflect continued caution amid elevated oil prices, geopolitical uncertainty and currency concerns. Sustained buying and improving turnover remain crucial for the market to maintain its upward momentum, KTrade added.
Overall, trading volume jumped to 585.8 million shares against Tuesday’s total of 383.7 million. The value of trade shares stood at Rs20 billion. Shares of 501 companies were traded in the ready market. Of these 256 rose, 200 fell and 45 remained unchanged. WorldCall Telecom was the volume leader with trading in 87.4 million shares, staying static at Rs0.96.

title: RuneScape  Dragonwilds plans multiple sagas as player count nears 3m

content:
RuneScape: Dragonwilds has attracted nearly three million unique players, with Jagex planning years of updates
Jagex has confirmed plans for multiple future sagas for RuneScape: Dragonwilds, with the survival-crafting game approaching three million unique players and a multi-year support plan in development.
Speaking to WCCFTech at RuneFest, Executive Producer Jesse America and Creative Director Rick Turek confirmed that the studio intends to continue expanding the game beyond its currently announced content.
“There is a string of sagas planned, and we’re committed to the game for the long haul,” the developers said. With each saga expected to deliver approximately a year of content, the plans could extend support well beyond 2027, although Jagex has not confirmed an end date.
The developers also revealed that “close to three million people have played the game now—unique players”. The figure includes players across its available platforms and subscription services rather than representing direct sales alone.
RuneScape: Dragonwilds launched in early access in 2025 before reaching version 1.0 and expanding to consoles. Its full release also brought the game to Xbox Game Pass and higher PlayStation Plus subscription tiers.
Jagex said the game's performance on these services has exceeded expectations. “Sony and Microsoft are extremely happy with results and interaction with RuneScape: Dragonwilds,” the developers said. “Higher than what they normally see.”
The studio also revealed that its audience has broadened since early access. Initially, approximately 85% of players were active RuneScape users, but that balance has since moved towards an even split between existing fans and newcomers.
Jagex is also partnering with CurseForge to make mod installation more accessible. The planned system will allow players to discover and install mods through an integrated browser and installer, with the developers confirming that “There will be oversight”.
The upcoming Blood Crystal Saga is scheduled for 2027, while further sagas are already in development.

The story has resurfaced as Clarkson faces a separate dispute with Brooklyn store Art of Play
Kelly Clarkson’s recent dispute with a Brooklyn store has brought renewed attention to the time the singer purchased a treasured ring belonging to celebrated English novelist Jane Austen, only for the UK government to intervene.
In 2012, Clarkson paid £152,450 for the turquoise-and-gold ring at Sotheby’s, reportedly outbidding Jane Austen’s House Museum.
The rare item had remained within Austen’s family following her death in 1817, aged 41, and was one of only three known pieces of jewellery belonging to the author.
According to the BBC , the UK’s culture minister at the time, Ed Vaizey, imposed a temporary export ban, hoping the “national treasure” could be “saved for the nation.”
The museum subsequently launched its Bring the Ring Home campaign, raising £157,740 through donations, including an anonymous contribution of £100,000.
Clarkson agreed to sell the ring back to the museum.
“The ring is a beautiful national treasure and I am happy to know that so many Jane Austen fans will get to see it at Jane Austen’s House Museum,” Clarkson said in a statement at the time, according to Billboard .

A relatively early PC launch could give players another option beyond consoles, including those considering whether to purchase a PlayStation 5 Pro for the game. However, the experience on PC would depend on players having hardware powerful enough to run the title.
A PC version could also become an important platform for the Grand Theft Auto roleplaying community. The PC edition of GTA 5 has supported a popular roleplaying scene.
The game is scheduled to launch on consoles on November 19 2026. A PC release in early 2027 would follow only a few months later, marking a shorter potential gap than the studio’s previous major releases.

content:
Bavuma backs his players to respond after a 214-run defeat in the series opener
South Africa captain Temba Bavuma says fast bowler Kagiso Rabada is likely to return for the second Test against Australia on Sunday after recovering from a hamstring injury.
Rabada has not played since featuring for Gujarat Titans in the Indian Premier League in May and missed the opening Test in Durban as a precaution while recovering from the injury sustained in training.
The 31-year-old is making progress towards a competitive return, with Bavuma encouraged by the paceman’s condition ahead of the second match in Gqeberha.
“KG (Rabada) looks good,” Bavuma said after South Africa’s 214-run defeat in the first Test.
“I think SuperSport kept showing him on the big screen bowling during breaks in play.
“He’s bubbly as ever within the changing room. And his non-selection was more from a precautionary point of view to give him the extra couple of days.
“So now he’s got the extra couple of days. We’ll see how he continues to improve. But KG is very good.”
Rabada’s return could put fellow fast bowler Anrich Nortje under pressure to make way, despite his successful comeback to Test cricket in Durban.
South Africa may also consider changes after several batters struggled in the opening match. Ryan Rickelton failed to reach double figures in either innings, while Tristan Stubbs and wicketkeeper Kyle Verreynne also endured difficult outings.
Fast bowlers Gerald Coetzee, Corbin Bosch and Dane Paterson are among the alternatives available to the hosts. Uncapped batter Marques Ackermann and bowling all-rounder Senuran Muthusamy, who did not feature in the first Test, could also come into contention.
However, Bavuma indicated that wholesale changes were unlikely, insisting the team retained confidence in the players who took the field in Durban.
“The guys that you saw who took the field are guys that we have full confidence in,” he said.
“Going forward, there’s going to be conversations that need to happen. Guys understand that’s just how professional, high-level sport goes. If you’re not delivering the goods and if there is someone else who’s waiting in the wings, they’ll get that opportunity.”
Bavuma admitted the defeat had been disappointing but said the team needed to address its shortcomings before the series moved to Gqeberha.
“It’s not the way you want to start a series, any kind of series, let alone just against a top outfit like Australia,” he said.
“The emotions are obviously still a little bit high. You probably want that to settle before you get into the conversations but there are obvious things that we could definitely improve on. No one is happy in that change-room, looking at the result that has played out.”

title: Yamal inspires Barcelona past Galatasaray
description: The Catalans win 4 1 in Istanbul
content:
Barcelona and Lamine Yamal rediscovered their sparkle after a rocky first-half spell in the cauldron of Istanbul's Ali Sami Yen stadium to win 4-1 away to Galatasaray in the Champions League on Tuesday.
Yamal tore the hosts apart after half time.
"It's incredible to have players like that," said Barcelona coach Hansi Flick. "He's turned the game around for us."
Halfway through the second round of matches, the victory lifted Barcelona to the top of the Champions League table with two wins. Galatasaray are pointless and near the foot of the standings.
"We're at a very high level. We have to keep going; the season is very long. We can't relax," Barcelona's Fermin Lopez told Spanish broadcaster Movistar.
Barcelona dominated the early stages. With Yamal vigorously policed on the right by the home defence, many of their attacks flowed through Anthony Gordon on the other flank.
Yet Galatasaray took the lead after 27 minutes. After Gordon went tumbling in the penalty box, the hosts launched a rapid counter-attack through Rafael Leao on the left.
He pulled the ball back to the edge of the area to Russian Aleksei Batrakov whose drive deflected off Joao Cancelo and into the corner of the goal.
"That goal made things a bit strange for us, because we had been dominating. But we knew how to react and come back," said Fermin.
That ignited a spell of furious home pressure which culminated with Victor Osimhen rising to head a corner past goalkeeper Joan Garcia. Baris Yilmaz toed the ball over the line but was ruled offside.
Barcelona reasserted control. When Yamal went down on the edge of the box, the ball broke to a surprised Davinson Sanchez who gave the ball away immediately. It fell to Dani Olmo who threaded a pass to Cancelo who scored.
At the start of the second half Yamal took over. After setting up Gordon, who spurned the chance, he helped put Barca ahead in the 50th minute, placing a gentle curled cross on the forehead of Fermin who nodded home.
"He's a friend and a great team-mate," said Fermin of Yamal. "When he has the ball, I always look for a run. He's the best in the world. We get along well off the field, and that shows on the pitch, too."
Three minutes later, Yamal beat Eren Elmali three times, and in three different ways, in a tiny space before rolling a pass to Gordon in front of goal.
This time the England striker made no mistake with Elmali, a Turkey international, lifting his arms to the heavens in an expression of powerlessness.
After 65 minutes Yamal cut in from his wing and fired a pass to replacement centre forward Gabriel Jesus. The ex-Arsenal man could not control the ball but it deflected to Karim Adeyemi who drilled the ball home.
"When you see the chances Lamine creates in every training session, it's the same in matches," said Flick. "I have a lot of top-quality players. Everyone's watching Lamine – that's only natural."
Yamal could have scored himself but after being quickest to a loose ball he fired his shot over the bar.
The 19-year-old finished the game without a goal which would have taken him closer to Kylian Mbappe's record for Champions League goals as a teenager, but Yamal, who became Barcelona's youngest ever captain in the previous round, again took over the captain's armband when Pedri was replaced.
