title: PM Shehbaz emphasises need for  safe  orderly migration  in meeting with EU commissioner
description: Brunner praises FIA s professionalism  says decline in illegal migration will help open pathways for legal migration
content:
Brunner praises FIA's professionalism, says decline in illegal migration will help open pathways for legal migration
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Tuesday emphasised the need to complement efforts to curb irregular migration with practical opportunities for "safe, orderly and regular migration" during a meeting with European Union (EU) Commissioner for Internal Affairs and Migration Magnus Brunner.
The meeting focused on strengthening Pakistan-EU cooperation in the areas of migration and mobility, one of the eight pillars of the Pakistan-EU Strategic Engagement Plan 2019, the Prime Minister's Office (PMO) said in a press release.
Welcoming Commissioner Brunner on his first visit to Pakistan, the prime minister highlighted Pakistan’s sustained efforts to curb irregular migration and combat migrant smuggling and human trafficking through legislative reforms, institutional strengthening, effective enforcement, and international cooperation.
Read : Talal Chaudhry says Pakistan's illegal migration strategy model for world
Mr. Magnus Brunner, European Union Commissioner for Internal Affairs and Migration, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif in Islamabad today. The meeting focused on strengthening Pakistan-EU cooperation in the areas of migration and mobility, one of the eight pillars… pic.twitter.com/YLrWKJifqP
The premier underscored the importance Pakistan attached to its partnership with the EU and reaffirmed its commitment to further strengthening cooperation across all pillars of the Pak-EU Strategic Engagement Plan.
He noted that expanding legal pathways for Pakistani skilled workers and professionals would help meet the labour-market needs of European countries while reducing the vulnerability of prospective migrants to smuggling networks.
Brunner appreciated the measures taken and the cooperation extended by the government of Pakistan.
Honoured to meet Prime Minister @CMShehbaz today. The EU remains committed to a forward-looking partnership with Pakistan, grounded in mutual benefit. We discussed migration, security and trade, and how to deepen cooperation. pic.twitter.com/hOeByhdXnz
He expressed confidence that these efforts would contribute positively to the expansion of legal migration pathways and the promotion of mutually beneficial labour mobility between Pakistan and the EU.
President Zardari calls for structured EU cooperation, legal mobility for Pakistani professionals
Meanwhile, President Asif Ali Zardari called for greater opportunities for legal migration of Pakistani workers and professionals in Europe in his meeting with Brunner at Aiwan-e-Sadr.
The president stressed that Pakistan’s sustained efforts to curb irregular migration should be matched by expanded legal pathways, skills-based mobility and structured cooperation with the EU, the Presidency said in a post on X.
1/2 President calls for greater opportunities for legal migration for Pakistani workers and professionals in Europe President Asif Ali Zardari has called for greater opportunities for legal migration for Pakistani workers and professionals in Europe, stressing that Pakistan’s… pic.twitter.com/N04dsDZfTK
The president said Pakistan attached great importance to its broad-based cooperation with the European Union and remains committed to implementing the Pakistan-EU Strategic Engagement Plan.
President Zardari highlighted Pakistan’s cooperation with the EU in curbing irregular migration, noting that Pakistan continued to implement the EU Readmission Agreement and had readmitted more than 30,000 individuals over the years.
He noted that Pakistan remained committed to combating human trafficking and irregular migration through stronger legislation, institutional capacity, border controls and international cooperation.
Referring to the progress made in reducing irregular migration, the president underlined that, according to EU figures, irregular migration from Pakistan reduced by 64% in the last eighteen months, making Pakistan the only country in the region to achieve such a reduction.
He said this progress reflected Pakistan’s sustained efforts and underlined the importance of expanding safe and legal avenues for migration.
The president emphasised that legal migration pathways were essential to providing safe opportunities for workers and reducing reliance on smuggling networks.
He highlighted the Pakistan-EU Migration and Mobility Dialogue as a useful framework for matching Pakistan’s human-resource potential with European labour-market needs and expressed the hope that the next round of dialogue, expected to take place in Brussels early next year, would advance this cooperation.
President Zardari also welcomed the expansion of the EU Talent Partnerships framework and called for greater opportunities for skilled workers and professionals, including through circular migration.
2/2 President Zardari also welcomed the expansion of the EU Talent Partnerships framework and called for greater opportunities for skilled workers and professionals, including through circular migration. He said Pakistan is ready to work with the EU on a structured mechanism to…
He said Pakistan was ready to work with the EU on a structured mechanism to match its workforce with European labour-market requirements and expressed the hope that the EU would consider establishing a European Legal Gateway Office in Pakistan, given the existing Talent Partnership and the country’s efforts to curb irregular migration.
The president said Pakistan and the EU had a broad-based relationship spanning political dialogue, trade, development cooperation and other areas of mutual interest. He expressed confidence that continued engagement would strengthen mutual understanding and help advance practical cooperation on migration and mobility.
Brunner appreciated Pakistan’s role in maintaining the regional balance and said Pakistan had done an amazing job in this regard.
He also commended Pakistan’s efforts to prevent irregular migrants from undertaking dangerous journeys that cost many of them their lives.
Dar, EU Commissioner discuss expanding legal migration opportunities for Pakistanis
Meanwhile, Deputy PM and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar discussed ways to strengthen Pakistan-European Union cooperation on migration and mobility with Brunner.
The deputy prime minister expressed satisfaction over the positive momentum in Pakistan-EU relations, recalling recent engagements between the two sides, whereas the discussions focused on enhancing cooperation on migration and mobility, a key pillar of the Pakistan-EU Strategic Engagement Plan (2019).
He highlighted Pakistan’s efforts to curb irregular migration and combat migrant smuggling and human trafficking. He stressed that these measures should be complemented by increased opportunities for legal migration for Pakistani skilled workers and professionals.
Commissioner Brunner appreciated Pakistan’s progress in curbing irregular migration and acknowledged the scope for expanding legal migration pathways.
The deputy prime minister reaffirmed Pakistan’s commitment to further strengthening its partnership with the European Union and expressed hope that the commissioner’s visit would lead to practical outcomes beneficial to both sides.
Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 met European Commissioner for Internal Affairs and Migration Mr. Magnus Brunner in Islamabad today. Recalling recent engagements between Pakistan and the European Union, the DPM/FM expressed… pic.twitter.com/Q6MNGDyLQH
Naqvi, EU commissioner agree to strengthen cooperation
Separately, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi also met Brunner to discuss cooperation on migration, border management and legal employment opportunities, following a 64% decline in illegal migration from Pakistan to Europe.
The two leaders also held delegation-level talks during the meeting, where Brunner appreciated Pakistan’s measures against illegal migration and acknowledged the performance of the Federal Investigation Agency (FIA).
وفاقی وزیرداخلہ محسن نقوی سے یورپین کمشنر برائے داخلی امور و مائیگریشن @magnusbrunner کی ملاقات دونوں رہنماؤں کے درمیان وفود کی سطح پربھی مذاکرات ہوئے یورپین کمشنر برائے داخلہ امور و مائیگریشن نے غیر قانونی مائیگریشن کے خلاف پاکستان کے اقدامات کو سراہا pic.twitter.com/lHaDXUtR6O
Brunner said the 64% reduction in illegal migration to Europe, achieved through Pakistan’s effective measures, was commendable. He also praised the FIA for demonstrating professional capabilities despite limited resources.

پاکستان کے مؤثر اقدامات کے باعث یورپ کی جانب غیر قانونی مائیگریشن میں 64 فیصد کمی قابل ستائش ہے ، ایف آئی اے نے کم وسائل کے باوجود پیشہ وارانہ صلاحیت کا مظاہرہ کیا جو قابل تحسین ہے
He said the decline in illegal migration would help open pathways for legal migration.
Naqvi further stated Pakistan had adopted a zero-tolerance policy against illegal migration, adding that after reducing illegal migration by 64 per cent, Pakistan’s next target was to eliminate it completely.
Naqvi said Pakistan and the EU needed to work together to end illegal migration while describing the issue as a highly serious global challenge.
During the meeting, both sides discussed promoting legal migration between Pakistan and the EU, strengthening border security and expanding opportunities for skilled workers.
Excellent meeting with Interior Minister @MohsinnaqviC42 in Islamabad today. Thank you for the kind invitation and your warm hospitality. We discussed joint action to tackle illegal migration, strengthen border management and enhance our efforts against terrorism. pic.twitter.com/hWZWjTRKgy
The two sides also agreed to work together on the EU’s Eastern Corridor Initiative to eliminate illegal migration.
The meeting further discussed expanding cooperation to enhance the operational capacity of the Pakistan Coast Guard.
Brunner assured Pakistan of all possible cooperation in this regard.

title: Pope Leo admitted to Rome hospital for lung surgery
description: Vatican says recovery is expected to take about a week  all public events of Pope Leo cancelled until October 20
content:
Vatican says recovery is expected to take about a week, all public events of Pope Leo cancelled until October 20
Pope Leo will ‌have surgery at Rome's Gemelli Hospital on Tuesday afternoon to remove a small growth on one of his lungs, in the first major health issue of his 17-month tenure.
Leo, 71, said on Sunday that the growth, a small nodule, was found during a recent check-up and was "well-contained" and spotted early.
The Vatican confirmed the timing of the surgery after Leo was seen heading into ​Rome in a convoy of vehicles driving toward Gemelli Hospital, about nine kilometres ⁠north of the Vatican.
Read : Pope Leo to be operated in 'coming days'
The pope waved from a black SUV as he left the Vatican.
NOW: Pope Leo XIV arrives at Gemelli Hospital ahead of his lung operation, as a cheering crowd greets him outside. The pope smiled and gave a brief wave as he stepped out of his car before greeting doctors. Pope Leo is set to undergo surgery later in the day to remove a lung… pic.twitter.com/mnwNcGEJhe
Upon arrival at the hospital, ​Leo shook hands with several officials, walked in front of a waiting crowd of well-wishers, some of whom shouted 'Auguri' (best ​wishes), and headed in via the main entrance.
The Vatican has said his recovery is expected to take about a week. All his public events have been cancelled until October 20.
Leo, elected by the world's cardinals in May 2025, is relatively ​young for a Church leader. He enjoys sports, including tennis, and is not known to be a smoker ​or to have had health issues previously.
A nodule on the lung is a small, localised lesion that can be benign. The American ‌Thoracic ⁠Society says fewer than 5% of lung nodules overall prove cancerous, although risk rises with age, size, and other factors such as smoking.
Dr Federico Venuto, chief of thoracic surgery at Rome's Policlinico Umberto I Hospital, said procedures to remove lung nodules are usually minimally invasive, and can sometimes involve use of a thin camera tube called a thoracoscope.
"The complication ​rate is extremely low," he ​told Reuters .
The ⁠late Pope Francis, Leo's predecessor, was hospitalised several times as he grew frail in his later years. He died aged 88 in April 2025.
Leo, who spoke in a firm, clear voice ​at his only public event on Monday, keeps a very busy schedule. He is ​due to make ⁠an 11-day tour of Uruguay, Argentina and Peru from November 6 to 17.
In the same address on Sunday, when the pope announced his need for surgery, he said he would go ahead with the trip .
The pope is the ultimate earthly authority for the ⁠world's 1.4 billion ​Catholics and does not have a deputy who steps in when ​he is sick. When a pope is incapacitated, the business of the Vatican's vast bureaucracy carries on as usual, holding off on any decisions ​that require papal approval.

title: AI models may soon self replicate without access to data centers  Anthropic warns
description: AI models with under 30 billion parameters could replicate  but struggled to complete the entire process
content:
AI models with under 30 billion parameters could replicate, but struggled to complete the entire process
In its experiments, Anthropic looked at whether AI models could find vulnerable devices, copy themselves into those devices, ​and continue spreading without human help.
It found that small ​models under 30 billion parameters could complete the many ⁠steps needed for replication.
However, the firm found that such AI ​models also struggled to complete the entire sequence from start ​to finish.
In its simplified tests, where some security steps were removed, Anthropic found that GLM-5.2 and stronger models were capable of end-to-end replication.
Replicating models ​would be hard to shut down as there is no ​central switch-off point and, unlike non-AI malware, they could also figure out ‌unfamiliar ⁠devices on their own, targeting data center processors, Anthropic warned.
Read More: Microsoft plans huge deployment of its own AI chips, with an eye on saving costs
The firm focused on IoT devices like Android TVs, smart appliances, and other internet-connected gadgets in its research as these are typically ​poorly secured.
The AI ​major also ⁠warned that if small models improved at their historical rate, they would be able to ​autonomously replicate by the end of this year, ​with small ⁠weight-based replicators following suit soon after.
Anthropic also said such autonomous AI systems were likely to replicate slowly and rely on widely ⁠available, ​relatively insecure computing resources. It added ​that systems should be strengthened to make it harder for such AI agents ​to spread.

title: NASA s Perseverance rover breaks record for off planet driving on Mars
description: NASA s Perseverance rover has travelled 45 2 km on Mars  surpassing the distance record set by Opportunity
content:
NASA's Perseverance rover has travelled 45.2 km on Mars, surpassing the distance record set by Opportunity
While no person has ever set foot on Mars, humankind has managed to ​conduct extensive explorations of the surface of Earth's planetary neighbor using robotic rovers. One of them, NASA's six-wheeled Perseverance rover , has now set a record for the ‌longest distance driven by any vehicle on a world beyond Earth.
The US space agency has announced that the car-sized Perseverance has trekked 28.1 miles (45.2 km) since arriving on Mars roughly 5-1/2 years ago, passing the distance mark previously established by another NASA rover, Opportunity, from 2004 to 2018. Perseverance and Opportunity both also beat the driving distances of any rover that operated on the moon.
Perseverance, carrying a suite of scientific instruments, has searched ​for evidence of ancient microbial life on Mars — a planet that long ago was wetter and warmer than the cold and desolate place it is today — and collected ​rock and soil samples for a potential future return to Earth.
Since landing on February 18, 2021, Perseverance has driven in and around ⁠Jezero Crater, an area in the Martian northern hemisphere believed to have been flooded with water and home to a lake basin billions of years ago.
NASA said the rover achieved its ​milestone on Sunday as it drove toward an area called Idubi, through the region off the crater's western rim nicknamed Lac de Charmes, where it is surveying some of the most ​ancient terrain ever encountered in the solar system.
It is one of two NASA rovers currently traversing the Martian surface, with the Curiosity rover operating in Gale Crater near the Martian equator. Curiosity has driven 23.71 miles (38.15 km) since landing on Mars in 2012.
Steven Lee, project manager of the two rovers at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in California, said Perseverance is showing no signs of slowing down.
Read More: Pakistan nears historic first astronaut mission
"Perseverance's engineering hardware and instruments are in excellent shape ​with all redundant systems still available. A recent assessment of all systems concluded that they are capable of operating well into the 2030s, likely beyond," Lee told Reuters .
China's Zhurong rover ​also gathered important scientific data on Mars, operating in the northern lowlands in 2021 and 2022.
Perseverance often has relied upon its self-driving capability, an autonomous navigation system called AutoNav. Lee said 90% of its ‌drives are ⁠done autonomously, with no human intervention.
"Perseverance takes stereo images of the terrain ahead, generates a 3D software map, and selects the safest path towards a drive goal," Lee said.
The rover also employs its Vision Compute Element, a co-processor computer that lets it process images and run its self-driving software quickly during drives, Lee said, while previous rovers needed to pause to "think" before each drive segment.
"Perseverance builds on the 29-year legacy of our past Mars rovers — Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity and Curiosity — each incorporating prior lessons and improving our ability to drive on another world," Lee said.
Perseverance's mobility ​system mechanisms are being tested to show it ​can drive 100 km (62 miles) or ⁠more, Lee said, with the hardware to be tested to the equivalent of 150 km to 300 km (93 miles to 186 miles) in the effort.
Lee said the rover's biggest achievement was almost certainly its discovery, disclosed last year, of a potential biosignature , or possible sign of ancient microbial ​life. This was found in reddish rock believed to have formed 3.2 billion to 3.8 billion years ago in a river channel ​feeding the lake that ⁠once filled Jezero Crater.
The Lac de Charmes terrain, Lee said, may yield clues to early planetary geological processes, such as the effects of large meteorite impacts. Jezero Crater was formed by such an impact early in Martian history.
"The terrain we're currently exploring may contain rocks older than any found on Earth," Lee said.
The rover's original mission envisaged 12.4 miles (20 km) of driving. NASA recently approved an extension ⁠of the rover's ​mission to explore the crater rim until roughly the end of 2028.
"There is evidence from orbital measurements that ​some areas of the rim were once hydrothermal systems with warm or hot groundwater. These areas may once have provided a warm, watery subsurface environment conducive to life. Indeed, some paleontologists hypothesise that life on Earth began in such ​environments," Lee said.
The rover's plutonium-based power system is performing as expected, Lee said, adding it has "many years of useful energy still available."

title: RJ Mitte   s final film    Talking to Strangers    gains attention after his death at 34
description: Director Johnny Severin said he wanted disability to be part of the story without defining the entire narrative
content:
Director Johnny Severin said he wanted disability to be part of the story without defining the entire narrative
RJ Mitte’s final film, Talking to Strangers , is receiving renewed attention following the actor’s death at 34. The drama features the Breaking Bad star as Joshua, a man with cerebral palsy who forms an unexpected connection with Marty, played by Lin Yin.
Mitte died in Brownsville, Texas, on October 12, 2026, according to reports confirmed by his representatives. His representatives announced his passing in a statement, describing him as an actor, philanthropist and disability rights advocate. No official cause of death was given in the statement.
In Talking to Strangers , Joshua meets Marty over lunch, and their encounter develops into an unlikely connection before taking a darker turn. The film explores vulnerability, acceptance and the complicated circumstances that shape people’s lives.
Writer and director Johnny Severin discussed the project in a September interview with True Hollywood Talk . Drawing on his background in special education, Severin explained that he wanted the characters’ experiences to feel authentic without making disability the sole focus.
“What was important was that this is not a movie about disability or cerebral palsy, it’s about a romance,” Severin said.
The role reflected a central aspect of Mitte’s career. He played Walter White Jr, the son of Bryan Cranston’s character, across all five seasons of Breaking Bad . Mitte also had cerebral palsy, bringing personal experience to a character whose disability was part of the series’ family story.
Away from acting, Mitte advocated for disability awareness and inclusion. He served as an ambassador for United Cerebral Palsy and Shriners Children’s and led the Mitte Foundation, supporting philanthropic work and greater representation.
Mitte attended a screening of Talking to Strangers at the Fine Arts Theatre in Beverly Hills on September 30. On October 8, he promoted the film in a Facebook post , describing it as having “a little love, some comedy, and maybe even some drama”.
The film now forms part of Mitte’s final screen work, while his performances and advocacy remain central to his legacy.

title: Investigators hunt French supermarket fridge hackers  no claim of responsibility
description: Staff at some    Paris supermarkets threw boxes full of perished meat and frozen goods into giant trash containers
content:
Staff at some ⁠Paris supermarkets threw boxes full of perished meat and frozen goods into giant trash containers
French investigators on Tuesday were hunting the hackers ​who seized control of cooling units at hundreds of supermarkets in a cyberattack that underlined the vulnerabilities of connected systems, ‌with no group publicly claiming responsibility.
The absence of a claim of responsibility by hacktivists or a ransom demand by cybercriminals has puzzled investigators, according to a source with knowledge of the probe. Typically, such groups tend to quickly seek to monetise their hacks or claim credit for them for ​political ends.
The cyberattack, which manually overrode the temperatures at fridges in supermarket groups including Carrefour, Monoprix, Intermarche and Cooperative ​U, appears to have been easy to pull off, three cyber experts told Reuters .
Staff at some ⁠Paris supermarkets threw boxes full of perished meat and frozen goods into giant trash containers on Tuesday. At least 350 ​supermarkets — a small fraction of the total number in France - were caught up in the strike.
The affected fridges relied ​on software by Danish firm Danfoss.
On Monday, Danfoss said many of the affected units had "reached end of life and no longer receive software or security updates" or were "running outdated firmware". It said it had "advised customers to keep supported systems updated with the latest firmware and to migrate legacy ​systems to current-generation solutions".
The company declined further comment on Tuesday.
Read: Thousands of cyberattacks blocked every month
The serious vulnerabilities present in older versions of Danfoss' firmware have been ​known for months.
On August 9, cybersecurity firm Claroty detailed weaknesses — since patched — in the Danfoss AK-SM 800A controller that could have allowed intruders to ‌bypass ⁠authentication and run code on compromised devices.
Although the precise mechanism by which attackers compromised the refrigerators has not been publicly disclosed, cybersecurity experts said all signs pointed to a basic stunt enabled both by the failure to adopt Danfoss' updates and by exposing device interfaces to the internet.
"This is about basic cyber hygiene," said Ken Munro, a partner at the British cybersecurity firm ​Pen Test Partners. "Get it wrong ​and you get a smelly ⁠mess of defrosted food."
He said the well-known vulnerabilities meant the attackers were essentially pushing at an open door, something that meant the hack could easily be "kids messing around".
Read more: Hacked FBI data has sensitive information about employees’ intelligence roles
"If this was a nation-state, why affect only a subset of French fridges? There are plenty of other nations ​with fridges on ⁠the internet," he said. "No ransom or demand suggests a lack of appreciation of the potential commercial losses that the fridge owners may experience."
Plenty of fridges remain reachable via the internet. Using the internet scanning service Shodan, Reuters found at least 4,500 Danfoss ⁠interfaces still ​viewable on Tuesday.
Reuters could not independently establish how many of them were running ​vulnerable software, but French internet scanning company Onyphe said only a small minority of the devices appeared to be running the latest version of the software.
Outdated ​and vulnerable versions were "still widely represented among publicly accessible interfaces", Onyphe said.

title: Jeremy Strong texts Jessica Chastain after  Other Mommy  beats  The Social Reckoning  at Box Office
description: The Social Reckoning  struggled to attract audiences  earning just  5 5 million from 2 606 North American theaters
content:
'The Social Reckoning' struggled to attract audiences, earning just $5.5 million from 2,606 North American theaters
Jeremy Strong and Jessica Chastain have exchanged playful messages after their latest films, The Social Reckoning and Other Mommy , went head-to-head at the North American box office, with Chastain’s horror film emerging as the clear winner.
The longtime friends poked fun at each other’s performances after their respective films opened in cinemas on October 9. On October 12, Chastain shared a screenshot of their text exchange on Instagram, revealing how Strong reacted to the contrasting box-office results.
Strong, who stars as Mark Zuckerberg in Aaron Sorkin’s The Social Reckoning , sent Chastain a headline highlighting the success of Other Mommy over his film. The headline read, “Other Mommy Spanks The Social Reckoning at the Box Office.”
Chastain responded with “Omg”, prompting Strong to reply with a middle-finger emoji followed by a kissing-face emoji, making it clear that their exchange was friendly banter rather than a serious disagreement.
The pair continued joking about the images used in the coverage. Chastain commented that the pictures were “hysterical” and teased Strong about appearing particularly sad in his portrayal of Zuckerberg. Strong returned the favour by telling Chastain that she looked “INSANE” as Ursula, the sinister figure she plays in Other Mommy .
Their exchange offered a light-hearted moment amid the contrasting fortunes of their films. Other Mommy , directed by Rob Savage, topped the North American box office with $27.5 million from 3,365 theaters during its opening weekend. The supernatural horror film follows a young girl who encounters a terrifying entity that takes the appearance of her mother.
Despite receiving poor reviews from critics and audiences, the film exceeded box-office expectations. Its worldwide opening reached approximately $45.2 million, including $17.7 million from international markets.
Meanwhile, The Social Reckoning struggled to attract audiences, earning just $5.5 million from 2,606 North American theaters. The film, written and directed by Sorkin, follows a Facebook whistleblower whose revelations expose concerns about the social media platform.
Strong stars alongside Mikey Madison and Jeremy Allen White in the drama, which serves as a companion piece to 2010’s The Social Network . The original film, directed by David Fincher and starring Jesse Eisenberg as Zuckerberg, earned more than $224 million worldwide and won three Academy Awards.
Chastain and Strong have been friends for more than two decades and have worked together on several films, including Zero Dark Thirty , Molly’s Game and Armageddon Time . Their friendship has also produced memorable moments away from the screen, including a viral video of the pair dancing to Madonna’s “Hung Up”.
Chastain has previously praised Strong as a passionate and inspiring actor, while Strong has spoken warmly about their longstanding friendship.
Their latest exchange demonstrates how the two actors can turn a box-office rivalry into a joke, even as their films experience very different opening weekends.

title: Breaking Bad    star RJ Mitte   s family details and engagement to Kennedy Suarez before his death

Mitte said he became his family’s main breadwinner at 13 after his mother was paralysed in a car accident
RJ Mitte, best known for playing Walter White Jr in Breaking Bad , has died at 34, leaving behind a personal story shaped by family responsibilities, a long acting career and his relationship with fiancée Kennedy Suarez.
Mitte was born in Jackson, Mississippi, and was adopted shortly after birth by Roy Frank Mitte Jr and Dyna Mitte. He grew up with his younger sister, Lacianne, also known as Lacey. In a 2016 interview with The Guardian , Mitte spoke about his parents separating when he was nine months old and said his father played a limited role in his upbringing.
Family responsibilities became significant when Mitte was still young. His mother was left paralysed for six years following a car accident, and he helped care for his younger sister. He also began earning money as a teenager to support the household.
“By 13, I was the main breadwinner for my family,” Mitte told, describing the experience as difficult but necessary. He initially worked as an extra before securing larger acting opportunities.
His career changed significantly when he was cast as Walter White Jr, the son of Bryan Cranston’s character, in Breaking Bad . The role brought him international recognition and helped raise visibility for actors with cerebral palsy, a condition Mitte also had.
Away from his career, Mitte shared an important milestone with Suarez in October 2025, when he proposed to his longtime partner on her birthday. The proposal took place during an event benefiting United Cerebral Palsy, reflecting his longstanding connection to disability advocacy.
Mitte also supported organisations including United Cerebral Palsy and Shriners Children’s, using his public profile to encourage greater inclusion and representation.
His representative described him as a beloved actor, philanthropist and passionate disability rights advocate in a statement reported by the BBC .
While Mitte became widely recognised through television, his story also reflected the responsibilities he carried early in life and the close family ties that shaped his journey.

description: ISPR says weapon system with advanced navigation can engage targets with high precision  defeat enemy defences
content:
ISPR says weapon system with advanced navigation can engage targets with high precision, defeat enemy defences
The Pakistan Army on Tuesday conducted a successful test launch of the hypersonic ballistic missile Fatah-2 extended range, the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said in a statement, adding that the weapon system was equipped with advanced navigation and state-of-the-art avionics.
"It is capable of engaging targets with high precision and defeating the enemy's missile defence systems due to its unique trajectory and manoeuvrability features. Fatah-2 ER, with its extended range, will further enhance the army's reach and capability of engaging deep targets," said the military's media wing.
The launch was witnessed by the commander of the Army Rocket Force Command (Comd ARFC), senior officers from the Pakistan Army and committed scientists and engineers, the ISPR said, adding that the ARFC commander "appreciated the dedication and technical prowess of scientists and engineers."
The statement also noted that President Asif Ali Zardari, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Asim Munir, along with service chiefs, congratulated the scientists and engineers on the successful test launch.
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi congratulated the nation on the successful test launch, stating that the scientists and engineers of the Pakistan Army had achieved a commendable feat. He added that the test was a significant development in the defence sector.

title: Four killed as van collides with truck on Quetta Karachi highway in Mastung
description: Four people were injured  police say all passengers belong to Kalat district
content:
Four people were injured; police say all passengers belong to Kalat district
Four people, including a woman, were killed and five others, including three women, were injured when a van collided with a truck on the Quetta-Karachi National Highway near Badrang in the Khadkocha area of Mastung district on Tuesday, Khadkocha Station House Officer (SHO) Babu Owais Shahwani said.
The accident occurred when a van travelling from Quetta to Kalat collided with a truck on the highway, killing four people at the scene and injuring five others. SHO Shahwani said the deceased and injured were shifted to a nearby hospital following the accident.
The deceased were identified as the wife of Ghulam Haider Muhammad, Muhammad Anwar, Zaheer Ahmed and Muhammad Ayub. The injured were identified as Noor Ahmed, Mahmood Ahmed and three women.
All those involved in the accident belonged to Kalat district, police said. Police initiated further proceedings into the incident.

Reading Rainbow host Mychal Threets has shared an emotional update about his mental health, revealing that he continues to struggle following a five-day psychiatric hold earlier this year.
In an Instagram video posted on Saturday,October 10, to mark World Mental Health Day, the 36-year-old librarian spoke candidly about his experiences and his determination to keep seeking help.
“People keep on saying, ‘Michael, I’m glad to see you’re doing well. I’m glad to see you’re OK.’ But I’m not doing well. I’m not OK. But I believe that’s OK, because I’m trying my best,” Threets said.
He added, “My brain is very loud. My feelings are very big. I believe I am running out of time. I don’t know how much time I have left. But I’m going to keep on trying to find joy each and every day.”
Threets also expressed his desire to remain connected with others, saying, “I want to stay. I’m trying to stay. I am asking for help. I am asking for joy. I am seizing hope.”

title: Sabeena Farooq denies lip filler rumours  says she is afraid of needles
description: The actor said she has not gotten lip fillers but even if she had  it shouldn t be a big deal
content:
The actor said she has not gotten lip fillers but even if she had, it shouldn't be a big deal
Pakistani actor Sabeena Farooq responded to speculation about her appearance, clarifying that she has not gotten lip fillers and explaining that her fear of needles and injections was the reason she had stayed away from the procedure.
Taking to her Instagram Story, the actor addressed messages from people suggesting that she had undergone the cosmetic treatment. While dismissing the rumours, Farooq made it clear that she did not consider cosmetic enhancements a bad thing and believed people should be free to make their own choices.
“I’ve been getting a lot of messages from people saying I got lip fillers, which first isn’t a bad thing, but I didn’t because I’m scared of needles and injections. Otherwise, I would’ve considered doing it, regardless of doing too much. But yeah, we shouldn’t question what people do, right?” she said, according to the remarks shared from her story.
Farooq’s response struck a balance between addressing speculation about herself and pushing back against the tendency to scrutinise other people’s appearances. Although she denied getting lip fillers, the actor indicated that she has no issue with those who choose to undergo cosmetic procedures.
Her remarks also highlighted a broader conversation around beauty standards and the scrutiny public figures face over their looks. Celebrities frequently find themselves at the centre of online speculation about cosmetic treatments, with changes in appearance often prompting assumptions about whether they have undergone procedures.
By acknowledging that cosmetic enhancements are a personal choice, Farooq appeared to question why such decisions should become a subject of public judgement in the first place.
Farooq has established herself as a familiar face in Pakistani television, earning recognition for her performances in several popular drama serials. A Media Studies graduate, she began her acting career in 2016 and has since taken on a range of roles.
She gained widespread attention for playing Haya in the hit drama Tere Bin . Although the character attracted considerable criticism from viewers, Farooq also faced online harassment and threats, prompting her to speak out about the distinction between an actor and the character they portray.
In 2023, the actor addressed the backlash in an Instagram post, urging viewers to stop directing hostility towards her over her on-screen role. She later discussed the different responses to her performance from audiences in Pakistan and India.
Farooq further strengthened her reputation with her portrayal of Barbeena in Kabuli Pulao and Aliya in Mann Jogi . Her performance in Kabuli Pulao earned her the Lux Style Award 2025 for Best TV Actress (Critics’ Choice).
In August 2026, she was also announced among the honourees of the CLC Global 100 Women Leaders Award 2026, recognising women from various fields, including entertainment.
Beyond her acting career, Farooq has used social media to address criticism, online behaviour and the pressures faced by celebrities. Her latest response to the lip filler rumours follows that pattern, with the actor clarifying her own position while reminding audiences that personal choices about appearance deserve respect.

title: Formula One to return to Africa
description: The East African nation has been chasing a Grand Prix race for years
content:
The East African nation has been chasing a Grand Prix race for years
Rwanda will host Africa's first Formula One Grand Prix since 1993 in "the early 2030s" after the circuit announced a decade-long deal with the country on Tuesday. The East African nation has been chasing a Grand Prix race for years, having already used football, basketball and other sports to enhance its image and attract investment. President Paul Kagame formally announced the bid when Rwanda hosted a gathering of the FIA in December 2024. The last time an F1 race was held in Africa was the 33rd South African Grand Prix, won by Alain Prost 33 years ago. The first African Grand Prix in Rwanda will take place "once a new purpose-built circuit in Bugesera, Rwanda, has been completed", F1 said in a statement. "Today is a landmark moment for Formula One," F1 president Stefano Domenicali added. "With Rwanda joining the calendar from the next decade, our sport will race in every inhabited continent, bringing the world championship closer than ever to fans around the globe. "Africa has always been part of Formula One's future, and from the beginning we were determined to return in the right way, with the right partner, a long-term commitment and a clear vision for creating meaningful impact." A landlocked country still widely associated with a horrific genocide in 1994, Rwanda has used sports to revamp its image, attract tourists and impress investors with its organisational efficiency. It has spent lavishly on football sponsorship deals with clubs including Arsenal and Paris Saint-Germain, partnered with the NBA to be the main hub of its African basketball league, and hosted last year's cycling world championships. Critics have called this "sports-washing" -- using glitzy events to distract from accusations of serious human rights abuses, including a brutal crackdown on any opposition or dissent. Others see that as Western hypocrisy, arguing that no one described this year's World Cup in the United States as "sports-washing", despite the country's rights abuses.

title: Lanterns    lands lowest DC Universe audience score on Rotten Tomatoes
description: Viewers have criticised the series for its grounded detective story and limited cosmic spectacle
content:
Viewers have criticised the series for its grounded detective story and limited cosmic spectacle
HBO’s Lanterns has earned an unwanted distinction in the DC Universe after its first season ended, with the series recording the franchise’s lowest audience score on Rotten Tomatoes .
According to the website’s listing on October 13, the show has a 69% Popcornmeter score based on more than 2,500 audience ratings. Its critical reception is considerably stronger, with a 91% Tomatometer score from 86 reviews. The figures highlight a clear divide between professional critics and audience members.
The rating also puts Lanterns behind other DC Universe projects, including Peacemaker season two, which has a 79% audience score, and Supergirl , at 72%, according to figures cited by TVLine in its October 12 report.
Audience criticism has focused on the series’ approach to the Green Lantern mythology. Rather than leaning heavily into colourful intergalactic adventures and large scale superhero spectacle, Lanterns centres on a murder investigation in rural America. The story follows new recruit John Stewart, played by Aaron Pierre, and veteran Lantern Hal Jordan, portrayed by Kyle Chandler.
Some viewers have argued that the grounded detective format does not deliver the cosmic elements they expected from a Green Lantern adaptation. Others have objected to the portrayal of Jordan, whose cynical and weary personality differs from the more upbeat version familiar to some comic book readers.
One viewer criticised the series for failing as a superhero, Green Lantern and detective story. Another complained that the show concealed alien characters and powers, saying it worked better when viewed separately from the established mythology.
However, the audience score does not mean the series has been universally rejected. Its 91% critics’ rating indicates broad approval among professional reviewers, and the contrast has fuelled debate about what viewers want from the new DC Universe.
Rotten Tomatoes scores can change as additional ratings are submitted. For now, Lanterns remains a striking example of the gap between critical approval and audience response.

title: Jeremy Renner says Hawkeye will not appear in    Avengers  Doomsday    and jokes Avengers will lose without him
description: Fans remain unconvinced by Renner   s denial  with some believing the Marvel star is keeping his return secret
content:
Fans remain unconvinced by Renner’s denial, with some believing the Marvel star is keeping his return secret
Jeremy Renner has said he will not appear in Avengers: Doomsday , joking that the superhero team could lose against Doctor Doom without Hawkeye on its side.
During a recent question and answer session, the actor was asked whether he would return for the upcoming Marvel film. Renner responded, “No, no, no, no. Not in that one.”
He then joked about the consequences of leaving the expert archer out of the fight, saying, “Doomsday I’m not in, so The Avengers will probably lose, just so you know… they didn’t call me so it’s their fault they’re going to lose.”
The comment prompted a playful reaction from the audience, with one person reportedly shouting “again”. The remark appeared to reference Avengers: Infinity War , in which the Avengers failed to stop Thanos from collecting the Infinity Stones. Renner’s Hawkeye was absent from that film but played a significant role in Avengers: Endgame , when the heroes ultimately defeated the villain.
Despite Renner’s apparent denial, some Marvel fans remain unconvinced. One online commenter reportedly insisted that the actor was “definitely lying”, fuelling speculation that Hawkeye could still make a surprise appearance.
Renner’s possible involvement in Avengers: Secret Wars , the planned follow up to Doomsday , has also been the subject of rumours. His wording during the question and answer session has led some to interpret his response as leaving the door open for a future Marvel appearance, although he did not explicitly confirm his participation in the later film.
Meanwhile, Avengers: Doomsday co director Anthony Russo has indicated that the complete cast has not yet been announced. Speaking during an Avengers: Endgame Encore question and answer event, Russo explained that some cast members had been revealed while others remained undisclosed.
Paul Bettany, who plays Vision, has also declined to confirm his involvement, telling Good Morning America that answering the question could get him fired.
Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to arrive in cinemas on December 18, 2026, with its UK release set for December 16.

title: James McAvoy reveals he nearly died after botched medical procedure in 2017
description: James McAvoy says botched lung biopsy in 2017 left him hospitalised for weeks before filming  Glass
content:
James McAvoy says botched lung biopsy in 2017 left him hospitalised for weeks before filming 'Glass'
Actor James McAvoy has revealed that he nearly died in 2017 after a medical procedure to investigate a shadow found on his lung went wrong, leaving him hospitalised for several weeks.
Speaking on Dax Shepard’s Armchair Expert podcast, the 47-year-old actor explained that doctors wanted to biopsy the shadow to determine whether it was cancerous. The results were negative, but he said the procedure caused a lung puncture.
“I had a lung puncture because they saw a shadow in my lung, so they wanted to biopsy it to see if it was cancer, which it wasn't, which was great,” McAvoy said.
“But that was botched, and I nearly died,” he added. “I was at home two days later, my lungs just collapsed in bed one night, and I was on my own as well, so it was crazy.”
McAvoy recalled spending “two or three weeks” in hospital while doctors attempted to treat the complications. After initial treatments failed, he said they considered a more invasive operation to clean out the affected area.
The health scare occurred before he filmed Glass , the sequel to the 2016 psychological thriller Split . In the film, McAvoy reprises his role as Kevin Wendell Crumb, a man with dissociative identity disorder whose personalities include the superhuman Beast.
McAvoy said he needed to regain his physical strength for the role, explaining that the Beast featured more prominently in the sequel. He recalled asking for a personal trainer to help him achieve the character’s muscular appearance.

description: Thomas Rew and Eddie Jack earn maiden call ups
content:
Thomas Rew and Eddie Jack earn maiden call-ups
Jofra Archer, Gus Atkinson, Sonny Baker and Josh Tongue will feature in the three-match ODI series before leaving the tour to prepare for December’s Test series in South Africa.
Archer and Jacob Bethell, who is returning from a knee injury, have been included in the ODI squad as England step up their preparations for the World Cup, which will be hosted by South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia.
The T20I squad, meanwhile, includes four uncapped players, with Somerset wicketkeeper-batter Thomas Rew, 18, and Hampshire seamer Eddie Jack receiving their maiden England call-ups.
James Coles and Henry Crocombe could also make their T20I debuts, while Luke Wood returns despite recently losing his central contract.
“We will be at close to full strength as we ramp up preparations for a World Cup in a year’s time,” national selector Marcus North said, referring to the ODI squad.
He added that the four fast bowlers would leave after the ODI series to manage their workloads ahead of the South Africa Tests.
England will play a three-day warm-up against a Cricket South Africa Invitational XI in Durban from December 9-11 before opening their three-Test series in Johannesburg on December 17. The early arrival of their quicks will give them time to acclimatise and work with new Test bowling coach Eric Simons.
Rehan Ahmed has been left out of both squads after a disappointing home summer, while seamer Saqib Mahmood will undergo knee surgery following another injury setback.
Brydon Carse has also been omitted as a Cricket Regulator investigation into his conduct during a night out in Derby continues. England managing director Rob Key said Carse needed to “get his house in order” before the team decided whether he could return to international cricket.
England will travel to Australia after an ODI tri-series in Pakistan involving the hosts and Sri Lanka. Their Australia campaign begins with a 50-over warm-up against Western Australia XI in Perth on November 7.

title: Mooney eyes 2029 World Cup and Brisbane Olympics | The Express Tribune
description: Australia’s veteran batter hopes to extend her international career as cricket prepares for a new era on the Olympic stage
content:
She hopes to extend her international career as cricket prepares for a new era on the Olympic stage
Australia batter and wicketkeeper Beth Mooney is targeting the 2029 Women’s Cricket World Cup and a possible appearance at the 2032 Brisbane Olympics as she prepares to reach 100 one-day internationals.
The 32-year-old is set to achieve the milestone in Wednesday’s third and final ODI against Bangladesh at Allan Border Field, with Australia already holding an unassailable 2-0 lead in the series.
Mooney has scored 3,288 runs at an average of 49.81 in the format, including six centuries, placing her seventh on Australia’s all-time ODI run-scoring list.
Australia’s semi-final defeat by India at the 2025 Women’s Cricket World Cup remains a driving force for Mooney, who hopes to help the team reclaim the title in 2029.
“There was a lot of bitter disappointment from that World Cup loss in India 12 months ago now,” Mooney was quoted as saying by the Australian Associated Press.
Australia have since won the Women’s T20 World Cup, with Mooney scoring 238 runs in seven innings, including an unbeaten 64 in the final against England.
But the left-hander is keen to add the 50-over crown to her collection.
“The 50-over one is what you want to win as well,” she said, adding that her immediate goal was to perform well enough to earn selection for the 2029 tournament.
Mooney also believes the prospect of competing at the Olympics could extend her international career, with cricket scheduled to feature at the Los Angeles 2028 Games and potentially at Brisbane 2032.
“Certainly the Olympics is definitely an enticing one for players to hang around a bit longer,” she said.
The Brisbane Games could offer Mooney the opportunity to compete on home soil at the age of 38.
“Hopefully I’m still around, but that’s a long way away,” she said, adding that her focus remained on contributing to Australia and helping younger players develop.
Mooney also welcomed the attacking approach of young openers Georgia Voll and Phoebe Litchfield, who shared a 162-run partnership in Australia’s nine-wicket victory over Bangladesh in the second ODI.
“The 50-over game is becoming a lot more modern, and we’re seeing Phoebe and Georgia really take the game on,” she said.
Australia will next face New Zealand in a three-match home T20 international series before turning their attention to the inaugural Women’s Champions Trophy, scheduled for early next year.

Druski could become first digital creator to host 'Saturday Night Live', as episode reportedly planned for November 7
Comedian and internet personality Druski is reportedly set to host Saturday Night Live on November 7, potentially becoming the first digital creator to lead an episode of the long-running NBC sketch comedy series.
According to Puck , Druski, whose real name is Drew Desbordes, is expected to make his hosting debut on the programme.
NBC has not officially confirmed the reported appearance, and an SNL representative declined to comment, according to the report.
If confirmed, the booking would mark a milestone for digital creators seeking opportunities in traditional television and Hollywood.

Druski has developed a following through viral comedy sketches, celebrity collaborations and his Coulda Been Records content.
His work has helped establish him as a recognised personality in online comedy, with his reported SNL appearance representing a potential expansion into mainstream television.
The programme has a history of drawing talent from different areas of comedy and entertainment. Andy Samberg and his comedy group, The Lonely Island, are among the performers associated with the show's connections to online comedy.
Druski's reported booking comes as digital creators continue to build careers across multiple entertainment platforms, including television, film and live performance.
However, until NBC confirms the appearance, the November 7 date and his status as host remain unconfirmed.

title: Finance Minister Aurangzeb vows to strengthen collective influence of G 24
description: Also meets IFC Regional VP for the Middle East and Central Asia Imad Fakhoury to discuss matters of mutual interest
content:
Meets IFC Regional VP for the Middle East and Central Asia Imad Fakhoury to discuss matters of mutual interest
Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb on Tuesday reaffirmed Pakistan’s commitment to strengthening the collective influence of G-24 and advancing the interests of developing economies as the incoming chair, a statement issued by the ministry said.
He was speaking as the first Vice-Chair of the G-24 at the finance ministers' and central bank governors’ meeting held on the sidelines of the World Bank Group– International Monetary Fund (IMF) Annual Meetings in Bangkok, Thailand.
Aurangzeb highlighted the challenges facing developing economies, including fragmentation disrupting trade and investment, climate shocks eroding development gains, restrictive financial conditions and widening financing gaps.
Finance Minister Calls for Reform of International Financial Architecture at G-24 Meeting, Reaffirms Pakistan’s Commitment as Incoming Chair Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue, Senator Muhammad Aurangzeb, speaking in his capacity as First Vice-Chair of the G-24 at the… pic.twitter.com/qhQrZ88oNr
The minister stressed that reform of the international financial architecture must keep pace with the challenges and called for timely support for countries undertaking difficult reforms while confronting external shocks beyond their control.
He outlined three priorities for the G-24 focused on restoring development as the central objective of the international financial system, making the Bretton Woods institutions more representative and responsive, and building a development-oriented international financial architecture.
Read: Govt eyes raising $1b from privatisation
Aurangzeb also emphasised cooperation among members and institutional partners to advance a more representative, resilient and development-centred international economic order.
FinMin discusses trade, investment and development cooperation with SFD CEO
Aurangzeb also conducted a meeting with Sultan Abdulrahman Al-Marshad, Chief Executive Officer of the Saudi Fund for Development (SFD), on the sidelines of the World Bank Group–IMF Annual Meetings in Thailand.
During the meeting, the finance minister expressed condolences over the loss of lives in recent incidents in Saudi Arabia and thanked the Kingdom for its longstanding support to Pakistan. He also highlighted Pakistan’s improving macroeconomic position and renewed access to international capital markets.
Finance Minister Discusses Trade, Investment and Development Cooperation with Saudi Fund for Development CEO Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue, Senator Muhammad Aurangzeb, met with H.E. Mr. Sultan Abdulrahman Al-Marshad, Chief Executive Officer of the Saudi Fund for… pic.twitter.com/FzfxiJYeh6
The discussions focused on expanding trade and investment, strengthening private-sector engagement, following up on the bilateral investment protection agreement, and exploring opportunities for refinery upgrades.
Both sides noted satisfactory progress on SFD-supported projects and emphasised the importance of developing a fresh pipeline of projects.
According to a statement issued by the finance ministry, the SFD reaffirmed its continued support to Pakistan within its mandate.
Calls for coordinated action on population growth, job creation
The finance minister also called for coordinated national efforts to address Pakistan’s rapid population growth, stressing the need to integrate population planning with health, education and employment policies while speaking at a World Bank roundtable titled “Transforming Demographic Transition into Human Capital Gains and Job Creation” in Thailand.
The minister announced plans to establish a National Population Council led by the prime minister.
He said the proposed council would help bring fragmented initiatives under a comprehensive framework through coordinated federal and provincial action, sustained political commitment and measurable outcomes.
Finance Minister Outlines Establishment of National Population Council, Calls for Integrated Action on Human Capital and Job Creation at World Bank Roundtable Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue, Senator Muhammad Aurangzeb, speaking at the World Bank’s roundtable on… pic.twitter.com/Oqubr9Ho5T
Aurangzeb highlighted women’s education and workforce participation as key priorities in managing the country’s demographic transition. He also stressed the importance of engaging religious leaders to promote awareness about birth spacing.
Drawing on experiences from Indonesia, Bangladesh and Iran, the minister underscored the need to learn from approaches adopted by other countries to address population-related challenges and improve human development outcomes.
He said Pakistan’s ability to benefit from its demographic dividend would depend on developing a skilled workforce and promoting private-sector-led growth capable of generating employment opportunities.
The finance minister identified freelancing, information technology-enabled services and digital skills as areas with potential to increase young people’s earnings and boost the country’s exports.
He stressed that population management could not be pursued in isolation, calling for an integrated approach linking population planning with investments in health and education and policies aimed at expanding employment.
Meeting with International Finance Corporation's Imad Fakhoury
Separately, the finance minister also met with International Finance Corporation (IFC) Regional Vice President for the Middle East and Central Asia Imad Fakhoury in Bangkok.
In a statement issued on social media, the finance ministry said that discussions focused on strengthening IFC support for private-sector-led growth and jobs, and translating macroeconomic stability into sustainable growth.
The meeting also reviewed IFC’s expanding portfolio, small-business financing, entrepreneurship, capital markets, and green and digital bonds.
Read more: IMF raises inflation forecast to 9.9%
Discussions also covered mining infrastructure and value addition, affordable housing and developer financing, and agricultural development through improved storage, cold chains and electronic warehouse receipt financing. The statement further highlighted that both sides explored greater private-sector participation in livestock development and support for pharmaceutical exports through stronger regulatory standards and investment.
Furthermore, the meeting deliberated infrastructure cooperation focused on public-private partnerships in water services, advanced electricity metering and financing mechanisms for provincial projects.
Finance Minister Discusses Private-Sector Growth, Investment and Development Cooperation with IFC Regional Vice President Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue, Senator Muhammad Aurangzeb, met with Mr. Imad Fakhoury, IFC Regional Vice President for the Middle East and Central… pic.twitter.com/P7U8gIAvFf
During the meeting, Aurangzeb also reaffirmed commitment to Reko Diq copper and gold mining project and appreciated IFC’s financing leadership.
According to the IFC portal , the Reko Diq project, put on hold on April 25, entails the development of a greenfield open-pit mining operation with processing facilities to produce copper-gold concentrate.
“The mine includes two open pits, a processing plant, several low-grade ore stockpiles, two waste rock dumps, a tailings storage facility (TSF), a heavy fuel oil power plant and photovoltaic solar plant, and other auxiliary infrastructure. The project will produce 200-250 kt of copper per year,” it stated, adding, “Reko Diq is one of the world's largest undeveloped copper and gold deposits, with an expected mine life of 40+ years.”
It further outlines that the sponsors contemplate a possible expansion of the project, which includes increasing copper production to 400kt per year and building the related infrastructure.
“It will be one of the largest copper mines globally when fully developed,” the IFC project description concludes.

title: Saudi Arabia strikes Yemen capital as Houthis vow to retaliate

content:
Houthi-run Al-Masirah television reports Saudi-led coalition targeted a fuel ​depot on the outskirts of Sanaa
Yemen's Houthis said Saudi Arabia was attacking the Yemeni capital Sanaa on ​Tuesday after a Saudi-led coalition warned civilians to stay away from an oil depot on the city outskirts, part of a rapidly ‌escalating war between the sides.
The Houthis have for a week been targeting Saudi airports, including a strike on Riyadh on Saturday that killed 13 people, in retaliation for the kingdom's backing of government forces against the Houthis in Yemen's reignited civil war .

Houthi-run Al-Masirah television reported that the Saudi-led coalition had targeted the Yemen Petroleum Company's (YPC) Sabah central station, a fuel ​depot on the outskirts of Sanaa.

YPC said the facility did not currently hold any stocks of petroleum products and that targeting it ​did not affect oil reserves or supply chains.
However, the Houthis had earlier threatened a "harsh and painful" response to any strikes ⁠on Sanaa, with spokesperson Yahya Saree saying targets could include the Saudi Aramco headquarters in Dhahran and an oil refinery in Riyadh.

The group renewed earlier ​warnings it had issued to oil workers in Saudi Arabia, telling them to stay away from sites that could be potential targets.
The Saudi cabinet, chaired ​by de facto ruler Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, issued a statement saying the Houthis would face consequences for their repeated attacks on the kingdom.
Saturday's ballistic missile strike on Riyadh airport was the deadliest in Saudi Arabia for a decade, with further attacks grounding flights across the country even as it hosts a major energy conference.
Saudi Arabia ​resumed its military campaign in Yemen in support of the internationally recognised government in a bid to reverse the Houthis' sudden gains last month when ​they swept down the Red Sea coast to the critical Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
The strait, the southern gateway to the Red Sea, has become a more vital route for ‌Saudi and ⁠other global energy supplies since the start of the Iran war in February, when Tehran closed the Hormuz Strait leading from the Gulf to the Indian Ocean.
He said he may ask Erdogan to intervene in support of Saudi interests.
Washington, Saudi Arabia's strongest ally and longtime security guarantor, has so far rebuffed Saudi efforts to bring it directly into the war against the Houthis.
The Yemen ⁠conflict has ​resumed as a spillover from the wider US-Iran war that began with the US-Israeli attack ​on the Islamic Republic starting on February 28.
Iran, Riyadh's longtime arch regional rival, has offered to mediate between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis, its foreign minister Abbas Araqchi said on Sunday in ​statements reiterated by the ministry on Monday.
Yemeni army strikes Houthi forces in Taiz
Earlier today, Yemeni government forces carried out nine airstrikes targeting Houthi fighters and military equipment in the southwestern Taiz province as escalation continues to rage across the country, according to the army.
The Taiz Military Axis Media Centre said warplanes belonging to the Yemeni armed forces carried out five strikes in the Al-Dhabab area and four others in Al-Misrakh district.
The strikes targeted Houthi personnel and military equipment, the centre said.
It added that clashes were also ongoing between government forces and Houthi fighters on the Al-Shaqab front south of Taiz. The military did not provide details on casualties or damage.
Meanwhile, the Taiz office of Yemen’s Human Rights Ministry said in a statement late on Monday that six civilians, including a girl, were killed and others were injured in Houthi shelling that struck densely populated villages in rural Taiz on Sunday.
Read: Saudi warning system stayed silent before deadly airport attacks
In Taiz city, the office said 17 civilians, including five women and six children, were injured and seven homes were damaged in Houthi shelling over the previous 24 hours.
The office did not specify the nature or severity of the injuries or the extent of the damage
The non-governmental Taiz Human Rights Centre accused the Houthis of shelling the area around Al-Safwa Hospital, a private facility in central Taiz city.
It said a shell landed near the hospital, causing material damage to patient rooms and frightening patients and medical staff.
Amid the continuing escalation, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs said on Monday evening that 216,000 people have been displaced in Yemen since August, including more than 172,000 from Taiz province.
The UN and humanitarian partners have so far reached around 143,000 people with emergency assistance, including food, hygiene supplies and cash support, the agency said.
On Saturday, local authorities in Taiz warned that the Houthis have tightened their siege on the province, threatening the lives, security and livelihoods of more than 6 million residents.
The Yemeni army launched Operation “Dawn of Yemen” last week, aimed at restoring state institutions and ending Houthi control of the capital Sanaa.
The developments are part of a military escalation that began in July, the most extensive since the relative calm that followed a UN-brokered truce that began in April 2022.
Yemen has been engulfed in war since the Houthis seized Sanaa and several of the country’s 22 provinces in September 2014, prompting an Arab coalition led by neighbouring Saudi Arabia to intervene in March 2015 in support of the internationally recognised government.
The Houthis fully control most northern and western provinces, including Sanaa, Saada, Amran, Dhamar, Al Hudaydah, Ibb, Al Mahwit and Raymah, while maintaining partial control over parts of Hajjah, Al-Bayda, Marib, Al-Jawf, Al-Dhalea and Taiz.

Government forces and their allies control the interim capital Aden, the eastern provinces of Al-Mahra and Hadramout, the southern provinces of Shabwa and Abyan, most of Lahj and Al-Dhalea, and parts of Taiz, Marib, Al-Jawf, Hajjah and Saada.
The Yemeni military said its air defence units intercepted and shot down a Saudi unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in the airspace over the country’s northwestern Sa’ada province.
Spokesman for the Yemeni military, Brigadier General Yahya Saree, said in a statement in the morning that the Yemeni armed forces detected and targeted an armed Wing Loong II reconnaissance drone belonging to the Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF), using an appropriate weapon.

title: RJ Mitte   s first Instagram post introduced him as Walt Jr as fans revisit  Breaking Bad  star   s legacy
description: Mitte had cerebral palsy  a condition he shared with his character in the acclaimed crime drama
content:
Mitte had cerebral palsy, a condition he shared with his character in the acclaimed crime drama
RJ Mitte, best known for playing Walter White Jr. in Breaking Bad , is being remembered by fans following his death at the age of 34, with renewed attention on his early Instagram activity and the role that made him a household name.
The actor died on October 12, 2026 in Brownsville, Texas. His death was confirmed by his representatives, who remembered him as a beloved actor, philanthropist and disability rights advocate. Mitte had cerebral palsy, a condition he shared with his character in the acclaimed crime drama.
Mitte became widely recognised for portraying Walter White Jr., the son of Bryan Cranston’s chemistry teacher-turned-drug kingpin, Walter White, and Anna Gunn’s Skyler White. The character, also known as Flynn, became an important part of the series as his family’s life unravelled following his father’s involvement in the criminal underworld.
As fans revisit Mitte’s career, attention has turned to his first Instagram post, which introduced him through his association with the character. His portrayal of Walt Jr. remained a defining part of his public identity, even as he went on to pursue other acting projects and disability advocacy work.
Mitte joined Breaking Bad as a teenager, beginning a five-season journey on a show that became one of television’s most celebrated dramas. His performance brought an authentic perspective to the character’s disability, helping broaden representation for disabled performers on mainstream television.
Unlike many portrayals of disability, Walt Jr.’s cerebral palsy was not the defining focus of his entire storyline. Instead, the character was depicted as a teenager navigating family relationships, adolescence and the consequences of his father’s increasingly dangerous decisions.
Mitte continued acting after the series concluded in 2013, appearing in projects including Standing Up for Sunny and Triumph . He also became an advocate for greater inclusion in the entertainment industry, working with organisations supporting people with cerebral palsy and performers with disabilities.
In the days before his death, Mitte had also discussed the possibility of revisiting Breaking Bad . During an appearance on The Joe Vulpis Podcast , he reflected on the show’s enduring legacy and said any potential continuation would need to surpass the original series. He shared a clip from the conversation on Instagram with the caption, “The White Family Isn't Over”.
Mitte’s comments prompted renewed discussion among fans about the possibility of returning to the world of Walter White and his family, although he did not confirm that a revival was in development.
Following news of his death, Cranston paid tribute to his on-screen son, expressing profound sadness and remembering their relationship both during and after the series. The actor also praised Mitte’s determination and advocacy for performers with disabilities.
Mitte’s legacy extends beyond his best-known television role. Through his acting and advocacy, he helped challenge assumptions about disability on screen and encouraged greater opportunities for disabled performers in Hollywood. As audiences revisit Breaking Bad , his portrayal of Walt Jr. remains an enduring part of the series’ emotional impact.

title: Dungeon Crawler Carl live action TV series to begin filming in 2027
description: Live action Dungeon Crawler Carl series preparing for production  with filming planned for 2027 and casting underway
content:
Live-action Dungeon Crawler Carl series preparing for production, with filming planned for 2027 and casting underway
The live-action television adaptation of Dungeon Crawler Carl is expected to begin filming in 2027, with further details about the project set to be announced in the coming weeks.
Author Matt Dinniman and executives from Universal Television shared the production update during a New York Comic Con panel on Saturday.
Kelsey Balance, Universal Global Television’s head of scripted series, said the team was developing scripts and preparing key production departments.
“We are starting to see drafts and outlines, and we’ve gotten the whole series pitch, which is really exciting, but it’s continued to evolve,” Balance said.
She added that the production team was hiring department heads and working to secure producers, production designers, directors and casting personnel. Balance said more announcements were expected “very soon, within the next few weeks”.
The adaptation is based on Dinniman’s bestselling LitRPG novel series and is being developed for Peacock through Universal Global Television.
Chris Yost and Eric Heisserer will lead the series, with executive producers including Seth MacFarlane, Erica Huggins and Rachel Hargreaves-Heald of Fuzzy Door. Dinniman is attached as co-executive producer.
The story follows Coast Guard veteran Carl after an alien invasion forces humanity’s survivors to compete in a dangerous intergalactic game show. Carl attempts to survive alongside Princess Donut, his ex-girlfriend’s talking cat, as they face monsters, aliens and other contestants.
Jeff Hays, who narrates the audiobooks, has already been announced as the voice of Princess Donut. However, Dinniman confirmed that Carl has not yet been cast.
“I want Carl to be played by someone who embodies the role and someone who can be both goofy and give off that really, really scary vibe,” the author said.

content:
Nathan Fielder’s Elizabeth Holmes documentary has earned 100% Rotten Tomatoes score ahead of US release on October 16
Nathan Fielder’s documentary about convicted Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes has received a 100% score on Rotten Tomatoes ahead of its US theatrical release on October 16.
Titled You Can See Everything , the film is directed by Fielder and Lance Oppenheim and follows Holmes in the years before she began serving her 11-year prison sentence.
According to reports, the filmmakers spent three years filming in secret, including gaining access to Holmes’s home shortly before she was sent to prison.
The documentary has also received a score of 97 on Metacritic , which labels the reviews “universal acclaim”.
Several critics have praised the film’s approach to Holmes and the Theranos scandal. The Daily Beast described it as “Not just the film of the year – it’s a documentary that stands shoulder-to-shoulder with the form’s all-time greats”.
The Guardian called it a “modern masterpiece of deceit”, adding that the film was “somehow, more shocking, twistier, thornier and revealing than billed – a stupefying and glorious destabilising hall of psychological mirrors”.
However, some reviews have highlighted the documentary’s unconventional style. Variety described it as “a one-of-a-kind reality-TV-as-hangout-movie psychodrama circus”, while Screen Daily praised its examination of how people involved in the story shape their versions of events.
Holmes, 42, was convicted of fraud in 2022 after Theranos claimed its technology could diagnose a range of medical conditions using only a few drops of blood.
The company’s technology was found not to work as claimed, and Holmes was sentenced to 11 years in prison. She began serving her sentence at a Texas facility in May 2023.
A trailer released in September showed Holmes telling Fielder, “I don’t have anything to deceive you on. Of course I’m not deceiving you. I’m engaging with you as a human being. Why would I deceive you? There’s no reason for me to do that.”
You Can See Everything premiered at the Telluride Film Festival in September and is scheduled to arrive in UK cinemas on November 20.

title: Litton Das creates Test history
description: Bangladesh wicket keeper sets world record with gloves and bat against Afghanistan
content:
Bangladesh wicket-keeper sets world record with gloves and bat against Afghanistan
Bangladesh wicket-keeper batsman Litton Das created history on Tuesday by becoming the first player in Test cricket to record nine dismissals behind the stumps while scoring a half-century and a century in the same match.
He surpassed the previous record held by South Africa’s Denis Lindsay.
In the Johannesburg Test against Australia in 1966, Lindsay scored 50-plus runs in both innings and recorded eight dismissals. By catching Ikram Alikhil, Litton surpassed Lindsay to set a new record.
The record for the most dismissals by a wicket-keeper in a single Test match is now within Litton’s reach.
England’s Jack Russell, South Africa’s AB de Villiers and India’s Rishabh Pant currently share the record, with 11 dismissals each in a match. Litton needs two more dismissals to equal their record and three to break it.
The veteran wicket-keeper batsman produced a diving, one-handed catch to dismiss Ikram Alikhil, who scored 33, off Ebadot Hossain just before lunch. The dismissal added to Litton’s outstanding performance behind the stumps, where he had already taken several impressive catches and completed stumpings during the match.
He also shone with the bat, scoring 53 in the first innings and 102 in the second to help Bangladesh set Afghanistan a daunting target of 479 runs. Bangladesh declared their second innings at 372-7 after building a 478-run overall lead.
Afghanistan reached 208-4 in their second innings after 85.2 overs while chasing the target at the Zayed Cricket Stadium.
Sediqullah Atal remained unbeaten on 70 after facing 235 deliveries and hitting three fours and three sixes. Rahmat Shah contributed 51 before being dismissed by Ebadot, who claimed three wickets, while Shahidullah scored 19 and Ikram added 33.
Hashmatullah Shahidi retired hurt on 20, while Ismat Alam was unbeaten on nought at the other end. Afghanistan still faced a substantial challenge to reach the target, with Bangladesh pressing for the remaining wickets.
