Flydubai said an “altercation occurred in the flight deck” and that crew members intervened to secure the plane before it was safely diverted.
The airline subsequently suspended flights to and from Israel while authorities investigated, saying the suspension would remain under review as more information became available.
In a post Thursday on his Truth Social, Trump also wrote, "I stated, numerous times, that it would take 4-6 weeks to get rid of THE IRAN NUCLEAR THREAT, and I did it in one night!"
"The rest of the time is just to make sure it stays that way," he added.
Trump: I stated, numerous times, that it would take 4-6 weeks to get rid of THE IRAN NUCLEAR THREAT, and I did it in one night! The rest of the time is just to make sure it stays that way. pic.twitter.com/WRsc8h4Zdx
Trump claims 'annihilation of Iran' possible, will create 'peace'
US President Donald Trump claimed on Thursday that the "annihilation of Iran" was possible, in response to a question about his earlier claims that the US would destroy the country.
“Yeah, I would do that. It’s possible,” Trump told Time magazine in an interview , while calling himself the “president of peace” in response to another question.
Asked during the interview how such a threat could fit with his description of himself as a "president of peace", Trump replied: "Because by annihilating Iran, we've created peace in the world. With Iran, I don't think you could ever have peace."
Q: Last week, you said you might annihilate Iran. That was the word you used. Trump: Yeah, I would do that. It's possible. Q: How can the president of peace be calling for the annihilation of an entire people? Trump: Because by annihilating Iran, we've created peace in the…
He also stated that bombing Iran was “possible” after the midterms, without providing specific details.
“I can’t tell you that because look, you know, you’re asking, where are you going to bomb?” Trump added.
Rubio ordered Iranian delegation to leave US after talks stalled
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio ordered Iran's delegation to the UN General Assembly, including Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, to leave the country after diplomatic negotiations stalled, a US official confirmed to Anadolu on Wednesday.
The US mission to the UN informed Iran's UN mission Monday evening on Rubio's orders that Araghchi's delegation had to leave New York "immediately," according to the Axios news site, which first reported the story.
It reported, citing a US official, that the delegation "had overstayed their welcome," adding: "The UN General Assembly was over, so it was time for them to go."
The delegation boarded a flight from New York to Doha at 1.20 am local time on Tuesday, the US official said, according to Axios.
A second source was quoted as saying that Araghchi had already been scheduled to travel back to Tehran on Monday night.
According to the report, the White House had expected possible progress in talks with Iran on Monday morning, but by late afternoon, it became clear the negotiations had reached a stalemate.
Qatari mediators are continuing talks with both sides on a compromise proposal, the report cited regional sources as saying.
Iran, Russia hold talks on information security cooperation
A new round of consultations on the implementation of the bilateral agreement on international information security between Iran and Russia was held in Moscow, IRNA reported.
The delegations were led by the Director General for International Peace and Security at the Iranian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Head of the Information Security Department at the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
During the meeting, representatives of the relevant agencies of both countries reviewed the current status of cooperation on the implementation of the agreement’s provisions and the established action plan.
Iran, Russia discuss information security and AI https://t.co/6UaIlzRoel pic.twitter.com/5b8aTHFWr2
Key areas of focus during this round of consultations included identifying and implementing cybersecurity projects; enhancing the resilience of critical infrastructure and communication networks in both countries against attacks; combating cybercrime; training and upskilling personnel to handle cyber incidents; and fostering cooperation in the field of artificial intelligence infrastructure.
Iran claims capture of another US submarine drone in Strait of Hormuz
Iran said its forces had captured another “advanced smart” unmanned submarine belonging to the US Army in the Strait of Hormuz, TRT reported.
In a statement carried by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps’ (IRGC) official news outlet, Sepah News, the navy said the autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV), which it said was carrying out “espionage” activities in the Strait of Hormuz, was captured in a “coordinated and complex operation with intelligence dominance and electronic warfare”.
Iran says its forces have captured another "advanced smart" unmanned submarine belonging to the US Army in the Strait of Hormuz. In a statement on the IRGC's official news outlet Sepah News, the navy said the autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV), which was carrying out… pic.twitter.com/R74nvrEk3P
The IRGC identified the AUV as a “REMUS 600”, adding that it had been handed over to specialists for data recovery.
Iran says it receives US response to latest proposal as Washington pulls out of Iraq
Iran said on Wednesday it had received a US response to its latest proposal to resurrect the ​collapsed ceasefire in the Gulf, days after President Donald Trump said he had rejected it.
Iran's allies were celebrating on Wednesday after Washington withdrew the last of its forces from neighbouring Iraq, ‌where 4,500 US troops died in the biggest US war of the century. More than 200,000 Iraqi civilians were killed in chaos unleashed after US forces toppled dictator Saddam Hussein in 2003.
Tehran views the pullout as a victory for its "axis of resistance" of allied armed groups, and a step towards its aim of driving US forces out of the region.
With the US-Israeli war against Iran now entering its eighth month, Iran put forward a proposal last week under which the United States would ​lift its blockade of Iranian ports, and Iran would reopen the disrupted Strait of Hormuz within seven days.
Trump said on Sunday he had rejected the proposal, although Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi ​said Tehran had not received a formal rejection. In a post on X on Wednesday, an Iranian government spokesperson said Araqchi had conveyed a US response ⁠to the Iranian government.
Iran says its plan aims to restore an interim agreement which collapsed weeks after it was signed by Trump and Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian in June.
Last week, Qatari mediators shuttled between US ​and Iranian envoys in New York on the sidelines of a meeting of the United Nations, the first proximity talks between the warring sides since the ceasefire unravelled.
An official briefed on the talks, who is not ​Iranian and spoke to Reuters on condition of anonymity, said the Qataris had briefed Araqchi on the US response on Tuesday when Araqchi stopped off in Doha on his way home from New York. According to the official, the sides largely agree about the steps that are needed but still disagree about the order in which to take them.
Iran wants an eventual deal to grant it control over the Strait of Hormuz, the world's most important oil shipping route, which runs past ​its coast.
Shipping through the strait has increased in recent weeks, with shippers charging high fees to brave the risk of attacks. But flows of crude oil, refined products and natural gas remain substantially disrupted. In ​the latest incidents, Britain's UKMTO maritime security body reported on Wednesday that two ships had been hit by projectiles the previous day.

Taylor Swift is reportedly affected by criticism of her new songs, while Travis Kelce has praised 'Cleveland!'

According to a source cited by Star Magazine, Swift has been affected by negative reviews of the four-track expansion, particularly because of her reported sensitivity to criticism surrounding her music.
“Taylor is extremely sensitive to criticism,” the source said. “These songs are like her babies, so when people tear them apart, she can't help but take it very personally.”
The report follows criticism from some music publications and listeners. Vulture published a review titled “Taylor Swift Needs to Let the Showgirl Era Go”, while Pitchfork wrote that Swift's music had been “almost entirely drained of depth and meaning.”

“Cleveland is rocking right now!” Travis said, per USA Today. “Shout out to Tay Tay for making that song, just giving the city a little more life.”
Jason also praised the track, saying, “Dude, that song is incredible. Kylie and I have been listening to it so much. There's just something about it that makes you feel real good. It's a great song.”
The Star source claimed Travis has also been supporting Swift as she responds to criticism of the new material.
“He keeps reminding her that she can't please everyone and she certainly doesn't need to prove herself at this point,” the source said.
The insider also claimed Travis is “completely obsessed” with “Cleveland!” and said he sings along to the song.
“He knows all the words and sings them at the top of his lungs, which puts a smile on her face,” the source stated.

Pataky called India a “cowgirl” in the video and wrote that watching her children ride nearly gave her a heart attack.
India has also taken part in other outdoor activities. In November 2025, Hemsworth shared footage of her riding a dirt bike and clearing a jump.

Kylie Kelce apologised to Kate Middleton after learning more about Princess of Wales’ formal title
Kylie Kelce has apologised to Kate Middleton after learning more about how the Princess of Wales is formally addressed.
The 34-year-old podcast host recently invited Kate to appear on her Not Gonna Lie podcast, referring to her as “Princess Kate, Duchess of Cambridge” during the Sept. 24 episode.
“I love learning, so I was unaware that calling Princess Catherine, Princess Kate was offensive,” Kylie said during the Oct. 1 episode.
“I didn't know that. Now I know that. Now I will proceed accordingly. I apologise for the mistake. I would like to refer to people in the most respectful way and how they feel respected.”
She then addressed Kate directly, saying: “Princess Catherine or the Princess of Wales, I apologise. I will get that sorted immediately starting now.”
Kylie had invited Kate to discuss topics including field hockey and raising children, noting that their husbands, Prince William and Jason Kelce, had previously spoken on Jason and Travis Kelce’s New Heights podcast.
Kate's formal title is Catherine, Princess of Wales, and she is formally referred to as the Princess of Wales. She has also remained widely known as Kate Middleton, a name associated with her since her relationship with William before their 2011 wedding.
Kylie also responded to a commenter who suggested she would need to change her language if Kate appeared on the podcast.
“First of all, you're correct. Agreed,” she said.
Kylie said she would like to interview the Princess of Wales but does not expect her to accept the invitation.
“Do I think she has time to hop on this podcast? No, I do not. I don't think that,” she said.
The podcast has previously featured guests including Michelle Obama, Sandra Bullock, Jennifer Garner, Kelly Clarkson and Hilary Duff.

title: Rick Ross arrested after woman accuses rapper of battery and strangulation

content:
Rick Ross was arrested in Miami after woman battery and strangulation accusation during alleged August incident
Rapper Rick Ross was arrested in Miami on Thursday after a woman accused him of repeatedly striking her and restricting her breathing during an alleged domestic violence incident at his Star Island home in August.
Ross, whose legal name is William Leonard Roberts II, voluntarily surrendered to Miami Beach police before being taken into custody, according to police. He was booked into the Turner Guilford Knight Correctional Center at 6:10 a.m.
The 50-year-old faces one felony count of battery by strangulation and one misdemeanor count of battery. The charges relate to an alleged incident on August 28 that was reported to police on September 29.
According to the arrest affidavit, Ross and the woman had been in a relationship for about a year and were living together.
The woman told investigators that Ross woke her at around 7:44 a.m. and allegedly slapped her after questioning her about an Instagram photo.
She later alleged that Ross struck her in the chest several times and restricted her breathing by grabbing and twisting the collar of her hoodie.
The affidavit further alleges that he grabbed her ponytail, slammed her against a wall and struck her in the face, causing a busted lip.
Police said the woman provided a sworn statement and timestamped photographs of her injuries. Investigators also reviewed surveillance footage from the residence.
Ross denied the allegations in a statement posted to Instagram.
"First and foremost, I'm totally innocent of the fabricated allegations made against myself. I repeat, I am totally innocent with these fabricated allegations," Ross said. "I have such an amazing team, and I'm totally confident that these fabricated allegations will be laid to rest."
His attorney, Bradley Horenstein, also denied the allegations and asked the public to allow the legal process to continue.
A judge found probable cause and set Ross' total bond at $5,000. He bonded out later Thursday. A stay-away order was issued involving the alleged victim, and Ross was ordered to surrender firearms. His arraignment is scheduled for October 22.

title: Govt increases petrol by Rs3 26  cuts diesel by Rs1 01 for Oct 2
description: Petrol price increases to Rs390 66 per litre  while HSD will cost Rs399 34 under daily price mechanism
content:
Petrol price increases to Rs390.66 per litre, while HSD will cost Rs399.34 under daily price mechanism
The federal government on Thursday increased the price of petrol by Rs3.26 per litre, while decreasing the price of high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs1.01 per litre for October 2.
According to a notification issued by the Petroleum Division, the price of petrol was fixed at Rs390.66 per litre, while HSD would cost Rs399.34 per litre for Friday.
The latest revision comes a day after the government decreased the price of petrol and HSD by 14 paisas and Rs1.89 per litre, respectively, for October 1
Read : Govt decreases petrol by 14 paisas, diesel by Rs1.89 for Oct 1
On July 17, the government announced a new pricing mechanism under which petroleum product prices would be reviewed and notified daily, replacing the weekly pricing mechanism, as renewed tensions between the United States and Iran continued to drive volatility in global oil markets and raise concerns over fuel supplies.
On September 13, PM Shehbaz announced a special relief scheme offering Rs100 per litre off petrol for motorcycles, three-wheeler rickshaws and cars with engines up to 800cc, in an attempt to shield lower-income consumers from the impact of rising petroleum prices.
Under the proposal, an estimated 11.8 million beneficiaries would be covered. Around 10 million two-wheeler users and 800,000 three-wheeler users would be entitled to relief on 20 litres of fuel per month, translating into a maximum monthly benefit of Rs2,000 per beneficiary.
Another one million users of cars up to 800cc would receive relief on 30 litres per month, providing them with a maximum benefit of Rs3,000 each.
On Sept 17, the government reintroduced austerity and fuel conservation measures amid rising fuel prices, tightening business operating hours and restricting public events.
Under the measures, notified with immediate effect, shops, markets, shopping malls, bazaars, departmental stores, grocery stores, general stores and kiryana shops would close by 9pm throughout the week, according to a notification issued by the Cabinet Division.
Marriage halls, marquees and other commercial venues hosting festive events would close by 10pm, while restaurants, cafes, eateries, food outlets and standalone fruit and vegetable shops would be allowed to operate until 11pm. Takeaway and home delivery services would remain exempt from the timing restrictions.
Global geopolitical developments continue to pose significant risks. International oil prices are influenced by decisions taken by OPEC+, conflicts in the Middle East, sanctions on oil-producing nations, and disruptions in critical shipping routes such as the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea. Any interruption in these supply chains can immediately increase crude oil prices and freight costs. Since Pakistan imports the majority of its petroleum requirements, these developments quickly translate into higher domestic fuel prices.
Oil ‌prices jumped more than $3 on Thursday after China suspended oil products exports, potentially tightening fuel markets already coping with global supply shortages, and as there were few signs that diplomatic efforts to end the US-Israeli war on Iran were having an effect.
The new front-month December Brent crude futures contract traded at $101.20 per barrel at 12:47 pm EDT (1647 GMT), up 3.2%, or $3.17, from Wednesday's close. The November contract expired on ​Wednesday, settling at $103.50 per barrel, marking a monthly gain of around 14% in September for the front-month contract.
Chinese refiners have suspended exports of oil products to regions beyond Hong Kong and Macau until further notice , four people briefed on the matter said on Thursday, ​a move that will further crimp war-constrained fuel markets.
"The Chinese export ban suggests concerns about domestic product availability," UBS analyst Giovanni Staunovo said, adding that it remains to be seen ​whether the measures will support higher crude imports after recent drawdowns in Chinese crude and fuel stocks.

title: Grammys CEO confirms new Asian Pop category will go ahead despite controversy
description: The category was introduced in June as one of five new awards for the 2027 Grammys
content:
The category was introduced in June as one of five new awards for the 2027 Grammys
The Recording Academy’s new Best Asian Pop Music Performance category will go ahead at the 2027 Grammy Awards despite controversy surrounding the award, Recording Academy CEO Harvey Mason Jr. has confirmed.
Mason addressed the ongoing debate in a statement, saying the Academy understands that its decision will not satisfy everyone but that the category will remain part of the upcoming Grammy Awards.
The category was introduced in June as one of five new awards for the 2027 Grammys. It is designed to recognise artistic excellence in Asian pop performances originating from or widely recognised within Asian markets, including K-pop, J-pop and C-pop, with meaningful use of one or more Asian languages.
The decision has faced criticism from some artists, including BTS, who announced in July that they would not submit music for consideration at the 2027 Grammys. The group said they wanted their music to be heard and appreciated without being divided by region or language.
The Recording Academy had previously indicated that it was reconsidering the new category following discussions with artists and music executives from K-pop, J-pop, C-pop, India and other parts of the Asian music community. In August, Mason said the organisation was listening to concerns from artists who felt the category did not represent their music in the way they wanted.
Mason has also previously defended the creation of the category, saying it was intended to recognise the growth and diversity of Asian pop rather than separate artists from the Grammys' wider awards. He clarified that artists competing in a genre category can still submit for the General Field awards, including Record of the Year, Album of the Year and Song of the Year.
The Recording Academy originally described Asian pop as one of the significant and sustained forces in the global music industry. Mason said the new category would provide recognition for music from markets including K-pop, J-pop and Mandopop.
The Best Asian Pop Music Performance award will therefore remain in place for the 69th Grammy Awards, which are scheduled to take place on February 7, 2027.

Coalition spokesman says attack targeted Taibah electricity distribution station at 5:11 am Tuesday
The Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Houthis said on Thursday the militant group had attacked a power distribution station ​in Medina this week, putting one transformer out of service ‌but without affecting the electricity network.
The coalition said an investigation and examination of drone wreckage confirmed Houthi involvement in planning and carrying out Tuesday's attack. It said the ​station supplies electricity to the Prophet's Mosque.
Coalition spokesman Maj Gen Turki al-Maliki said the attack targeted the Taibah electricity distribution station at 5:11am local time on Tuesday.
An operational review and examination of debris from the drone established Houthi involvement in planning and carrying out what he described as a "cowardly terrorist act", Al-Maliki said.
The attack knocked one transformer out of service but did not affect the electricity grid, he added.
Al-Maliki said the facility provides electricity to the Prophet's Mosque in Madinah.

A Houthi military source, quoted by the Houthi-run Saba news ⁠agency, denied the accusation, calling it a "lie" and saying it was intended ​to cover up what he described as Saudi Arabia's failure to substantiate ​its earlier accusation that the Houthis targeted Makkah.
Saudi Arabia said two weeks ago it had intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone south of Makkah ​before it entered restricted airspace over the city. The coalition described that ​incident as the second Houthi attempt to target Makkah since 2017, while the Houthis ‌denied ⁠targeting Makkah or any other Islamic holy site.
The coalition said the Madinah attack was part of what it described as repeated Houthi attempts to target the Two Holy Mosques and "provoke" Muslims worldwide. It said it would continue ​taking measures to protect ​the holy sites ⁠and pilgrims.
The latest escalation is the most serious fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-aligned Houthis since a ​UN-brokered truce largely halted cross-border attacks in 2022. Hostilities ​resumed this ⁠year after the Houthis declared a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia in July and began attacking Saudi territory and shipping, while Houthi forces also made major ⁠territorial ​gains along Yemen's Red Sea coast.
Saudi Arabia has ​responded with airstrikes in Yemen and backed government forces fighting to push back the Houthis.

content:
Netflix is developing 'American Royals', a YA drama from 'Red, White & Royal Blue' co-writer Ted Malawer and Alloy
Netflix has landed American Royals , a young adult drama based on Katharine McGee’s bestselling book series, with Red, White & Royal Blue co-writer Ted Malawer attached to write the television adaptation.
According to Deadline , the Netflix series is being developed in partnership with Alloy Entertainment and Warner Bros. Television. The story imagines an alternate history in which George Washington became king of the United States instead of being elected president.
The American Royals TV series will follow the young members of the fictional American royal family as they navigate relationships, family expectations and the competition surrounding the crown. Romance plays a central role in the story, with two princesses competing for the throne and two young women vying for the prince’s affection.
Malawer will executive produce the project alongside Leslie Morgenstein, president and chief creative officer of Alloy Entertainment. Warner Bros. Television, which owns Alloy Entertainment, will serve as the studio.
The project marks Malawer’s return to Netflix after previously working as a writer on the streamer’s limited series Halston , starring Ewan McGregor. He also co-wrote the film adaptation of Red, White & Royal Blue , another popular story centred on contemporary royalty.
McGee’s American Royals book series was published by Ember and consists of four novels: American Royals , Majesty , Rivals and Reign . The franchise also includes the prequel novella Inheritance .
Alloy Entertainment is behind several successful young adult properties, including Gossip Girl , Pretty Little Liars and You . The company is also developing The Probability of Miracles for Prime Video.

description: Rockstar says GTA 6   s story will explore most of its map  but not every location will feature in main missions
content:
Rockstar says GTA 6’s story will explore most of its map, but not every location will feature in main missions
Rockstar Games has confirmed that GTA 6’s story will take players across much of its map, but players will not visit every location through the main missions.
Grand Theft Auto 6 is set to release on November 19, and Rockstar has continued to share details about the game’s world ahead of launch.
According to recent comments from the development team, the map is around twice the size of Grand Theft Auto 5’s Los Santos and Blaine County.
Speaking to Game Informer, Rockstar’s Aaron Garbut described the new map as the largest the studio has created “by some degree”. However, the developers do not intend for the story to guide players through every part of the world.
“Part of the job of he game’s story is to bring the player around the map in a way that feels authentic and interesting,” Rockstar’s Senior Vice President of Narrative, Rupert Humphries, said.
“We don’t have time to take you everywhere, but we want you to be able to explore and get a feel for most the places, cultures, and vibes.”
The approach means players will have locations to discover beyond those directly featured in the main storyline. Garbut said Rockstar was “obsessed about every part” of the new world while working to make it a “cohesive whole” setting.
GTA 6’s map includes Vice City, which represents Miami, alongside Grassrivers, the game’s take on Florida’s Everglades.
However, several real-world Florida locations, including Disney World, Universal Studios and NASA’s space coast, will not be included.
Rockstar has also confirmed an advanced weather system featuring hurricanes, tropical storms and powerful winds that can affect non-player characters.
The game’s wildlife will provide another way to explore the map, with more than 170 animal species confirmed, including special legendary variants.

title: Avalanche kills 15 Nepali workers preparing Himalayan mountain camp for climbers
description: Avalanche buried Himlung Himal base camp in Nepal  killing workers pitching tents and fixing ropes  one missing
content:
Avalanche buried Himlung Himal base camp in Nepal, killing workers pitching tents and fixing ropes; one missing
At least 15 Nepali workers were killed when an avalanche buried a mountain camp they were preparing in central Nepal for foreign climbers, a rescue official said on Thursday, in the deadliest incident of the autumn climbing season ending this month.
The avalanche buried the base camp of the 7,126-metre Himlung Himal mountain in the northern Manang district over the weekend, where the Nepali workers were pitching tents and fixing ropes. One remains missing.
Rescuers have so far recovered 15 bodies from the site, said Tul Singh Gurung, president of the Nepal National Mountain Guide Association (NNMGA).
Eight bodies were recovered from under the snow on Thursday, while the other seven were retrieved earlier this week.
Read More: Sindh records country's biggest rainfall deficit
"The bodies that were recovered today are expected to be brought by a helicopter to Kathmandu," Gurung told Reuters .
He said chances of finding the one missing worker were dim and the rescue operation was likely to wind up.
The foreign climbers had not reached the site at the time of the avalanche.
Each year, thousands of visitors flock to Nepal to visit or climb its mountains, creating work for tens of thousands of people as guides, porters and other staff, as well as in tourism-related jobs.
However, as climate change accelerates the melting of glaciers and ice, the work is becoming increasingly perilous.

title: Hades 2 developers explain why Supergiant Games decided to create Hades sequel
description: Supergiant Games says creative interest  rather than business considerations  drove decision to make Hades 2
content:
Supergiant Games says creative interest, rather than business considerations, drove decision to make Hades 2
Supergiant Games has revealed that making Hades 2 was not simply a business decision, with the studio prioritising its creative interest in returning to the world of Hades.
In a new Noclip documentary about the sequel’s development, studio director Amir Rao explained that Supergiant typically evaluates its previous game before deciding what project to pursue next.
Rao said the studio initially believed it was unlikely to make a sequel to Hades.
“With each new project, Supergiant takes a step back to ‘think about how we feel about the last game,’” Rao said.
“What kind of lessons did we take from it and how did we feel about the original game? We did our process where we considered lots of projects and I actually, at the beginning of that process, thought we almost certainly would not make a sequel to Hades.”
Art director Jen Zee said the team remained interested in exploring the world and Greek mythology featured in the original game. The scale of the mythology also provided opportunities for a follow-up.
“We still have enthusiasm for this world that we've been exploring,” Zee said. “The Greek pantheon is so vast. It just felt like, ‘Oh, there's this beautiful orchard and there's so much fruit left on the trees. Like, we should maybe consider harvesting.’”
Zee also said Supergiant generally approaches sequels cautiously because the studio prefers creating new worlds. However, the unfamiliarity of developing a direct sequel became part of its appeal.
“We approach sequels with a fair amount of skepticism because we do love exploring new worlds and we've never done it before,” Zee said. “I would say that was actually one of the appeals of making a sequel, as well – because we'd never done it before.”
Rao acknowledged that Hades’ success was considered during development but said the studio needed to be creatively motivated before moving forward.
“If making the sequel is the right financial decision, we have made the dumb decision many times in a row,” Rao said.
He added that success also brings expectations, making creative enthusiasm an important consideration for the studio.

title: Amelia Dimoldenberg   s  Chicken Shop Date  lands on Netflix for final season
description: Amelia Dimoldenberg   s  Chicken Shop Date  brings its final season and past episodes to Netflix alongside YouTube
content:
Amelia Dimoldenberg’s 'Chicken Shop Date' brings its final season and past episodes to Netflix alongside YouTube
Amelia Dimoldenberg’s popular interview series Chicken Shop Date is coming to Netflix, with its final season set to premiere on the streaming platform alongside new episodes on YouTube and social media.
According to Variety , the final season will debut on October 2, with new episodes becoming available on Netflix at the same time they are released through Dimoldenberg’s existing digital channels. Netflix will also add a selection of previous Chicken Shop Date episodes to its catalogue.
The Netflix library will include interviews with high-profile guests such as Andrew Garfield, Damson Idris, Central Cee, Sabrina Carpenter, Ryan Reynolds, Hugh Jackman and Jack Harlow.
Dimoldenberg launched Chicken Shop Date in 2014. The series has since released 115 episodes, featuring the host’s trademark deadpan and often flirtatious interviews with celebrities in local chicken shops. The show initially focused largely on British rappers before expanding to include major musicians, actors and other public figures.
Past guests have included Jennifer Lawrence, Paul Mescal, Cynthia Erivo and Paul McCartney.
The series won the Streamy Award for Best Indie Series in 2022, while Dimoldenberg was named to Time magazine’s inaugural Time100 Creators list in 2025. She has also worked with the Academy as a social media ambassador and red carpet correspondent at the Oscars, according to Variety.
Dimoldenberg directs Chicken Shop Date and produces the series through her Dimz Inc. banner. Diara Vassallo Ndiaye and Zoe Dimoldenberg also serve as producers, with Ashleigh Kybert as head of content and social.

title: Zoe Kazan says Florence Pugh was the only person she wanted for  East of Eden
description: Kazan said Pugh was attached to the project early in its development and remained committed as the series took shape
content:
Kazan said Pugh was attached to the project early in its development and remained committed as the series took shape
Zoe Kazan has revealed that Florence Pugh was the "only person" she wanted to play Cathy Ames in Netflix’s new adaptation of John Steinbeck’s East of Eden.
Speaking to PEOPLE at the series’ London premiere, Kazan, who serves as writer, co-showrunner and executive producer, said Pugh was attached to the project early in its development and remained committed as the series took shape.
"You know, Florence came on to this project very early, and she stayed on year after year as we tried to put it together and make this happen," Kazan said. "She's the only person I wanted to play this role. I love her so much."
Kazan also praised Pugh’s professionalism and commitment to the production, describing her as "so smart" and "such a leader". She highlighted the actor’s preparation, punctuality and consideration for everyone she worked with, including performers with smaller roles.
Pugh is also an executive producer on the series and plays Cathy, one of the central characters in Steinbeck’s sprawling novel. For Pugh, the attraction was not simply the opportunity to portray a darker character, but to explore Cathy’s complexity and humanity.
"I think probably more than playing darker characters, I'm interested in playing complicated humans," Pugh told PEOPLE. "They're not one thing, they're not bad, they're not villains, they're not evil, they are a whole human."
Kazan began developing her adaptation in 2020, with Pugh becoming attached to the role early in the process. The writer previously revealed that seeing Pugh’s performance in Midsommar convinced her that the actor could bring the necessary complexity to Cathy.
The new series expands beyond the 1955 film adaptation directed by Kazan’s grandfather, Elia Kazan, which starred James Dean. Zoe Kazan said she wanted to explore more of the novel’s characters and its intergenerational story, although some material, including the Hamilton family storyline, had to be left out.
East of Eden stars Pugh alongside Christopher Abbott and Mike Faist, among others. The Netflix series began streaming on October 1, 2026.

title: The Lunar Chronicles adaptation gets casting update from author Marissa Meyer
description: Marissa Meyer says casting for The Lunar Chronicles animated film could begin soon  with movie set for 2028
content:
Marissa Meyer says casting for The Lunar Chronicles animated film could begin soon, with movie set for 2028
Marissa Meyer has shared an update on the animated adaptation of The Lunar Chronicles, revealing that casting for the film could begin soon.
The author discussed the project while speaking about her latest book, The House Saphir, and said most details about the upcoming movie remain undisclosed.
“It’s so exciting,” Meyer said. “They’ve got a lot of really, really great writers and a really fantastic director, and I know that we’re going to be looking into casting in the very near future. I cannot wait to hear how that goes.”
Meyer also said she is particularly interested in seeing how the series is adapted into animation.
The author has an anime background and noted that producer Christina Steinberg previously worked on the Spider-Verse films.
“And I know one of the producers on the project comes from the Spider-Verse movies, which, to me, are like top of the top when it comes to animated films,” Meyer said. “So I feel like I’m in really good hands.”
The author said she remains involved in the adaptation at a limited level, although the production team continues to seek her opinions.
“I would say I’m very much on the outskirts, but they also are kind of always seeking out my opinions for things,” Meyer said.
“So, I’ll be really curious as we get into the next phases to see that. I honestly don’t know, I guess, is going to be the answer. We’re waiting to find out.”
The Lunar Chronicles is being developed by Warner Bros. Pictures Animation and Locksmith Animation. Lindsey Ferrentino, Kalen Egan and Travis Sentell are writing the screenplay, while Noëlle Raffaele is directing.
The film currently has a November 3, 2028 release date. No voice cast has been announced yet.
Based on Meyer’s books Cinder, Scarlet, Cress and Winter, the story combines classic fairy tales with a dystopian setting featuring androids, cyborgs, a deadly plague and a Lunar kingdom.

title: Anne Hathaway scares Josh Hartnett with surprise  Verity  set prank
description: Anne Hathaway pranked Josh Hartnett on the  Verity  set  giving him an unexpected scare before the film s release
content:
Anne Hathaway pranked Josh Hartnett on the 'Verity' set, giving him an unexpected scare before the film's release
Anne Hathaway gave her Verity co-star Josh Hartnett an unexpected scare while filming the upcoming thriller, with Hartnett describing the prank as his most frightening moment in years.
Hathaway and Hartnett star alongside Dakota Johnson in Verity , the film adaptation of Colleen Hoover’s bestselling novel. Directed by Michael Showalter, the movie follows writer Lowen Ashleigh, played by Johnson, who is hired to complete the work of acclaimed author Verity Crawford, portrayed by Hathaway.
Hartnett plays Jeremy Crawford, Verity’s husband. During an interview with IMDb, the cast discussed uncomfortable moments from filming, and Hartnett recalled an incident involving Hathaway that happened while he was rehearsing a scene with Johnson.
According to Hartnett, Hathaway was not originally expected to be on set that day. While he was walking down a hallway after filming a kitchen scene, Hathaway hid around a corner and suddenly hissed at him.
“She hissed at me,” Hartnett recalled, describing it as the most terrifying moment he had experienced in the previous decade.
Hathaway later explained that she had found a small alcove where she could hide without being seen by Hartnett. She decided against screaming because she wanted the prank to be a private scare for her co-star.
Hartnett said Hathaway’s decision to make the hiss quieter made the prank even more frightening. Hathaway also recalled his immediate reaction, saying he appeared startled before realising she was responsible.
Verity follows Lowen as she moves to the isolated Crawford estate and discovers disturbing autobiographical writings that raise questions about Verity, Jeremy and the events surrounding their family.
The film, directed by Michael Showalter, stars Hathaway, Hartnett and Johnson and is scheduled to arrive in theatres on October 2.

title: The Witcher 3  Wild Hunt Remastered breaks Steam player record with 120 975 players
description: The Witcher 3  Wild Hunt Remastered has reached 120 975 concurrent Steam players  breaking game   s previous record
content:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered has reached 120,975 concurrent Steam players, breaking game’s previous record
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered has surpassed 120,000 concurrent players on Steam, setting a new all-time record for the game within hours of its release.
The remastered version reached a peak of 120,975 concurrent Steam players at 3am JST on September 30, according to SteamDB .
The game launched at 7pm on September 29, meaning it reached the new record roughly eight hours after release.
The previous record for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt was 103,329 concurrent players, recorded in January 2020 following the premiere of Netflix’s The Witcher. The original game reached around 92,000 concurrent players at launch in 2015.
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered features updated visuals, performance improvements and gameplay changes.
CD Projekt Red announced the remaster at Gamescom, saying it wanted the game to feel like a 2026 release.
Existing owners can receive the remastered version as a free update on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2, although the Switch 2 version requires a separate purchase according to the supplied information.
The updated PC requirements begin with an Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600 processor alongside a GTX 1660 graphics card. Higher specifications are required for the game’s full path tracing experience, with an RTX 5080 listed at the top end.
The Steam figures do not include players on other platforms. The remastered edition is also available on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, GOG and Battle.net, meaning its overall player count across platforms is not publicly represented by Steam’s figures.

Police said students were swept away after misjudging the water's depth and strong currents at the beach
At least eight students died after drowning at sea in India's western state of Maharashtra on Thursday, local media reported.
The eight teenagers were part of a private coaching academy from the city of Pune and had travelled for a picnic to Diveagar beach in Raigad district, around 170 kilometres from India's financial capital of Mumbai, news agency ANI and other local media reported.
"On visiting the beach, they had ventured into the sea and had misjudged the tides, due to which they drowned," The Indian Express newspaper quoted local police as saying.

title: President  PM form committee to initiate talks with PTI leadership
description: Joint delegation comprising federal government and PPP representatives to meet PTI leadership tomorrow
content:
Joint delegation comprising federal government and PPP representatives to meet PTI leadership tomorrow
The government on Thursday formed a committee to hold talks with the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) leadership on the current political situation in the country.
The development comes amid continued tensions following PTI's announcement of an Islamabad march. Although the protest was postponed from September 27 to October 4, the standoff between the federal and provincial governments remains unresolved.
The decision was taken during a meeting between President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif at Aiwan-e-Sadr, according to a statement issued by the President House.
صدرِ مملکت آصف علی زرداری سے وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی ایوانِ صدر میں ملاقات، ملک کی مجموعی سیاسی، اور سیکیورٹی صورتحال پر تبادلۂ خیال۔ ملاقات میں نائب وزیراعظم و وزیر خارجہ سینیٹر محمد اسحاق ڈار، وفاقی وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی، وفاقی وزیر قانون و انصاف سینیٹر اعظم نذیر تارڑ،… pic.twitter.com/9dRyQ9hVoE
The meeting decided that a joint delegation comprising representatives of the federal government and the Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) would meet the PTI leadership the following day to discuss the current political situation.
The delegation will comprise Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, Prime Minister’s Adviser on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah and Amir Muqam from the federal government. At the same time, Sherry Rehman, Syed Naveed Qamar and Ejaz Jakhrani will represent the PPP.
The president and prime minister also discussed the country’s overall political and security situation during the meeting.
The meeting expressed concern over the security situation in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa and reviewed the country’s overall security situation.
President Zardari and PM Shehbaz stressed the need to further strengthen the national resolve against terrorism and ensure effective coordination among all relevant institutions for peace and stability in the country.
The meeting was attended by Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, Law and Justice Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar, Rana Sanaullah, Attorney General for Pakistan Mansoor Usman Awan, PM’s Adviser Dr Tauqir Shah, PPP Senators Sherry Rehman and Saleem Mandviwalla, Sindh Senior Minister Sharjeel Inam Memon and provincial minister Syed Nasir Hussain Shah.
PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Khan also confirmed the development, saying the party had accepted the government’s request for a meeting on Friday.
In a post on X, he said the PTI chairman had received a message from the government on Wednesday requesting a meeting, which he had accepted in light of the decision to be taken at Thursday’s opposition meeting.
چیئرمین پی ٹی آئی بیرسٹر گوہر خان کو حکومت کی جانب سے کل ملاقات کا پیغام موصول ہوا جسے انہوں نے آج کے اپوزیشن اجلاس میں ہونے والے فیصلے کی روشنی میں قبول کر لیا۔ انشاء اللہ کل دوپہر 12 بجے اسپیکر قومی اسمبلی سردار ایاز صادق کے دفتر میں اپوزیشن اور حکومتی وفود کے درمیان ملاقات… pic.twitter.com/dNcXI83lL8
“Insha’Allah, a meeting between the opposition and government delegations will be held tomorrow at 12 noon in the office of Speaker Ayaz Sadiq,” Gohar wrote.
However, he refused to withdraw the call for the long march, saying it would go ahead anyway and hoping that any unconstitutional or illegal intervention would not derail it.
“If the government wishes us to abandon the long march, our demands are simple: Let there be meetings [with Imran Khan], proper medical treatment (of the PTI founder), and access to justice,” he said while speaking to the media outside the parliament.
چیئرمین پی ٹی آئی بیرسٹر گوہر خان کی اپوزیشن میٹنگ کے بعد میڈیا ٹاک pic.twitter.com/4NaiICAlpk
He said it was his party’s democratic right to protest if the demands were left unheard.
Earlier in the day, Adviser to the Prime Minister on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah confirmed that the federal government and the PTI are holding “off-the-record” discussions over the party’s planned October 4 protest march towards Islamabad.
“Off-the-record talks are ongoing with senior PTI leaders,” he said while speaking to a private television channel on Thursday.
However, he did not rule out the imposition of governor’s rule in the province, saying the option remained under consideration in K-P, adding that the final decision would require the constitutional process and parliamentary approval.
Separately, Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari held a telephone conversation with K-P Governor Faisal Karim Kundi and discussed the political situation in the province.
Kundi briefed Bilawal on incidents of terrorism in various parts of K-P, including Dera Ismail Khan, Hangu, Tank and Kohat.
The governor also briefed the PPP chairman in detail about Afghanistan shooting down drones before they could reach their targets.
Bilawal urged the governor to ensure that the long march was called off unconditionally and called on the K-P government to play its role in dealing with the situation of terrorism and war.
The decision for talks comes amid deepening political uncertainty in K-P and growing tensions between the federal and provincial governments, with the former threatening to impose governor’s rule or an emergency in the province.
A day earlier, speaking to journalists at Parliament House, Parliamentary Affairs Minister Tariq Fazal Chaudhry said the federal government was “seriously” considering imposing an emergency in K-P in response to the worsening security situation in the province.
The issue has become a major point of contention between the federal and provincial governments. On Sept 21, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi said the government was consulting the Law Ministry on legal options for the province, including governor’s rule , if the PTI proceeded with the march. Two days later, however, Information Minister Atta Tarar ruled out any plan to impose governor’s rule, saying the federal government had no intention of removing the PTI administration.
K-P Governor Faisal Karim Kundi separately warned the provincial government against creating a situation that could force the Centre to impose Governor's Rule.
Amid the government’s warnings, K-P Chief Minister Sohail Afridi also struck a defiant tone, saying the PTI would “rebel” if necessary to force changes in federal policies that were “harming the province”.
Rejecting the warnings, he said he would not retreat from his position because of threats of Governors' Rule or an emergency. He also said PTI supporters could take to the streets at short notice if an attempt was made to remove him.

title: Awkwafina trades Hollywood for the kitchen in new Apple TV series
description: Awkwafina learns to cook while reviving her great grandfather   s restaurant in new Apple TV series  The Unlikely Cook
content:
Awkwafina learns to cook while reviving her great-grandfather’s restaurant in new Apple TV series 'The Unlikely Cook'
Awkwafina is taking on a new challenge in Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook , an upcoming Apple TV series that follows the actress as she learns to cook while attempting to revive her great-grandfather’s restaurant in Flushing, New York.
The eight-part series premieres on Apple TV on November 6, with Awkwafina, whose real name is Nora Lum, exploring her family’s culinary history and learning the skills needed to bring back Lum’s, the Chinese-American restaurant established by her great-grandfather.
The actress openly acknowledges her limited cooking experience throughout the trailer, which features her attempting to prepare dishes while receiving humorous reactions from her grandmother. The series combines her cooking lessons with a broader exploration of Chinese-American and Asian-American cuisine.
Awkwafina receives guidance from several established chefs during her journey, including Martin Yan and Roy Choi. She also visits the Culinary Institute of America and travels across the country to explore the influences that could shape her version of Lum’s.
The series includes stops in Hawaii, where Awkwafina explores tiki culture connected to her grandmother’s restaurant, as well as Los Angeles’ Chinatown, where she faces the challenges of working in a professional restaurant.
Comedian Jimmy O. Yang also joins Awkwafina during parts of her culinary journey.
The experience ultimately leads to an opening night for the restaurant, where Awkwafina’s grandmother serves as one of the most important diners. The series focuses on her efforts to develop her cooking abilities while preserving and reimagining her family’s restaurant legacy for a new generation.

content:
'Dexter: Resurrection' season 2 follows the return of the franchise after the original series ended in 2013
Michael C. Hall’s Dexter Morgan is back in the first trailer for Dexter: Resurrection Season 2, which introduces new killers and puts the serial killer vigilante at the centre of another deadly game.
Paramount+ has released the first full trailer for the second season, ahead of its premiere on October 30. The new episodes will see Dexter caught between two killers, including a notorious figure from the past and a new murderer terrorising New York.
The season introduces Brian Cox as Don Framt, also known as the New York Ripper. The character is a former subway worker who uses phone calls to torment the families of his victims, while Dexter finds himself drawn into the hunt for the notorious killer.
At the same time, Dan Stevens joins the season as another serial killer known as the Five Borough Killer. Dexter appears less than impressed by the attention the newcomer is receiving, setting up a potential rivalry between the two killers.
Dexter also has to contend with changes closer to home. His son Harrison, played by Jack Alcott, continues his pursuit of justice and becomes a police officer, creating another complication for Dexter as he attempts to maintain his secret life.
The new season also features Kadia Saraf as Detective Claudette Wallace, who is investigating Framt alongside Harrison and his new partner Fiona Mixon, played by Nona Parker Johnson. Krysten Ritter is also returning in a guest role, while Uma Thurman, Ntare Guma Mbaho Mwine, Dominic Fumusa, Desmond Harrington and James Remar are among the returning cast members.
Dexter: Resurrection Season 2 follows the return of the franchise after the original series ended in 2013 and the subsequent Dexter: New Blood revival. Michael C. Hall later returned to the role in Dexter: Resurrection, which premiered in 2025.
The second season will premiere on Paramount+ on October 30, bringing Dexter back just in time for Halloween and the franchise’s 20th anniversary.

title: Chinese hackers impersonated ex US official to steal emails from AI experts
description: Proofpoint says China linked hackers have targeted US and Japanese think tanks  firms and universities since 2025
content:
Proofpoint says China-linked hackers have targeted US and Japanese think tanks, firms and universities since 2025
Chinese hackers have been ‌impersonating US AI experts, including a former government official, to try to steal emails from experts in AI at think tanks, universities, and other organizations, the cybersecurity company Proofpoint said on Thursday.
In a report , Proofpoint said that it had watched the hackers — which it dubs "TA419" — ​regularly try to steal passwords from people working for US or Japanese think tanks, defense contractors, universities, and ​law firms since as far back as 2025.
Proofpoint attributed the hacking efforts to the Chinese ⁠group based on the types of malware the group used, the internet infrastructure used to carry out the attacks, ​and the targets it observed the group focusing on, which align with Chinese intelligence collection priorities.
Proofpoint said the hackers' ​recent campaign involved writing emails purporting to come from experts in AI or statecraft, including Lynne Parker, who previously worked as the principal deputy director of the White House's Office of Science and Technology Policy. Proofpoint said the emails would typically propose AI-themed collaborations or ​initiatives before steering targets toward password-stealing websites.
The Chinese Embassy in Washington did not immediately return a message seeking comment. ​Beijing has long denied carrying out cyberespionage operations.
Proofpoint declined to name the hackers' targets, saying only that the latter included "experts working on ‌AI regulation, ⁠export controls and national AI strategy."
Reuters was independently able to identify one of them: Alex Engler, a former White House official who now heads the Penn Center on Media, Technology, and Democracy.

Engler told Reuters on Wednesday he had received an email appearing to come from Parker inviting him "to join a new AI policy project." But he said the email "felt ​slightly, nebulously off" and, after ​he checked with others ⁠in the field, he realized he was dealing with an impostor.
Engler said he could not speculate about why someone would try to hack him, but Proofpoint said that its ​view of the targeting — which involved fewer than 10 individuals working for a handful ​of organisations — suggested "an ⁠intelligence interest in US policymaking rather than technology theft alone."
Parker told Reuters that Engler was one of two people that she knew of who had received suspicious messages purporting to come from her in early July. She added that the allegation ⁠of Chinese ​involvement made sense.
"The United States and China are in a competition around ​AI," Parker said. "Trying to get people in the AI policy space to reveal information about their AI policy plans — if that indeed was what ​the objective was — it's not surprising."

Google gives new AI model to select cybersecurity partners, with no timeline for public release
Alphabet's Google on Wednesday announced a new top-tier artificial intelligence model to ​anchor its Gemini 4 generation of models in a fresh bid ‌to catch up to rivals Anthropic and OpenAI in the AI race.
The new model, "Argon", is larger in size than Google's previous line of advanced "Pro" models, a company spokesperson ​said.
"It's our most performant model yet built for complex workloads, ​and we see it comparable to frontier models like (OpenAI's) Astra and (Anthropic's) Opus on ⁠key coding and cyber benchmarks," the spokesperson said.
Google said it was ​providing the model to select cybersecurity partners and was participating in the Trump ​administration's voluntary process for pre-release model access . It did not provide a timeline for the model's public release.

The model posted better marks than Astra and Opus in terms of self-reported ​performance on several industry benchmarks, per a company press release. Still, Argon ​remained behind on certain other metrics, including two of the four coding-related benchmarks Google ‌included ⁠in the release.
Google no longer plans to release Gemini 3.5 Pro, which CEO Sundar Pichai originally said would be released in June, according to the company spokesperson.
In the intervening time, Google overhauled its DeepMind AI lab, with its ​founder and CEO ​Demis Hassabis stepping ⁠aside and several leaders of its Gemini model leaving the company.
The months of delays to its AI model have ​caused the company to fall behind Anthropic and OpenAI, ​which continued ⁠to push the research frontier with new releases to its top models.
Pichai in July pushed back on the notion that Google was losing ground in the ⁠AI ​race. But Google in recent months has shifted ​its messaging from touting Gemini's cutting-edge capabilities to highlighting its cost advantage compared to competitor models.

title: Pentagon creates  Autowarcom  to expand AI and drone capabilities
description: Pentagon seeks cheaper AI driven autonomous systems  reflecting a shift from costly conventional weapons platforms
content:
Pentagon seeks cheaper AI-driven autonomous systems, reflecting a shift from costly conventional weapons platforms
US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on ​Wednesday announced the creation of a new military command that would be dedicated to building and providing ‌autonomous and robotic capabilities across the US military.
The command, which Hegseth said would be called "Autonomous Warfare Command," highlights the rapidly changing nature of warfare and the need to make progress on systems like drones and the use of artificial intelligence.
Creating a new command is ​not common — the last one was US Space Command in 2019 — and the move reflects the Pentagon's push ​to shift from costly conventional weapons platforms to cheaper, AI-driven autonomous systems that have proved ⁠decisive in recent conflicts.
Speaking in front of hundreds of junior officers and enlisted personnel at Quantico, Virginia, in a ​speech peppered with attacks on the media, Hegseth said the command would be led by a four-star officer.
"The pace of ​war is changing faster than the process to support it," Hegseth said in a speech called the "State of the Force," in which he announced other changes, including the creation of the office of religious affairs.
"Cheap compute, superintelligence, and advanced commercial manufacturing have enabled the proliferation ​of low-cost, high-precision strike," Hegseth added.
The US military currently has 11 combatant commands, which are responsible for different parts ​of the world and specific tasks.
Experts have expressed fears over the potential for unchecked AI development and technology ‌rivalries ⁠that could further heighten risks across the global security environment.

Both China and the US — the two major drivers of cutting-edge AI development and its global adoption — have been at loggerheads over AI policies and industry practices. Security experts from both countries have called for guardrails and consensus-building regarding AI in military systems, including nuclear weapons.
The United States has long ​relied on its vast military ​budget to field some of ⁠the world's most expensive weapons systems. But there is an increasing realisation within the Pentagon that this is not sustainable.

title: Farrah Abraham faces two months with jaw wired shut after double disc surgery leaving her unable to speak
description: Her daughter Sophia shared a glimpse of Abraham   s recovery during a TikTok livestream
content:
Her daughter Sophia shared a glimpse of Abraham’s recovery during a TikTok livestream
Farrah Abraham is facing a difficult recovery after undergoing double disc jaw surgery. Her manager, Chrissy Johnston, confirmed the procedure to PEOPLE , saying Abraham had her stitches removed on September 30, calling the milestone welcome.
The 35 year old personality currently has her mouth wired shut and is expected to remain unable to speak for about two months. She must follow a strict liquid diet, and Johnston said Abraham has already lost significant weight.
Johnston said Abraham has been dealing with severe pain and facial swelling, while restrictions on eating, opening her mouth and speaking have affected her mood. She said Abraham is trying to remain positive and is taking things one day at a time.
Abraham has also experienced hearing loss in one ear following the procedure, according to Johnston. The manager said Abraham has a long recovery ahead but is continuing to focus on her work, including her campaign for Austin City Council.
Abraham’s daughter, Sophia, recently offered followers a glimpse of her mother’s recovery during a TikTok livestream. Unable to speak, Abraham communicated through writing and said she felt like Frankenstein. She also indicated that she hoped the facial swelling would subside within three months.
The surgery follows years in which Abraham has spoken publicly about medical and cosmetic procedures. However, the current operation was performed to address ongoing jaw issues, according to her manager.
Abraham first became known through MTV’s 16 and Pregnant before appearing on Teen Mom . She has continued to attract public attention through her television work and social media.
Her recovery remains focused on managing pain, swelling and the restrictions caused by having her jaw wired shut. Her manager’s update indicates that Abraham still has a healing period ahead while she works towards returning to her normal routine.

title: ICC introduces new playing conditions with time wasting penalties
description: Usage of Pink balls in day time Tests is among other changes
content:
Usage of Pink-balls in day-time Tests is among other changes
The International Cricket Council (ICC) introduced a series of changes to its Playing Conditions, including new measures to address time-wasting, standardise ball specifications and clarify certain aspects of fielding.
The changes come into effect for all the international series that start on October 1 or later, with ongoing series played as per previous regulations.
The updated Playing Conditions for Men and Women across all formats are now available in the Rules and Regulations section of the ICC website and incorporate changes to the MCC Laws of Cricket that come into effect today.
This playing condition has been refined.
If a batter is not ready to face the ball within the prescribed time, a warning will be issued for the first offence, a final warning for the second, and five penalty runs awarded to the fielding side for the third and each subsequent offence.
Code of Conduct provisions may also be invoked in case of repeated offences.
Tighter Tolerance for size and weight of Women’s Cricket Balls
The specifications for men’s cricket balls allow only a limited tolerance in size and weight.
For women’s and junior cricket, manufacturers have often produced a single ball for both categories.
New limits have now been introduced, establishing three distinct size and weight specifications for men’s, women’s and junior cricket.
Ambiguity over what constitutes an overthrow has been removed.
An overthrow is an attempt to direct the ball towards the stumps to prevent runs or effect a run-out. A misfield, whether an attempt to stop the ball or pass it to another fielder, does not constitute an overthrow.
The umpire will now have greater leeway in determining whether a ball is finally settled, which can often be extremely important, particularly on the final ball of a close game. The ball no longer must necessarily be in the bowler’s or wicketkeeper’s hands to be finally settled.
For a ball to be considered held by a fielder for a run-out or stumping, the fielder must have complete control of the ball. Merely touching the ball with the hand while it breaks the stumps does not establish holding it.
As a trial, pink balls may be used in daytime Tests by mutual agreement to reduce loss of play due to bad light.
The use of a pink ball must be agreed before the start of the Test and once agreed, must apply for the duration of the match.
The decision cannot be changed after the match has started. Switching from red to pink ball is also not allowed once the match has commenced.
Final wicket of day to not necessarily determine the end of Play
Play will no longer automatically come to an end at the fall of a wicket in the last over of the day if that over has not been completed, given if the weather and conditions are fit for playing the game.
This change has been made because it does not save time as the remaining deliveries still need to be bowled the next day, while it will also reward the fielding team and keep drama in the game.
A fixed 15-minute interval is the rule now in T20I cricket. This can be reduced to a minimum of 10 minutes when time is lost.
Coaches in Drinks Break (ODIs and T20Is)
The ODI and T20I Playing Conditions are now aligned to allow the ‘Head Coach or their designate’ to enter the field of play at drinks intervals.
The new wide ball rule, which was initially trialled in the ODI and T20I format, has now been permanently added to the ODI and T20I Playing Conditions.
The rule was trialled in an effort to provide leniency for a bowler who saw the batter moving around prior or during a delivery. As part of the changes, the position of the batter’s legs at the point of delivery was used as the reference point for a wide, even if the batter subsequently moved across to the off side.

Paramount’s film brings Dickens’ Christmas classic to cinemas on November 13, 2026
Johnny Depp returns to major Hollywood filmmaking with Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol , Paramount Pictures’ dark reimagining of Charles Dickens’ classic. A second trailer has now been released, offering a closer look at Ti West’s horror influenced approach to the familiar Christmas story. Paramount has confirmed the film will arrive in cinemas on November 13, 2026.
The trailer presents Depp as Ebenezer Scrooge, the miserly businessman whose hatred of Christmas leaves him facing supernatural consequences. Rather than treating the ghosts as purely whimsical figures, West’s version gives the encounters a distinctly frightening edge. The footage includes unsettling apparitions and imagery of Scrooge being buried alive, suggesting that the film will explore the darker elements of Dickens’ original tale.
West, known for horror films including X , Pearl and MaXXXine , previously said his early exposure to adaptations of A Christmas Carol helped shape his interest in horror. The film represents Depp’s return to a major Hollywood studio production after his last such role in 2018’s Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald . He was subsequently replaced as Grindelwald in Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore , which was released in 2022. Depp has continued working in international and independent productions, including Minamata , Jeanne du Barry and Modì, Three Days on the Wing of Madness .
Ebenezer is also part of a renewed studio slate for Depp. He stars alongside Madelyn Cline and Penélope Cruz in Lionsgate’s Day Drinker , directed by Marc Webb and scheduled for March 26, 2027.
With its Christmas setting, classic literary source and horror driven presentation, Ebenezer offers a markedly darker interpretation of Scrooge’s familiar redemption story when it reaches cinemas this November for audiences again.

The US aerospace company’s donation was announced during a meeting between Anwar and a SpaceX delegation in Malaysia’s administrative capital, Putrajaya.

Malaysia has increasingly turned to satellite connectivity to extend internet services to areas where conventional telecommunications infrastructure remains limited.

A recurring criticism concerns the film’s tone, with reviewers questioning whether it successfully balances erotic thriller elements with comedy and melodrama.

title: The Weeknd steps in after young fan is pushed at Jakarta concert barricade

The incident sparked fresh discussion about safety and crowd control at concert barriers
The Weeknd briefly stopped his Jakarta concert after appearing to see a young fan being pushed aside at the front barricade. The moment happened during the first of his two performances at Jakarta International Stadium on September 26, part of his AFTER HOURS TIL DAWN TOUR. The Jakarta dates ran from September 26 to 27.
Footage from the concert shows The Weeknd moving towards the barricade while singing to the young fan. Another concertgoer then approached the same area and pushed her aside. The singer paused and appeared to address the man, saying, "Watch it", before checking on the young fan.
Reports have not identified the concertgoer involved or established whether security staff took action after the incident. The available footage also does not establish the circumstances behind the interaction beyond what can be seen at the barricade. For that reason, claims about the man's intentions or any later consequences remain unconfirmed.
The moment quickly drew supportive reactions online, with fans praising The Weeknd for noticing the situation and returning to his performance. One widely shared reaction described him as "a pro and a gentleman", while others focused on how quickly he resumed singing after checking on the fan.
The incident has also renewed attention on safety near concert barriers, where audience movement can become difficult when performers approach the crowd. However, there is no verified evidence in the available reports that the Jakarta incident caused an injury or that venue staff failed to respond.
The Weeknd's Jakarta shows were part of the Asian leg of his AFTER HOURS TIL DAWN TOUR. Official listings show the tour continuing to Singapore on October 2 and 3, followed by South Korea, Thailand, Hong Kong and Malaysia after the incident ended.

title: Kanye West s Russia shows officially cancelled after weeks of uncertainty
description: West  who now goes by Ye  had been scheduled to perform at the Gazprom Arena in St Petersburg on October 10 and 11
content:
West, who now goes by Ye, had been scheduled to perform at the Gazprom Arena in St Petersburg on October 10 and 11
Kanye West’s planned concerts in Russia have officially been cancelled after weeks of uncertainty surrounding the rapper’s proposed performances in St Petersburg.
West, who now goes by Ye, had been scheduled to perform at the Gazprom Arena in St Petersburg on October 10 and 11. The shows would have marked one of the biggest performances by a Western artist in Russia since the country invaded Ukraine in 2022.
However, uncertainty grew after Gazprom Arena said in August that it had not signed a rental agreement with the concert promoters, meaning the venue could not host the performances.
Concert organisers Say Agency later said they were working to resolve the issue with the stadium. The Moscow-based agency has now confirmed that the shows will not go ahead.
"The Ye concerts in St Petersburg will not be able to take place on the scheduled dates," Say Agency said in a post on Telegram, adding that it had made the decision with "sincere regret".
The agency said it would release a further statement about the project's status and its future plans.
Gazprom Arena had also acknowledged receiving complaints about West's proposed performance.
The planned shows had faced criticism in Russia over West's previous antisemitic and pro-Nazi remarks. The rapper has apologised for his past comments, saying he had "lost touch with reality" as a result of his bipolar disorder.
Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova was among those who criticised the planned concerts, pointing to West's previous "glorification" of Adolf Hitler. In 2025, West sold T-shirts featuring a swastika and released a song titled Heil Hitler.
The planned performances also faced criticism from some pro-war bloggers in Russia, who questioned whether the country should host an American artist while the United States provides financial and military support to Ukraine.
West has not publicly commented on the cancellation.
The rapper returned to the stage for his first major US concert in more than five years in Los Angeles in April and has since performed in countries including Spain, Portugal and the Netherlands.
The cancelled Russia concerts are also part of a wider series of disrupted West performances. Last summer, he was scheduled to headline London's Wireless Festival, but organisers cancelled the event after he was barred from entering the UK. His shows have also previously been cancelled in Poland, Italy and France.
